texts.CeladonCity_Text_GotMyKoffingInCinnabar:
I got my KOFFING in CINNABAR.

It's usually nice, but it breathes poison when it's angry.
texts.CeladonCity_Text_GymIsGreatFullOfWomen: Heheh! This GYM is great! It's full of women!
texts.CeladonCity_Text_GameCornerIsBadForCitys:
CELADON takes pride in its efforts to keep the city beautiful.

That's why the new GAME CORNER is bad for our city's image.
texts.CeladonCity_Text_BlewItAllAtSlots:
Moan… I blew it all at the slots!

I knew I should have cashed in my COINS for prizes!
texts.CeladonCity_Text_MyTrustedPalPoliwrath:
This is my trusted pal, POLIWRATH.

It evolved from a POLIWHIRL when I used a WATER STONE.
texts.CeladonCity_Text_GetLostOrIllPunchYou: What are you staring at? Get lost, or I'll punch you.
texts.CeladonCity_Text_KeepOutOfTeamRocketsWay: Keep out of TEAM ROCKET's way!
texts.CeladonCity_Text_ExplainXAccuracyDireHit:
TRAINER TIPS

X ACCURACY boosts the accuracy of techniques.

DIRE HIT jacks up the likelihood of critical hits.

Get your items at the CELADON DEPT. STORE!
texts.CeladonCity_Text_CitySign: CELADON CITY The City of Rainbow Dreams
texts.CeladonCity_Text_GymSign: CELADON CITY POKéMON GYM LEADER: ERIKA The Nature-Loving Princess!
texts.CeladonCity_Text_DeptStoreSign: Find what you need at the CELADON DEPT. STORE!
texts.CeladonCity_Text_GuardSpecProtectsFromSt:
TRAINER TIPS

GUARD SPEC. protects POKéMON from status-reduction moves during battle.

Get your items at the CELADON DEPT. STORE!
texts.CeladonCity_Text_PrizeExchangeSign: COINS exchanged for prizes! PRIZE EXCHANGE
texts.CeladonCity_Text_GameCornerSign: ROCKET GAME CORNER The playground for grown-ups!
texts.CeladonCity_Text_ScaldedTongueOnTea:
Aaaagh, ow… I scalded my tongue!

This nice old lady in the MANSION gave me some TEA.

But it was boiling hot! Gotta cool it to drink it.
texts.Text_SoftboiledTeach:
Hello, there!

I've seen you about, but I never had a chance to chat.

It must be good luck that brought us together finally.

I'd like to celebrate by teaching you the move SOFTBOILED.
texts.Text_SoftboiledDeclined:
I'll always be keeping an eye out for you.

I hope we can chat again.
texts.Text_SoftboiledWhichMon: So, who's the POKéMON that gets the chance to learn SOFTBOILED?
texts.Text_SoftboiledTaught: I wish you the best of luck!
texts.CeladonCity_Text_SomeoneStoleSilphScope:
Oh, what am I to do…

Someone stole our SILPH SCOPE.

The thief came running this way, I'm sure of it.

But I lost sight of him! Where'd he go?
texts.CeladonCity_Condominiums_1F_Text_TryThis:
You shouldn't spend all your money on drinks.

Try this instead.
texts.CeladonCity_Condominiums_1F_Text_Nothing:
Nothing beats thirst like some hot TEA.

It really is the best.
texts.CeladonCity_Condominiums_1F_Text_MyDearM: My dear POKéMON keep me company. MEOWTH even brings money home!
texts.CeladonCity_Condominiums_1F_Text_DaisyCo:
Oh, hello, dearie. Did you enjoy my TEA?

By the way, dear. Are you, by any chance, from PALLET TOWN?

A girl from PALLET TOWN, DAISY, she enjoys TEA every day.

She visits the CELADON DEPT. STORE to buy some TEA.
texts.CeladonCity_Condominiums_3F_Text_ImTheGr: I'm the graphic artist! I drew you!
texts.CeladonCity_Condominiums_3F_Text_IWroteT:
I wrote the story! Isn't ERIKA cute?

I like MISTY a lot, too! Oh, and SABRINA, I like her!
texts.CeladonCity_Condominiums_3F_Text_ImGameD:
Is that right?

I'm the game designer!

Filling up your POKéDEX is tough, but don't quit!

When you finish, come tell me!
texts.CeladonCity_Condominiums_3F_Text_Complet: Wow! Excellent! You completed your POKéDEX! Congratulations! …
texts.CeladonCity_Condominiums_3F_Text_ItsTheG: It's the game program! Messing with it could bug out the game!
texts.CeladonCity_Condominiums_3F_Text_Someone: Someone's playing a game instead of working!
texts.CeladonCity_Condominiums_3F_Text_ItsScri: It's the script! Better not look at the ending!
texts.CeladonCity_Condominiums_RoofRoom_Text_T:
There is nothing that I don't know, like I wrote on the blackboard.

I know about the world of POKéMON in your GAME BOY ADVANCE!

Get together with your friends and enjoy trading POKéMON!
texts.CeladonCity_Condominiums_RoofRoom_Text_B: ポケモンが　いっぱいだ ボックスを　かえて　きなさい
texts.CeladonCity_Condominiums_RoofRoom_Text_W:
POKéMON Lecture

Playing with the Wireless Adapter
texts.CeladonCity_Condominiums_RoofRoom_Text_R: Which heading do you want to read?
texts.CeladonCity_Condominiums_RoofRoom_Text_E:
The POKéMON WIRELESS CLUB is upstairs at any POKéMON CENTER.

Visit one to link up with friend(s) using your Wireless Adapter.

To link only with a friend, go to the DIRECT CORNER.

It is the right counter at the POKéMON WIRELESS CLUB.

Go into the TRADE CORNER or the COLOSSEUM with your friend.

To link and communicate with anyone, go to the UNION ROOM.

It is the left counter at the POKéMON WIRELESS CLUB.

Go to the UNION ROOM and enjoy meeting other TRAINERS.
texts.CeladonCity_Condominiums_RoofRoom_Text_P:
It's a pamphlet on TMs.

… …

There are fifty TMs in all.

There are also seven HMs that can be used repeatedly.

SILPH CO.
texts.CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_1F_Text_Welc:
Hello! Welcome to CELADON DEPT. STORE.

The board on the right describes the store layout.
texts.CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_1F_Text_Floo:
1F: SERVICE COUNTER

2F: TRAINER'S MARKET

3F: TV GAME SHOP

4F: WISE MAN GIFTS

5F: DRUGSTORE

ROOFTOP SQUARE: VENDING MACHINES
texts.CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_2F_Text_Supe:
SUPER REPEL keeps weak POKéMON at bay…

Hmm, it's a more powerful REPEL.
texts.CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_2F_Text_BuyR: For long outings, you should buy REVIVE.
texts.CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_2F_Text_Floo:
Top-Grade Items for TRAINERS!

2F: TRAINER'S MARKET
texts.CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_2F_Text_Lanc:
We have a customer, LANCE, who occasionally comes.

He always buys capes.

I wonder… Does he have many identical capes at home?
texts.CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_3F_Text_OTSt:
Captured POKéMON are registered with an ID No. and the OT.

OT stands for “Original TRAINER” - the TRAINER that caught it first.
texts.CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_3F_Text_Budd:
All right!

My buddy's going to trade me his KANGASKHAN for my HAUNTER!
texts.CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_3F_Text_Haun:
Come on, HAUNTER!

I love HAUNTER! I collect them!

Huh?

HAUNTER turned into a different POKéMON while being traded!
texts.CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_3F_Text_CanI: You can identify POKéMON you get in trades by their ID Numbers.
texts.CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_3F_Text_AnRP: An RPG! There's no time for that!
texts.CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_3F_Text_Spor: A sports game! Dad'll like that!
texts.CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_3F_Text_RedG: Red and Green! Both are POKéMON!
texts.Text_CounterTeach:
Oh, hi! I finally finished POKéMON.

Not done yet? How about I teach you a good move?

The move I have in mind is COUNTER.

Not like the one I'm leaning on, mind you!
texts.Text_CounterDeclined: You're not interested? Come see me if you change your mind.
texts.Text_CounterWhichMon: Which POKéMON should I teach COUNTER to?
texts.Text_CounterTaught: Are you using that COUNTER move I taught your POKéMON?
texts.CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_4F_Text_Gett:
I'm getting a present for my girlfriend.

I guess a POKé DOLL will be it. It's the popular thing.
texts.CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_4F_Text_CanR:
I heard something useful.

If a wild POKéMON appears, you can distract it with a POKé DOLL.

You can run away while the wild POKéMON is distracted.
texts.CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_4F_Text_Floo:
Express yourself with gifts! 4F: WISE MAN GIFTS

Evolution Special! Element STONES on sale now!
texts.CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_5F_Text_Expl:
POKéMON stat enhancers can be bought only here.

HP UP increases the base HP of a POKéMON.

CALCIUM raises the base SP. ATK stat of one POKéMON.

ZINC boosts the base SP. DEF stat of one POKéMON.

CARBOS enhances the base SPEED stat.
texts.CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_5F_Text_Here:
I'm here for POKéMON stat enhancers.

PROTEIN increases the base ATTACK power.

IRON increases the base DEFENSE stat.
texts.CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_Roof_Text_Im:
I'm thirsty! I want something to drink!

{FONT_NORMAL}Give her a drink?
texts.CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_Roof_Text_Ya:
Yay!

FRESH WATER!

Thank you! You can have this from me!
texts.Text_ReceivedItemFromLittleGirl: {PLAYER} received a {STR_VAR_2} from the little girl.
texts.CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_Roof_Text_Ex:
TM16 contains LIGHT SCREEN.

It's a move that weakens the power of special attacks by your foe.
texts.CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_Roof_Text_Ya:
Yay!

SODA POP!

Thank you! You can have this from me!
texts.CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_Roof_Text_Ex:
TM20 contains SAFEGUARD.

It's a move that prevents status problems among your POKéMON.
texts.CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_Roof_Text_Ya:
Yay!

LEMONADE!

Thank you! You can have this from me!
texts.CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_Roof_Text_Ex:
TM33 contains REFLECT.

It's a move that weakens the power of physical attacks by your foe.
texts.CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_Roof_Text_Do: You don't have space for this!
texts.CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_Roof_Text_Im: No, thank you! I'm not thirsty after all!
texts.CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_Roof_Text_My:
My sister is a TRAINER, believe it or not.

But, she's so immature, she drives me nuts!
texts.CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_Roof_Text_Im: I'm thirsty! I want something to drink!
texts.CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_Roof_Text_Ve: A vending machine! What does it have?
texts.CeladonCity_DepartmentStore_Roof_Text_No: There's no more room for stuff!
texts.CeladonCity_GameCorner_Text_CanExchangeC:
Welcome!

You can exchange your COINS for fabulous prizes next door.
texts.CeladonCity_GameCorner_Text_WelcomeBuySo:
Welcome to ROCKET GAME CORNER!

Do you need some game COINS? Would you like to buy some?
texts.CeladonCity_GameCorner_Text_SorryDontHav: Oh, I'm sorry. You don't have a COIN CASE.
texts.CeladonCity_GameCorner_Text_CoinCaseIsFu: Whoops! Your COIN CASE is full.
texts.CeladonCity_GameCorner_Text_HereAreYourC: Thank you. Here are your COINS!
texts.CeladonCity_GameCorner_Text_RumoredTeamR:
Keep this quiet.

It's rumored that this place is run by TEAM ROCKET.
texts.CeladonCity_GameCorner_Text_ThinkMachine: I think these machines have different odds.
texts.CeladonCity_GameCorner_Text_DoYouWantToP: Kid, do you want to play?
texts.CeladonCity_GameCorner_Text_WinsComeAndG: Wins seem to come and go. Nothing's a sure thing.
texts.CeladonCity_GameCorner_Text_WinOrLoseIts: These slot games… Win or lose, it's only by luck.
texts.CeladonCity_GameCorner_Text_GymGuyAdvice:
Hey!

You have better things to do, champ in the making!

CELADON GYM's LEADER is ERIKA.

She is a user of GRASS-type POKéMON, and at one with nature.

She might appear docile because of her flower arranging…

But she's not one to be taken lightly!
texts.CeladonCity_GameCorner_Text_RareMonsForC:
They offer rare POKéMON that can be exchanged for your COINS.

But, I just can't seem to win!
texts.CeladonCity_GameCorner_Text_SoEasyToGetH: Games are scary! It's so easy to get hooked!
texts.CeladonCity_GameCorner_Text_Received20Co: {PLAYER} received 20 COINS from the nice guy.
texts.CeladonCity_GameCorner_Text_NeedMoreCoin: Darn! I need more COINS for the POKéMON I want!
texts.CeladonCity_GameCorner_Text_HereAreSomeC: Hey, what? You're throwing me off! Here are some COINS, so shoo!
texts.CeladonCity_GameCorner_Text_YouveGotPlen: You've got plenty of your own COINS!
texts.CeladonCity_GameCorner_Text_WatchReelsCl: The trick is to watch the reels closely.
texts.CeladonCity_GameCorner_Text_GruntIntro: I'm guarding this poster! Go away, or else!
texts.CeladonCity_GameCorner_Text_GruntPostBat:
The TEAM ROCKET HIDEOUT might be discovered!

I better tell BOSS!
texts.CeladonCity_GameCorner_Text_SwitchBehind:
Hey!

A switch behind the poster!? Let's push it!
texts.CeladonCity_GameCorner_Text_DontHaveCoin: Oops! Don't have the COIN CASE!
texts.CeladonCity_GameCorner_Text_SlotMachineW: A slot machine! Want to play?
texts.CeladonCity_GameCorner_Text_OutOfOrder: OUT OF ORDER This is broken.
texts.CeladonCity_GameCorner_Text_OutToLunch: OUT TO LUNCH This is reserved.
texts.CeladonCity_GameCorner_PrizeRoom_Text_Fa: I sure do fancy that PORYGON! But, it's hard to win at slots!
texts.CeladonCity_GameCorner_PrizeRoom_Text_Ra: Gahaha! I raked it in today! If only every day were like this…
texts.CeladonCity_GameCorner_PrizeRoom_Text_We: We exchange your COINS for prizes.
texts.CeladonCity_GameCorner_PrizeRoom_Text_Yo: Okay, a TM of {STR_VAR_2} is what you want?
texts.CeladonCity_GameCorner_PrizeRoom_Text_Ne: Sorry, you'll need more COINS than that.
texts.CeladonCity_GameCorner_PrizeRoom_Text_Oo: おきゃくさん もう もてないよ
texts.CeladonCity_Gym_Text_ErikaIntro:
Hello… Lovely weather, isn't it? It's so pleasant…

…Oh, dear… I must have dozed off. Welcome.

My name is ERIKA. I am the LEADER of CELADON GYM.

I am a student of the art of flower arranging.

My POKéMON are solely of the GRASS type.

…Oh, I'm sorry, I had no idea that you wished to challenge me.

Very well, but I shall not lose.{PLAY_BGM MUS_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}
texts.CeladonCity_Gym_Text_ErikaDefeat:
Oh! I concede defeat. You are remarkably strong.

I must confer on you the RAINBOWBADGE.
texts.CeladonCity_Gym_Text_ErikaPostBattle:
You are cataloging POKéMON? I must say I'm impressed.

I would never collect POKéMON if they were unattractive.
texts.CeladonCity_Gym_Text_ExplainRainbowBadge:
The RAINBOWBADGE will make POKéMON up to Lv. 50 obey.

It also allows POKéMON to use STRENGTH in and out of battle.

Please also take this with you.
texts.CeladonCity_Gym_Text_ExplainTM19:
TM19 contains GIGA DRAIN.

Half the damage it inflicts is drained to heal your POKéMON.

Wouldn't you agree that it's a wonderful move?
texts.CeladonCity_Gym_Text_ShouldMakeRoomForTh: You should make room for this.
texts.CeladonCity_Gym_Text_KayIntro:
I should tell you about this GYM.

Only real ladies are allowed in here!
texts.CeladonCity_Gym_Text_KayPostBattle: Bleaah! I hope ERIKA wipes you out!
texts.CeladonCity_Gym_Text_BridgetIntro: Oh, welcome. I was getting bored.
texts.CeladonCity_Gym_Text_BridgetPostBattle:
GRASS-type POKéMON are tough against the WATER type.

They also have an edge on ROCK- and GROUND-type POKéMON.
texts.CeladonCity_Gym_Text_TinaPostBattle: Oh, you were looking at ERIKA… You weren't looking at me…
texts.CeladonCity_Gym_Text_TamiaIntro:
Look, look! See my POKéMON!

I like the GRASS type. I like how they're easy to raise.
texts.CeladonCity_Gym_Text_TamiaPostBattle:
We only use GRASS-type POKéMON at our GYM.

Why? We also use them for making flower arrangements!
texts.CeladonCity_Gym_Text_LisaIntro:
Oh, hey!

We don't like BUG- or FIRE-type POKéMON in here!
texts.CeladonCity_Gym_Text_LisaPostBattle: Our LEADER ERIKA might be quiet, but she's famous around here.
texts.CeladonCity_Gym_Text_LoriIntro: Pleased to meet you. My hobby is POKéMON training.
texts.CeladonCity_Gym_Text_LoriPostBattle: I have a blind date coming up. I have to learn to be polite, especially if I have to battle.
texts.CeladonCity_Gym_Text_MaryIntro:
Welcome to CELADON GYM!

You'd better not underestimate the nice ladies here.
texts.CeladonCity_Gym_Text_MaryPostBattle: I didn't bring my best POKéMON. Wait until next time!
texts.CeladonCity_Gym_Text_GymStatue:
CELADON POKéMON GYM LEADER: ERIKA

WINNING TRAINERS: {RIVAL}
texts.CeladonCity_Gym_Text_GymStatuePlayerWon:
CELADON POKéMON GYM LEADER: ERIKA

WINNING TRAINERS: {RIVAL}, {PLAYER}
texts.CeladonCity_Hotel_Text_ThisHotelIsForPeo:
POKéMON? No, this is a hotel for people.

We're full up, unfortunately.
texts.CeladonCity_Hotel_Text_OnVacationWithBro:
I'm on vacation with my brother and boyfriend.

CELADON is such a pretty city!
texts.CeladonCity_Hotel_Text_WhyDidSheBringBro: Why? Why did she bring her brother?
texts.CeladonCity_Hotel_Text_SisBroughtMeOnVac: Yippee! I'm on vacation! My sis brought me along! Awesome!
texts.CeladonCity_House1_Text_SlotsReelInTheDo:
Hehehe!

The slots just reel in the dough, big-time!
texts.CeladonCity_House1_Text_ShippedMonsAsSlo:
CHIEF!

We just shipped two thousand more POKéMON as slot prizes again today!
texts.CeladonCity_House1_Text_DontTouchGameCor:
Don't touch the poster at the GAME CORNER!

There's no secret switch behind it!
texts.CeladonCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_PokeFl:
A POKé FLUTE awakens sleeping POKéMON. You know that.

It does so with a sound that only they can hear.
texts.CeladonCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_RodeHe:
I rode here from FUCHSIA.

It's an uphill ride on CYCLING ROAD, so I'm exhausted.
texts.CeladonCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_GoToCy: If I had a BIKE, I would go to CYCLING ROAD!
texts.CeladonCity_Restaurant_Text_TakingBreakR:
Hi!

Sorry, but we're taking a break right now.
texts.CeladonCity_Restaurant_Text_OftenGoToDru: My POKéMON are weak, so I often have to go to the DRUGSTORE.
texts.CeladonCity_Restaurant_Text_PsstBasement: Psst! There's a basement under the GAME CORNER, I hear.
texts.CeladonCity_Restaurant_Text_ManLostItAll:
Munch…

The man at that table lost it all at the slots.
texts.CeladonCity_Restaurant_Text_TakeThisImBu:
Go ahead! Laugh! I'm flat-out busted!

No more slots for me! I'm going straight!

Here! I won't be needing this anymore!
texts.CeladonCity_Restaurant_Text_ReceivedCoin: {PLAYER} received a COIN CASE from the man.
texts.CeladonCity_Restaurant_Text_ThoughtIdWin: I always thought I was going to win it back…
texts.CeruleanCity_Text_RivalIntro:
{RIVAL}: Yo! {PLAYER}!

You're still struggling along back here?

I'm doing great! I caught a bunch of strong and smart POKéMON!

Here, let me see what you caught, {PLAYER}!
texts.CeruleanCity_Text_RivalDefeat: Hey! Take it easy! You won already!
texts.CeruleanCity_Text_RivalPostBattle:
{RIVAL}: Hey, guess what?

I went to BILL's and got him to show me his rare POKéMON.

That added a lot of pages to my POKéDEX!

After all, BILL's world famous as a POKéMANIAC.

He invented the POKéMON Storage System on PC, too.

Since you're using his system, you should go thank him.

Well, I better get rolling! Smell ya later!
texts.CeruleanCity_Text_OhRightLittlePresentAs:
Oh, yeah, right.

I feel sorry for you. No, really. You're always plodding behind me.

So here, I'll give you a little present as a favor.
texts.CeruleanCity_Text_ExplainFameCheckerSmel:
A chatty gossip like you… That thing's perfect.

I don't need it because I don't give a hoot about others.

All right, this time I really am gone. Smell ya!
texts.CeruleanCity_Text_RivalVictory: なんたって！ おれは　てんさい　だからよ！
texts.CeruleanCity_Text_GruntDefeat: GRUNT: Stop! I give up! I'll leave quietly!
texts.CeruleanCity_Text_OkayIllReturnStolenTM: …Okay. I'll return the TM I stole.
texts.CeruleanCity_Text_RecoveredTM28FromGrunt: {PLAYER} recovered TM28 from the TEAM ROCKET GRUNT.
texts.CeruleanCity_Text_MakeRoomForThisCantRun: Make room for this! I can't run until I give it to you!
texts.CeruleanCity_Text_TrainerLifeIsToughIsnt:
You're a TRAINER, too?

Collecting, battling… It's a tough life, isn't it?
texts.CeruleanCity_Text_YouCanCutDownSmallTree:
Did you know that you can CUT down small trees?

Even that small tree in front of the shop can be CUT down.

I think there's a way around it, though.
texts.CeruleanCity_Text_IfSlowbroWasntThereCou:
If that SLOWBRO wasn't there, you could CUT down the small tree.

That way, you could get to the other side.

I think there's a way around it, though.
texts.CeruleanCity_Text_PokemonEncyclopediaAmu: You're making an encyclopedia on POKéMON? That sounds amusing.
texts.CeruleanCity_Text_PeopleHereWereRobbed:
The people here were robbed.

It's obvious that TEAM ROCKET is behind this most heinous crime!

Even our POLICE FORCE has trouble with the ROCKETS!
texts.CeruleanCity_Text_HardToControlMonsObedi:
No! That's wrong! It's so hard to control POKéMON!

Your POKéMON's obedience depends on your abilities as a TRAINER.
texts.CeruleanCity_Text_WantBrightRedBicycle:
I want a bright red bicycle.

I'll keep it at home, so it won't get dirty.
texts.CeruleanCity_Text_ThisIsCeruleanCave:
This is CERULEAN CAVE.

Horribly strong POKéMON live inside there.

It takes a very special TRAINER to be allowed inside there.

You'd have to be strong enough to become the POKéMON LEAGUE CHAMPION for starters.

And, you would have to have made a great achievement.
texts.CeruleanCity_Text_CitySign: CERULEAN CITY A Mysterious, Blue Aura Surrounds It
texts.CeruleanCity_Text_TrainerTipsHeldItems:
TRAINER TIPS

A POKéMON can be made to hold an item.

Some items can even be used by the holding POKéMON in battle.
texts.CeruleanCity_Text_BikeShopSign: Grass and caves handled easily! BIKE SHOP
texts.CeruleanCity_Text_GymSign: CERULEAN CITY POKéMON GYM LEADER: MISTY The Tomboyish Mermaid!
texts.CeruleanCity_BikeShop_Text_WelcomeToBike:
Hi! Welcome to our BIKE SHOP.

Have we got just the BIKE for you!
texts.CeruleanCity_BikeShop_Text_OhBikeVoucher:
Oh, that's…

A BIKE VOUCHER!

Okay! Here you go!
texts.CeruleanCity_BikeShop_Text_ExchangedVouc: {PLAYER} exchanged the BIKE VOUCHER for a BICYCLE.
texts.CeruleanCity_BikeShop_Text_ThankYouComeA: Thank you! Come back again sometime!
texts.CeruleanCity_BikeShop_Text_HowDoYouLikeN:
How do you like your new BICYCLE? Do you like how it rides?

You can take it out on CYCLING ROAD and even into caves!
texts.CeruleanCity_BikeShop_Text_MakeRoomForBi: You better make room for your BICYCLE!
texts.CeruleanCity_BikeShop_Text_CityBikeGoodE:
A plain city bike is good enough for me.

After all, you can't put a shopping basket on a mountain bike.
texts.CeruleanCity_BikeShop_Text_BikesCoolButE: These bikes are cool, but they're way expensive!
texts.CeruleanCity_BikeShop_Text_WowYourBikeIs: Wow. Your BIKE is really cool!
texts.CeruleanCity_BikeShop_Text_GermanFoldabl:
ついに　はつばい！

ドイツ　せい　さいこうきゅう おりたたみ　じてんしゃ！
texts.CeruleanCity_Gym_Text_MistyIntro:
Hi, you're a new face!

Only those TRAINERS who have a policy about POKéMON can turn pro.

What is your approach when you catch and train POKéMON?

My policy is an all-out offensive with WATER-type POKéMON!{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}
texts.CeruleanCity_Gym_Text_ExplainTM03:
TM03 teaches WATER PULSE.

Use it on an aquatic POKéMON!
texts.CeruleanCity_Gym_Text_ExplainCascadeBadg:
The CASCADEBADGE makes all POKéMON up to Lv. 30 obey.

That includes even outsiders you got in trades.

There's more. You can now use CUT anytime, even out of battle.

You can CUT down small trees to open new pathways.

You can also have my favorite TM.
texts.CeruleanCity_Gym_Text_BetterMakeRoomForT: You better make room for this!
texts.CeruleanCity_Gym_Text_MistyDefeat:
Wow! You're too much!

All right!

You can have the CASCADEBADGE to show you beat me.
texts.CeruleanCity_Gym_Text_DianaIntro:
What? You? I'm more than good enough for you!

MISTY won't have to be bothered.
texts.CeruleanCity_Gym_Text_DianaPostBattle: You have to face other TRAINERS to see how good you really are.
texts.CeruleanCity_Gym_Text_LuisIntro:
Splash!

I'm first up! Let's do it!
texts.CeruleanCity_Gym_Text_LuisPostBattle:
MISTY is a TRAINER who's going to keep improving.

She won't lose to someone like you!
texts.CeruleanCity_Gym_Text_GymGuyAdvice:
Yo! Champ in the making!

Let me give you some advice!

The LEADER, MISTY, is a pro who uses WATER-type POKéMON.

You can drain all their water with GRASS-type POKéMON.

Or, you might use ELECTRIC-type POKéMON and zap them!
texts.CeruleanCity_Gym_Text_WeMakePrettyGoodTe:
You beat MISTY! See, what'd I tell ya?

You and me, kid, we make a pretty darn-good team!
texts.CeruleanCity_Gym_Text_GymStatue:
CERULEAN POKéMON GYM LEADER: MISTY

WINNING TRAINERS: {RIVAL}
texts.CeruleanCity_Gym_Text_GymStatuePlayerWon:
CERULEAN POKéMON GYM LEADER: MISTY

WINNING TRAINERS: {RIVAL}, {PLAYER}
texts.CeruleanCity_House1_Text_BadgesHaveAmazi:
Only skilled TRAINERS can collect POKéMON BADGES.

I see you have at least one.

Those BADGES have amazing secrets, did you know?
texts.CeruleanCity_House1_Text_DescribeWhichBa:
Now then…

Which of the eight BADGES should I describe?
texts.CeruleanCity_House1_Text_ComeVisitAnytim: Come visit me anytime you wish.
texts.CeruleanCity_House1_Text_AttackStatFlash:
The ATTACK stat of all your POKéMON increases a little bit.

It also lets you use the move FLASH outside of battle.
texts.CeruleanCity_House1_Text_ObeyLv30Cut:
POKéMON up to Lv. 30 will obey you.

That includes even outsiders you obtain in trades.

POKéMON of higher levels will be unruly in battle, however.

It also lets you use the move CUT outside of battle.
texts.CeruleanCity_House1_Text_SpeedStatFly:
The SPEED stat of all your POKéMON increases a little bit.

It also lets you use the move FLY outside of battle.
texts.CeruleanCity_House1_Text_ObeyLv50Strengt:
POKéMON up to Lv. 50 will obey you.

That includes even outsiders you obtain in trades.

POKéMON of higher levels will be unruly in battle, however.

It also lets you use the move STRENGTH outside of battle.
texts.CeruleanCity_House1_Text_DefenseStatSurf:
The DEFENSE stat of all your POKéMON increases a little bit.

It also lets you use the move SURF outside of battle.
texts.CeruleanCity_House1_Text_ObeyLv70RockSma:
POKéMON up to Lv. 70 will obey you.

That includes even outsiders you obtain in trades.

POKéMON of higher levels will be unruly in battle, however.

It also lets you use the move ROCK SMASH outside of battle.
texts.CeruleanCity_House1_Text_SpStatsWaterfal:
The SP. ATK and SP. DEF stats of all your POKéMON rise a little bit.

It also lets you use the move WATERFALL outside of battle.
texts.CeruleanCity_House2_Text_RocketsStoleTMF:
Those miserable ROCKETS!

Look what they've done to my house!

They stole a TM for teaching POKéMON how to DIG holes!

I was going to use it on a MANKEY or a SANDSHREW…

That cost me a bundle, it did!
texts.CeruleanCity_House2_Text_TeachDiglettDig:
I figure what's lost is lost.

I decided to teach DIGLETT how to DIG without a TM.
texts.CeruleanCity_House2_Text_TeamRocketTryin: TEAM ROCKET must be trying to DIG their way into no good!
texts.CeruleanCity_House2_Text_TeamRocketLeftW: TEAM ROCKET left a way out!
texts.CeruleanCity_House3_Text_PleaseTradeWith:
My husband likes trading POKéMON.

You're collecting POKéMON for your POKéDEX, aren't you?

Would you please trade with him?
texts.CeruleanCity_House4_Text_NothingEntertai:
Sigh… Too much time, too little to do…

Is nothing entertaining happening anywhere?
texts.CeruleanCity_House4_Text_NewNewsInformat:
Ah! A new news report!

Hmm…

I see! That was quite informative!

I applaud you for taking interest in the news at your young age.

As my thanks for sharing the news with me, I want you to have this.
texts.CeruleanCity_House4_Text_IncredibleNewsH:
Oh, oh! Th-this news report!

Hmm…

Amazing! What an incredible piece of news!

I haven't seen a news story this incredible in too long a time!

Thanks for sharing this fantastic news. Have a bunch of BERRIES!
texts.CeruleanCity_House4_Text_WishCouldShareN:
It seems such a shame to not share this news with other folks…

I wish I could tell someone… Let others know the news…
texts.CeruleanCity_House4_Text_ThanksForSpread:
Ah, you've spread the news for me?

Good news becomes worthwhile when all sorts of people share it.

As my thanks for your spreading the news, take this!
texts.CeruleanCity_House4_Text_MagnificentNews:
You've spread the news some more? Magnificent!

That piece of news must be delighted to be passed around so.

Yes, indeed!

Consider this a show of appreciation from me and the news.

I'll give you more BERRIES than I usually do.
texts.CeruleanCity_House4_Text_EnjoyingMyselfW:
I'm quite enjoying myself with all sorts of news.

Yes, I am satisfied! I won't be bored for a while.
texts.CeruleanCity_House4_Text_YourBerryPouchI: Hm? Your BERRY POUCH is full. My gift remains ungiven, then.
texts.CeruleanCity_House1_Text_AnyInterestInBe:
I concoct a variety of medicine from BERRY POWDER.

Using good BERRY POWDER, I can make any kind of medicine.

Now tell me, have you any interest in BERRIES?
texts.CeruleanCity_House1_Text_HaveJustTheThin: Ah, good! For you, then, I have just the thing.
texts.CeruleanCity_House1_Text_GoCrushBerriesA:
There's something new on the second floor of POKéMON CENTERS, at the DIRECT CORNER.

They installed a Wireless Adapter machine for crushing BERRIES.

This is where you come in.

I have a favor to ask, one that I can entrust only to you.

Could you make BERRY POWDER for me using that machine?

Don't forget, the machine is at the DIRECT CORNER of POKéMON CENTERS.

I'll concoct medicine for you if you bring me some BERRY POWDER.

Don't forget, crush BERRIES into BERRY POWDER and bring it to me.
texts.CeruleanCity_House1_Text_WhyMustYouLieNo:
Why must you lie to me?

How many BERRIES do you have? Not a one!
texts.CeruleanCity_House1_Text_TakeInterestInA:
You have no interest in BERRIES?

Young one, it's important to take an interest in all sorts of things.
texts.CeruleanCity_House1_Text_HaveYouBroughtB: Er-hem! Have you brought me some BERRY POWDER?
texts.CeruleanCity_House5_Text_ExchangeWithWha: With what would you like to  exchange it?
texts.CeruleanCity_House1_Text_YoullExchangeBe: Fine, you'll exchange your BERRY POWDER for one {STR_VAR_1}?
texts.CeruleanCity_House1_Text_DontHaveEnoughB: Hm? You don't have enough BERRY POWDER.
texts.CeruleanCity_House1_Text_TradeMoreBerryP:
This is fine BERRY POWDER indeed. It will make excellent medicine.

Would you like to trade more BERRY POWDER for something else?
texts.CeruleanCity_House1_Text_HopeToSeeYouAga: That's fine, then. I'll hope to see you back again.
texts.CeruleanCity_House1_Text_SeeMeIfYoudLike: Come see me if you'd like to trade your BERRY POWDER.
texts.CeruleanCity_Mart_Text_RepelWorksOnWeakM:
REPEL not only keeps bugs away, it also works on weak POKéMON.

Put your strongest POKéMON at the left of the POKéMON LIST.

If your first POKéMON is strong, REPEL's effect is boosted.
texts.CeruleanCity_Mart_Text_DoYouKnowAboutRar:
Do you know about RARE CANDY? They don't sell it in shops.

I think it makes POKéMON grow very quickly all of a sudden.
texts.CeruleanCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_BillD:
That BILL!

I heard that he'll do whatever it takes to get rare POKéMON.

He's not above doing all sorts of things, I've heard.
texts.CeruleanCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Every:
Have you heard about BILL?

Everyone calls him a POKéMANIAC!

I think people are just jealous of BILL, though.

Who wouldn't want to boast about their POKéMON?
texts.CeruleanCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_BillC: BILL has lots of POKéMON! He collects rare ones, too!
texts.CeruleanCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_TryTr:
Why don't you go upstairs and try trading POKéMON with your friends?

You could get a lot more variety by trading.

The POKéMON you get in trades grow quickly, too.
texts.CinnabarIsland_Text_BlaineLivedHereSince:
CINNABAR GYM's BLAINE is quite the odd fellow.

He's lived on the island since way before the LAB was built.
texts.CinnabarIsland_Text_ScientistsExperiment:
Scientists conduct experiments  in the burned-out building.

You know, the one they call the POKéMON MANSION.
texts.CinnabarIsland_Text_IslandSign: CINNABAR ISLAND The Fiery Town of Burning Desire
texts.CinnabarIsland_Text_GymSign: CINNABAR ISLAND POKéMON GYM LEADER: BLAINE The Hotheaded Quiz Master!
texts.CinnabarIsland_Text_ComeWithMeToOneIslan:
Look, it's me, BILL. Long time no see!

I hope you're still using my PC system.

Well, listen, since we met up here, how about spending time with me?

There's this little island in the far south called ONE ISLAND.

A friend invited me, so I'm on my way out there.

How about it? Do you feel like coming with me?
texts.CinnabarIsland_Text_IllBeWaitingInPokeCe:
What, are you too busy?

Well, all right. The boat hasn't arrived yet anyway.

I'll be waiting at the POKéMON CENTER over there.

Come see me when you're done with your business here.
texts.CinnabarIsland_Text_MyPalsBoatArrived:
Looks like my pal's boat arrived, too.

He sent it specially here to CINNABAR to pick me up.
texts.CinnabarIsland_Text_IfYouHaveTriPassYouC:
Hey, wasn't that a long cruise?

My buddy CELIO seemed to enjoy your company.

I'm sure he'd welcome you if you were to visit him again.

If you have a TRI-PASS, you can always take a ferry there from VERMILION PORT.

All right, thanks for your company!
texts.CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_BlaineIntro:
Hah!

I am BLAINE, the red-hot LEADER of CINNABAR GYM!

My fiery POKéMON are all rough and ready with intense heat!

They incinerate all challengers!

Hah! You better have BURN HEAL!{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}
texts.CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_BlaineDefeat:
I have burned down to nothing! Not even ashes remain!

You have earned the VOLCANOBADGE.
texts.CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_FireBlastIsUltim:
FIRE BLAST is the ultimate fire technique.

Don't waste it on WATER POKéMON.
texts.CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_ExplainVolcanoBa:
Hah!

The VOLCANOBADGE heightens the SPECIAL stats of your POKéMON.

Here, you can have this, too!
texts.CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_BlainePostBattle:
TM38 contains FIRE BLAST. Teach it to FIRE-type POKéMON.

VULPIX or CHARMELEON would be ideal for that move.
texts.CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_ErikIntro: Do you know how hot POKéMON fire breath can get?
texts.CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_ErikPostBattle:
Fire, or to be more precise, combustion…

…Oxygen in the air… Blah, blah, blah, blah…
texts.CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_QuinnIntro: I was a thief, but I went straight as a TRAINER.
texts.CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_QuinnPostBattle: I get this uncontrollable urge to steal other people's POKéMON.
texts.CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_AveryIntro: I've studied POKéMON thoroughly. You can't win!
texts.CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_AveryPostBattle: My theories are too complicated for you to understand.
texts.CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_RamonIntro: I like using FIRE-type POKéMON. I just do.
texts.CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_RamonPostBattle: I wish there were a thief POKéMON. I'd use that!
texts.CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_DerekIntro: I know why BLAINE became a TRAINER.
texts.CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_DerekPostBattle:
Our LEADER, BLAINE, became lost in the mountains but good.

Night fell when a fiery bird POKéMON appeared.

Its light allowed BLAINE to find his way down safely.
texts.CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_DustyIntro: I've been to many GYMS, but this one best suits my style.
texts.CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_DustyPostBattle: PONYTA, NINETALES… Those are popular FIRE POKéMON.
texts.CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_ZacPostBattle:
Water beats fire, of course.

But fire melts ice, so the FIRE type beats ICE-type POKéMON.
texts.CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_GymGuyAdvice:
Yo! Champ in the making!

The hotheaded BLAINE is a FIRE POKéMON pro.

Douse his spirits with water!

You'd better take some BURN HEALS, too.
texts.CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_GymStatue:
CINNABAR POKéMON GYM LEADER: BLAINE

WINNING TRAINERS: {RIVAL}
texts.CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_GymStatuePlayerW:
CINNABAR POKéMON GYM LEADER: BLAINE

WINNING TRAINERS: {RIVAL}, {PLAYER}
texts.CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_PokemonQuizRules:
POKéMON Quiz!

Get it right, and the door opens to the next room.

Get it wrong, and face a TRAINER!

If you want to conserve your POKéMON for the GYM LEADER…

Then get it right! Here we go!
texts.CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_QuizQuestion2: There are nine certified POKéMON LEAGUE BADGES?
texts.CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_QuizQuestion4: Are electric moves effective against GROUND-type POKéMON?
texts.CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_QuizQuestion5: POKéMON of the same kind and level are not identical?
texts.CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_CorrectGoOnThrou:
You're absolutely correct!

Go on through!
texts.CinnabarIsland_Mart_Text_DontTheyHaveXAt:
Don't they have X ATTACK?

I like it because it raises the ATTACK stat in battle.
texts.CinnabarIsland_Mart_Text_ExtraItemsNever: It never hurts to have extra items. You never know what might happen.
texts.CinnabarIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Cin:
I came to visit the CINNABAR GYM, but the door is locked tight.

There should be a key for it somewhere.

Could it be in that burned-out mansion?

The GYM LEADER's friend used to live there, they say.
texts.CinnabarIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Vis:
Do you have lots of friends?

Linking up with the usual friends is fun, of course.

But how about visiting the UNION ROOM every so often?

Who knows, you may end up making new friends.

I think it would be worth your time to check the UNION ROOM.
texts.CinnabarIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Evo:
POKéMON can still learn techniques after canceling evolution.

Evolution can wait until new moves have been learned.
texts.CinnabarIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Rea: BILL: Hey, you kept me waiting! Ready to set sail to ONE ISLAND?
texts.CinnabarIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_OhN: Oh, you're still not done yet?
texts.CinnabarIsland_Gym_Text_PhotoOfBlaineAnd:
It's a photo of BLAINE and MR. FUJI.

They're standing shoulder to shoulder with big grins.
texts.CinnabarIsland_PokemonLab_Entrance_Text_:
We study POKéMON extensively every day.

People often bring us rare POKéMON for examination.
A photo of the LAB's founder… DR. FUJI?!
texts.Text_MetronomeTeach:
Tch-tch-tch! I'll teach you a nifty move.

Teach it to a POKéMON, and watch the fun unfold!

It's a move called METRONOME. Does it strike your fancy?
texts.Text_MetronomeDeclined: I tell you, it's a lot of fun!
texts.Text_MetronomeWhichMon: Okay! Which POKéMON should I teach?
texts.Text_MetronomeTaught:
Tch-tch-tch! That's the sound of a METRONOME.

It tweaks your POKéMON's brain into using moves it doesn't even know.
texts.CinnabarIsland_PokemonLab_ExperimentRoom:
Hiya!

I am important doctor. Yes, very much so, indeed.

Here, I study rare POKéMON fossils. All the time, I study.

You! Have you a fossil for me?

ちょっと　じかん　かかるよ！

そこらへんを　すこし ブラブラ　してくると　よろしー！

You late. Where were you?

Your fossil is back to life! It was {STR_VAR_1} like I think!
ポケモン　いっぱいで　もてないね！

Oh! That is {STR_VAR_2}, it is!

It is fossil of {STR_VAR_1}, a POKéMON that is already extinct!

My Resurrection Machine will make that POKéMON live again!

So! You hurry and give me that!

{FONT_NORMAL}{PLAYER} handed over the {STR_VAR_2} to the weird doctor.
I take a little time! You go for walk a little while!
texts.CinnabarIsland_PokemonLab_Lounge_Text_Fo:
I found this most remarkable fossil inside MT. MOON.

I think it's of a rare, prehistoric POKéMON.
texts.CinnabarIsland_PokemonLab_ResearchRoom_T: EEVEE can evolve into one of three kinds of POKéMON.

There's an e-mail message.

… … …

There are three legendary bird POKéMON.

They are ARTICUNO, ZAPDOS, and MOLTRES.

Their whereabouts are unknown.

We plan to explore the cavern close to CERULEAN.

From: POKéMON RESEARCH TEAM…
texts.DiglettsCave_NorthEntrance_RockTunnelPit:
I went inside ROCK TUNNEL, but it's pitch-black and scary in there.

If I could get a POKéMON to use FLASH and light it up…
texts.DiglettsCave_SouthEntrance_Text_DiglettD:
Well, isn't this a surprise! DIGLETT dug this long tunnel!

It goes right to VIRIDIAN CITY, they tell me.
texts.FiveIsland_Text_IslandSign: FIVE ISLAND Chrono Island: Where Time Goes
texts.FiveIsland_Text_WeirdBuildingInMeadow:
Oh, this stinks. I wanted to play in the MEADOW.

But they put up a weird building on it, so I can't play there.
texts.FiveIsland_Text_BeenGettingBusierAroundH:
It's been getting busier around these parts lately.

I haven't been catching many good fish lately, either.
texts.FiveIsland_House1_JPText_HusbandWentOffF:
こんばんの　おかずは ようい　しなくて　いいぞ！

って　だんなが つりに　いったん　だけど‥ しんじて　いいのかねえ
texts.FiveIsland_House1_Text_HusbandWentOffFis:
Don't worry about buying anything for dinner tonight!

…That's what my husband said when he went off fishing today.

I'm not sure if I can count on him to live up to that promise.
texts.FiveIsland_House2_Text_MeadowBelongedToF:
That MEADOW has belonged to our family for generations.

I should have had a giant mansion built on it.

It would be preferable to having those thugs run wild on it!
texts.FiveIsland_LostCave_Room1_Text_LawsonInt:
Aiyeeeeeh!

I thought this was an ancient ruin. But it's teeming with ghosts!
texts.FiveIsland_LostCave_Room1_Text_LawsonPos:
I'm trying to get out of here, but I always end up at the same spot.

Maybe the number of boulders is a hint…
texts.FiveIsland_LostCave_Room10_Text_SelphyIn: W-what do you intend to do with me?
texts.FiveIsland_LostCave_Room10_Text_SelphyDe: Oh… I was afraid that you meant to harm me.
texts.FiveIsland_LostCave_Room10_Text_MayIAskY:
I am so glad that you happened here.

I grew rather bored of walking, and I am feeling fatigued.

May I ask you to take me home from here?
texts.FiveIsland_LostCave_Room4_Text_LauraIntr: I think there is a mysterious power at work in this cave.
texts.FiveIsland_LostCave_Room4_Text_LauraDefe: If you don't go into the right tunnel, you won't get ahead.
texts.FiveIsland_LostCave_Room4_Text_LauraPost: Earlier, a lady went into the caves ahead.
texts.FiveIsland_Meadow_Text_DoorNeedsTwoPassw: とびらを　あけるには パスワードが　2つ　いるようだ
texts.FiveIsland_Meadow_Text_EnteredPasswordAn:
{PLAYER} entered a password.

“GOLDEEN need log.”

… …  … …  … …

Another password is needed to open the door…
texts.FiveIsland_Meadow_Text_EnteredPasswordDo:
{PLAYER} entered two passwords.

“GOLDEEN need log.” “Yes, nah, CHANSEY.”

… …  … …  … …

The WAREHOUSE's door opened!
texts.FiveIsland_Meadow_Text_WarehouseDoorAlre: The WAREHOUSE's door is already open.
texts.FiveIsland_Meadow_Text_Rocket1Intro: This area's strictly off-limits! Out, out!
texts.FiveIsland_Meadow_Text_Rocket1PostBattle: You don't have any business here! Go home!
texts.FiveIsland_Meadow_Text_Rocket2Intro:
There's nothing past here except our WAREHOUSE.

So what brings you here?
texts.FiveIsland_Meadow_Text_Rocket2PostBattle:
You're wanting to know what's inside this WAREHOUSE?

It's better you didn't know. For your own sake, I mean.
texts.FiveIsland_Meadow_Text_Rocket3Intro: You'd be wasting time even if you were to get by me.
texts.FiveIsland_Meadow_Text_Rocket3PostBattle: You won't be able to get in without the passwords anyway.
texts.FiveIsland_MemorialPillar_Text_MiloIntro:
I'm the eldest of the BIRD BROTHERS.

The best thing about birds… It has to be the beak.
texts.FiveIsland_MemorialPillar_Text_MiloPostB: You can fly to FOUR ISLAND from here.
texts.FiveIsland_MemorialPillar_Text_ChazIntro:
I'm the middle kid of the BIRD BROTHERS.

The best thing about birds… It has to be the wings.
texts.FiveIsland_MemorialPillar_Text_ChazPostB: There was a really somber guy over that way.
texts.FiveIsland_MemorialPillar_Text_HaroldInt:
I'm the youngest of the BIRD BROTHERS.

The best thing about birds… It has to be the down.
texts.FiveIsland_MemorialPillar_Text_HaroldDef: Down is so comfy… It makes me drowsy…
texts.FiveIsland_MemorialPillar_Text_HaroldPos: It fills me with happiness when bird POKéMON beg playfully…
texts.FiveIsland_MemorialPillar_Text_ThisIsWhe: This is where I buried my ONIX… It was named TECTONIX…
texts.FiveIsland_MemorialPillar_Text_HereLiesT:
“Here lies TECTONIX” is engraved on a boulder.

There is a LEMONADE placed as an offering in front of the grave.
texts.FiveIsland_MemorialPillar_Text_LeaveAnot: Would you like to leave another LEMONADE as an offering?
texts.FiveIsland_MemorialPillar_Text_PlacedCan: {PLAYER} placed a can of LEMONADE in front of the grave.
texts.FiveIsland_MemorialPillar_Text_ThankYouP:
Th-thank you…

That was my TECTONIX's favorite drink…

I don't even know you, but your act of kindness…

It's uplifted me a little.

Can you please take this as my thanks?
texts.FiveIsland_MemorialPillar_Text_BeGoodToY: Please be good to your POKéMON, too.
texts.FiveIsland_MemorialPillar_Text_DontHaveR: If you don't have room for it, I'll hold it for you till next time.
texts.FiveIsland_MemorialPillar_Text_StillHave:
Oh, it's you from that time…

I still have that thing I wanted you to have as my thanks.
texts.FiveIsland_MemorialPillar_Text_HereLiesT:
Boulders and rocks are neatly piled up as a cairn.

“Here lies TECTONIX” is engraved on a boulder.
texts.FiveIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_OnMyWay: I'm on my way to prepare a meal for a certain high-society person.
texts.FiveIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_YoureOn:
You're on a quest to catch every single kind of POKéMON?

…How incredible. Please tell me if you catch a strong one!
texts.FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_DaisyIntr: With these hands, I will create my victory!
texts.FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_DaisyDefe: The shame of this… I'm red-faced…
texts.FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_DaisyPost: Uh-oh, my paint tubes have scattered everywhere!
texts.FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_CelinaInt: Excuse me! I'm trying to paint. Please keep out of my sight!
texts.FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_CelinaDef: This loss… I feel like I'm whiting out…
texts.FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_CelinaPos: GILLIAN? Please tilt your head slightly… There! That's the look I want!
texts.FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_RaynaIntr: Hmm… The angle, it is not quite there…
texts.FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_RaynaDefe: Oh… My feelings, they are blue…
texts.FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_RaynaPost:
The sky and the sea… They are so fickle.

Their changing expressions make them difficult to capture.
texts.FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_JackiIntr: I am visiting my friend's retreat, if you must know.
texts.FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_JackiPost: I find it pleasurable to leisurely battle in the gentle sea breeze.
texts.FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_GillianIn: I'm thinking of having a pool made specially for POKéMON.
texts.FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_GillianPo: A pool would be nice, but I must say, a sun-room may be sublime.
texts.FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_DestinInt: I'm a good runner. I'm really fast!
texts.FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_DestinPos: When I run with the wind, it feels like I could fly!
texts.FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_TobyIntro: I say, this marine life here at this resort agrees with me.
texts.FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_TobyDefea: That's a shocker! You must be joking.
texts.FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_TobyPostB: Getting so serious over this… How nonsensical.
texts.FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_SelphyTha:
SELPHY: Thank you.

You may go now.
texts.FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_House_Text_Ple:
SELPHY: Oh? Do I know you from somewhere?

Oh, but that doesn't matter.

I am exquisitely bored. Please, hear my wish.
texts.FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_House_Text_Wis:
I wish to see a POKéMON. A darling {STR_VAR_1}.

I want to see one right away. Please, make my wish come true.
texts.FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_House_Text_OhI:
SELPHY: Oh, I'm tired of this. I'm tired of waiting for you.

I'll forgive you this time, but please don't fail me next time.
texts.FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_House_Text_Mon:
SELPHY: Oh, hello, there.

Oh, my gracious. That must be the {STR_VAR_1} you caught for me.

Giggle… I see a resemblance to you.

Thank you so kindly.

… …  … …  … … Is something the matter?

You may leave.

… …  … …  … … Oh, fine. I understand now.

SEBASTIAN! I need you here this instant!
texts.FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_House_Text_Sel: SELPHY: See to it that this person is given a token of appreciation.
texts.FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_House_Text_But: Butler: I shall do as you bid, my lady.

Butler: I sincerely thank you for pleasing Lady SELPHY.

Please accept this as her thanks…
Butler: Your BAG appears to be unfortunately full.
texts.FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_House_Text_Sel: SELPHY: I wish you the best of luck.
texts.FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_House_Text_Lad:
Butler: The smile of Lady SELPHY has the brilliance of the sun.

Please, I beg you to bring joy to Lady SELPHY.
texts.FiveIsland_RocketWarehouse_Text_ManyMons: There are many POKéMON locked away in the pen…
texts.FiveIsland_RocketWarehouse_Text_PenUnloc: The pen door is unlocked. The POKéMON appear to have fled.
texts.FiveIsland_RocketWarehouse_Text_Grunt2In: Did you come here knowing it's TEAM ROCKET's WAREHOUSE?
texts.FiveIsland_RocketWarehouse_Text_Grunt2De: What do you think you're doing?!
texts.FiveIsland_RocketWarehouse_Text_Grunt2Po: TEAM ROCKET broke up? What planet are you from?
texts.FiveIsland_RocketWarehouse_Text_Grunt1In:
Oh, now your POKéMON look strong. You're willing to sell them?

Oh? You wanted to battle?
texts.FiveIsland_RocketWarehouse_Text_Grunt1Po: We can give you a great price. Sell us your POKéMON!
texts.FiveIsland_RocketWarehouse_Text_Grunt3In:
I got word about you from the others.

But there's no way a kid like you'd know our BOSS GIOVANNI!
texts.FiveIsland_RocketWarehouse_Text_Grunt3Po: Don't mess in the doings of adults, you jumped-up pip-squeak!
texts.FiveIsland_RocketWarehouse_Text_Admin1In:
I don't know or care if what I'm doing is right or wrong…

I just put my faith in GIOVANNI and do as I am told.
texts.FiveIsland_RocketWarehouse_Text_Admin1Po:
You're doing things according to your beliefs and morals.

I understand now…
texts.FiveIsland_RocketWarehouse_Text_MadeItSo:
I've made it so you can come back in through there.

Why don't you go get rested and refreshed for what lies ahead?

The ADMIN after me outranks me thoroughly as a TRAINER.

You'd better steel yourself for one harsh challenge.
texts.FiveIsland_RocketWarehouse_Text_Admin2In:
That's quite enough of you  playing the hero, kid.

Spreading lies about how TEAM ROCKET has disbanded…

It's such an obvious attempt to cause confusion in our ranks.

Fortunately, we're not so ignorant to fall for the lies of a child!

And now, I'll show you how scary an angry adult can be!
texts.FiveIsland_RocketWarehouse_Text_Admin2De:
Urgh… You were too strong…

… Th-that's GIOVANNI's BADGE!

So it's true? TEAM ROCKET really has disbanded?
texts.FiveIsland_RocketWarehouse_Text_Admin2Po:
We will abandon this WAREHOUSE…

But don't think this is over. I won't let this be the end.

I will find GIOVANNI. And I will resurrect TEAM ROCKET! I will…

Until then, farewell!
texts.FiveIsland_RocketWarehouse_Text_ReportWi:
A report with graphs and text is on the PC monitor.

“The Influence of Magnetic Waves on POKéMON Evolution”…

… … … … … …

It's too difficult to understand…
texts.FiveIsland_RocketWarehouse_Text_GideonIn:
I almost managed to sell the SAPPHIRE for huge money…

Then, you just had to come along and blow the whole deal apart!

Fufu… Fufufufu… There's no forgiveness for you!
texts.FiveIsland_RocketWarehouse_Text_GideonPo: If I can't sell it, it's worthless! Go ahead, take it!
texts.FiveIsland_RocketWarehouse_Text_GetLostL: What do you want now? Go on, get lost, leave me be.
texts.FiveIsland_RocketWarehouse_Text_Giovanni:
What, you again?

You… You're not GIOVANNI's kid, are you?

No, that can't be right! GIOVANNI's kid has red hair.

You don't have any reasons for bugging me. Leave me alone!
texts.FiveIsland_WaterLabyrinth_Text_LetMeTake:
You travel all over the place, don't you?

You're not driving your POKéMON too harshly, are you?

Let me take a look. … … …   … … …
texts.FiveIsland_WaterLabyrinth_Text_HmmISeeIs: Ah, hmm… I see, I see…
texts.FiveIsland_WaterLabyrinth_Text_TreatMonR:
Oh, impressive. You treat your POKéMON right.

I think you can be entrusted with this.

Please, I'd like you to have this.
texts.FiveIsland_WaterLabyrinth_Text_ReceivedE: {PLAYER} received an EGG from the man!
texts.FiveIsland_WaterLabyrinth_Text_DontHaveS:
…Unfortunately, you don't have space for this in your party.

You'd better come back for it another time.
texts.FiveIsland_WaterLabyrinth_Text_YouveCome: やあ タマゴを　もらいに きて　くれたんだね
texts.FiveIsland_WaterLabyrinth_Text_GladIMetS:
I received that EGG while I was traveling.

I'm glad I met someone like you.
texts.FiveIsland_WaterLabyrinth_Text_CuteMonRe:
Oh, hello. That's a cute {STR_VAR_2}.

Seeing it reminds me of a sweet  little girl I met while traveling.

She was gently grooming POKéMON… She was a little angel.

That little girl's name… I think it was DAISY.
texts.FiveIsland_WaterLabyrinth_Text_AlizeIntr: This is an excellent environment for raising POKéMON.
texts.FiveIsland_WaterLabyrinth_Text_AlizeDefe: Your POKéMON are growing up admirably well!
texts.FiveIsland_WaterLabyrinth_Text_AlizePost: You know, I think you have the talent to be a good BREEDER.
texts.FourIsland_Text_IslandSign: FOUR ISLAND The Warm, Blue, Floe Island
texts.FourIsland_Text_LoreleiHasReturned:
LORELEI has returned.

Did she find the city life too stressful, I wonder?
texts.FourIsland_Text_LoreleiMetLaprasAsChild:
LORELEI has gone back.

The LAPRAS she has, I imagine it to be the one she met as a child.

I believe it was in ICEFALL CAVE that she caught it.

Perhaps that POKéMON has been with her ever since.
texts.FourIsland_Text_RivalAlreadyGotEggBeSmel:
{RIVAL}: Hey! {PLAYER}!

What are you doing here in the SEVII ISLANDS?

You should quit copying me, you know?

Anyways, I already got my POKéMON EGG, so I'm done with this island.

Heh, I bet you don't even know about POKéMON EGGS.

You'll never fill your NATIONAL POKéDEX that way.

By the way, I saw someone we both know on this island.

Why don't you go look around if it makes you curious?

Me, I don't have the time to waste.

Be smelling ya!
texts.FourIsland_Text_LoreleiHasLotsOfStuffedD:
Oh, you found me! Please don't tell LORELEI.

Did you know that LORELEI has lots and lots of stuffed dolls?

Every time she comes back to FOUR ISLAND, her collection grows!
texts.FourIsland_Text_MadeSlushieUsingIcefallC:
Ooh, chilly!

I made a slushie using ice I shaved inside ICEFALL CAVE.

It's chilly and tasty!
texts.JPText_BodySlamTeach:
そーれ　ぼよーん！ どっちが　さきに　へたばるか？ のしかかり　しょうぶ　してるんだ

きみは　なかまに　はいったら つぶれそうだな‥ かわりに　きみの　ポケモンに のしかかり　おしえて　やろっか？
texts.JPText_BodySlamDeclined: また　おいで　ぼよーん！
texts.JPText_BodySlamWhichMon: どの　ポケモンに おしえたい　かい？
texts.FourIsland_IcefallCave_Back_Text_Lorelei:
LORELEI: Keep your filthy hands off the POKéMON in the cave!

Do as I say, or you'll have me to answer to!
texts.FourIsland_IcefallCave_Back_Text_ShutItL:
Aww, shut it, lady, and leave us be.

Don't let your glasses get all steamed up!
texts.FourIsland_IcefallCave_Back_Text_Lorelei:
LORELEI: {PLAYER}?! What are you doing here?

No, we can catch up later. Right now, I need your help.

Help me kick these poachers out before they do anything else.

They've been catching POKéMON here, then selling them off!

Are you ready? You take that one, please!
texts.FourIsland_IcefallCave_Back_Text_GruntIn:
W-what?!

Who says we can't do what we want with the POKéMON we catch?
texts.FourIsland_IcefallCave_Back_Text_Lorelei:
LORELEI: Humph. So despicably weak.

You! Tell me!

Where have you taken the captured POKéMON?

I'm smashing your ring once and for all!
texts.FourIsland_IcefallCave_Back_Text_NotTell: N-no way! I'm not telling you that!
texts.FourIsland_IcefallCave_Back_Text_Lorelei:
LORELEI: If you won't confess, we'll deep-freeze you.

My LAPRAS is furious for what you've done to its friends.

Go, LAPRAS! ICE BEAM…
texts.FourIsland_IcefallCave_Back_Text_OkayRoc:
Wawaah! Okay! I'll talk!

The POKéMON are in the ROCKET WAREHOUSE on FIVE ISLAND.

There! I said it! We'll be going now!

…But I doubt you'll ever make it into the ROCKET WAREHOUSE!

Heheheheh!
texts.FourIsland_IcefallCave_Back_Text_ThankYo:
{PLAYER}, thank you. But this is awful…

I was born and raised here on these islands.

I had no idea that those horrible criminals were loose here…
texts.FourIsland_LoreleisHouse_Text_IfAnything:
LORELEI: There's something weighing heavily on my mind.

If anything were to happen on the island where I was born…

I wouldn't know about it if I were in the POKéMON LEAGUE.

I wonder if that would make me irresponsible to my home…
texts.FourIsland_LoreleisHouse_Text_IllReturnT:
LORELEI: So, you managed to solve all the problems here?

That's wonderful.

That means there isn't any reason for me to be here all the time.

Thank you…

I'll return to the POKéMON LEAGUE in a short while.
texts.FourIsland_LoreleisHouse_Text_WillDoWhat:
I don't know what will happen in the future, but…

I will do what I can here and now. That's all I can do.
texts.FourIsland_Mart_Text_LoreleiGrewUpOnThis:
We've had a great and powerful TRAINER grow up on this island.

I bet even you'd know her. It's LORELEI of the ELITE FOUR!

When LORELEI was just a tyke, I taught her about POKéMON.
texts.FourIsland_Mart_Text_IcefallCaveIsFrigid:
The SEVII ISLANDS are in a warm region overall.

But there is one exception you need to know about.

The ICEFALL CAVE is frigid because of the POKéMON that live in it.
texts.Text_BodySlamTeach:
Ready? Boing!

We're having a BODY SLAM match to see who wimps out first.

If you were to join us, you'd be squashed like a bug, though…

How about I teach BODY SLAM to a POKéMON of yours instead?
texts.Text_BodySlamWhichMon: Which POKéMON wants to learn how to BODY SLAM?
texts.FourIsland_House1_Text_FatMan: それ　ぼよーん！ おまえ　おもいなあー！
texts.FourIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_RareIce:
There's a rare kind of ICE POKéMON that lives in the cave.

We get a lot of visitors hoping to see that POKéMON.
texts.FourIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_DayCare:
Oh? A POKéMON EGG? …I have no idea.

…Oh, wait. The DAY-CARE people in town were saying something.

They said that they'd found EGGS before on their property.
texts.FourIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_NewPoke:
What's this?

The new POKéMON JOURNAL hasn't arrived on this island?
texts.FuchsiaCity_Text_DidYouTrySafariGame:
Did you try the SAFARI GAME?

There are some rare POKéMON that can only be caught there.
texts.FuchsiaCity_Text_SafariZoneZooInFront:
The SAFARI ZONE has a zoo in front of the entrance.

Out back is the SAFARI GAME for catching POKéMON.
texts.FuchsiaCity_Text_WheresSara: ERIK: Where's SARA? I said I'd meet her here.
texts.FuchsiaCity_Text_ItemBallInThere:
That item ball in there… Were you wanting that?

Me, too! …Huh? That's a POKéMON?
texts.FuchsiaCity_Text_CitySign: FUCHSIA CITY Behold! It's Passion Pink!
texts.FuchsiaCity_Text_SafariZoneOfficeSign: POKéMON PARADISE! Welcome to the SAFARI ZONE! SAFARI ZONE OFFICE
texts.FuchsiaCity_Text_GymSign: FUCHSIA CITY POKéMON GYM LEADER: KOGA The Poisonous Ninja Master
texts.FuchsiaCity_Text_ChanseySign: Name: CHANSEY Catching one is all up to chance.
texts.FuchsiaCity_Text_VoltorbSign: Name: VOLTORB The very image of a POKé BALL.
texts.FuchsiaCity_Text_KangaskhanSign:
Name: KANGASKHAN

A maternal POKéMON that raises its young in a pouch on its belly.
texts.FuchsiaCity_Text_SlowpokeSign: Name: SLOWPOKE Friendly and very slow moving.
texts.FuchsiaCity_Text_LaprasSign: Name: LAPRAS AKA the king of the seas.
texts.FuchsiaCity_Text_OmanyteSign: Name: OMANYTE An extremely rare POKéMON that was regenerated from a fossil.
texts.FuchsiaCity_Text_KabutoSign: Name: KABUTO An extremely rare POKéMON that was regenerated from a fossil.
texts.Text_SubstituteTeach:
Aww, I wish I was a KANGASKHAN baby.

I'd love to be a substitute for the baby…

And snuggle in the mother KANGASKHAN's belly pouch.

But only POKéMON can use the technique SUBSTITUTE…

Want me to teach SUBSTITUTE to one of your POKéMON?
texts.Text_SubstituteDeclined: Oh, really? SUBSTITUTE seems so fun…
texts.Text_SubstituteWhichMon: Which POKéMON wants to learn SUBSTITUTE?
texts.Text_SubstituteTaught: Boy, what I'd give to crawl inside a KANGASKHAN belly pouch…
texts.FuchsiaCity_Text_MyFatherIsGymLeader:
My father is the GYM LEADER of this town.

I'm training to use POISON POKéMON as well as my father.
texts.FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_KogaIntro:
KOGA: Fwahahaha!

A mere child like you dares to challenge me?

The very idea makes me shiver with mirth!

Very well, I shall show you true terror as a ninja master.

Poison brings steady doom. Sleep renders foes helpless.

Despair to the creeping horror of POISON-type POKéMON!{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}
texts.FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_KogaDefeat:
Humph! You have proven your worth!

Here! Take the SOULBADGE!
texts.FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_KogaPostBattle:
When afflicted by TOXIC, a POKéMON suffers more and more.

It suffers worsening damage as the battle wears on!

It will surely terrorize foes!
texts.FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_KogaExplainSoulBadg:
Now that you have the SOULBADGE, the DEFENSE of your POKéMON rises.

It also lets you SURF outside of battle.

Ah! Take this, too!
texts.FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_KogaExplainTM06:
Sealed within that TM06 lies TOXIC!

It is a secret technique dating back some four hundred years.
texts.FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_KaydenIntro:
Strength isn't the key for POKéMON. Do you understand this?

POKéMON is about strategy!

I'll show you how strategy can beat brute strength.
texts.FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_KaydenPostBattle:
So, you mix brawn with brains? Good strategy!

That's remarkable for a child TRAINER.
texts.FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_KirkIntro:
I was a magician once upon a time.

But I dreamt of becoming a ninja, so I joined this GYM.
texts.FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_KirkPostBattle: Even though I've lost, I will keep training according to the teachings of KOGA, my ninja master.
texts.FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_NateIntro: Let's see you beat my special techniques!
texts.FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_NatePostBattle: I like poison and sleep techniques, as they linger after battle!
texts.FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_PhilIntro:
Stop right there!

The famed invisible walls of FUCHSIA GYM have you frustrated?
texts.FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_PhilPostBattle:
You impressed me! Here's a hint!

Look very closely for gaps in the invisible walls!
texts.FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_EdgarIntro:
I also study the way of the ninja with Master KOGA!

Ninja have a long history of using animals!
texts.FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_EdgarPostBattle: I still have much to learn.
texts.FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_ShawnIntro:
Master KOGA comes from a long line of ninjas.

What did you descend from?
texts.FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_ShawnDefeat: You're more skilled than I'd thought!
texts.FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_ShawnPostBattle:
Where there is light, there is shadow!

Light and shadow! Which do you choose?
texts.FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_GymGuyAdvice:
Yo! Champ in the making!

FUCHSIA GYM is a tricked-up place. It's riddled with invisible walls!

KOGA might appear close, but he's blocked off.

You have to find gaps in the walls to reach him.
texts.FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_GymGuyPostVictory: It's amazing how ninja can terrify, even now!
texts.FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_GymStatue:
FUCHSIA POKéMON GYM LEADER: KOGA

WINNING TRAINERS: {RIVAL}
texts.FuchsiaCity_Gym_Text_GymStatuePlayerWon:
FUCHSIA POKéMON GYM LEADER: KOGA

WINNING TRAINERS: {RIVAL}, {PLAYER}
texts.FuchsiaCity_House1_Text_WardenIsOldHasFa:
The SAFARI ZONE's WARDEN is old,  but he's still very much active.

All his teeth are false, though.
texts.FuchsiaCity_House1_Text_BillIsMyGrandson:
Hmm? You've met BILL?

He's my grandson!

He always liked collecting things, even as a child!
texts.FuchsiaCity_House1_Text_BillFilesHisOwnM:
BILL files his own POKéMON data on his PC.

Did he show you?
texts.FuchsiaCity_House2_Text_DoYouLikeToFish:
I'm the FISHING GURU's older brother.

I simply looove fishing! I can't bear to go without.

Tell me, do you like to fish?
texts.FuchsiaCity_House2_Text_LikeYourStyleTak:
Grand! I like your style. I think we can be friends.

Take this and fish, young friend!
texts.FuchsiaCity_House2_Text_ReceivedGoodRod: {PLAYER} received a GOOD ROD from the FISHING GURU's brother.
texts.FuchsiaCity_House2_Text_GoodRodCanCatchB:
Fishing is a way of life! It is like the finest poetry.

A crummy OLD ROD could only catch MAGIKARP, yes?

But with a GOOD ROD, you can catch much better POKéMON.
texts.FuchsiaCity_House2_Text_HowAreTheFishBit:
Hello there, {PLAYER}!

How are the fish biting?
texts.FuchsiaCity_House2_Text_YouHaveNoRoomFor:
Oh, no!

I had a gift for you, but you have no room for it!
texts.FuchsiaCity_House3_Text_WouldYouLikeToFo:
Uh… Oh, yes, I'm the MOVE DELETER.

I can make POKéMON forget their moves.

Would you like me to do that?
texts.FuchsiaCity_House3_Text_WhichMonShouldFo: Which POKéMON should forget a move?
texts.FuchsiaCity_House3_Text_MonOnlyKnowsOneM: {STR_VAR_1} seems to know only one move…
texts.FuchsiaCity_House3_Text_MonsMoveShouldBe: Hm! {STR_VAR_1}'s {STR_VAR_2}? That move should be forgotten?
texts.FuchsiaCity_House3_Text_MonHasForgottenM:
It worked to perfection!

{STR_VAR_1} has forgotten {STR_VAR_2} completely.
texts.FuchsiaCity_House3_Text_ComeAgainToForge: Come again if there are other moves to be forgotten.
texts.FuchsiaCity_House3_Text_NoEggShouldKnowM: What? No EGG should know any moves.
texts.FuchsiaCity_Mart_Text_DontTheyHaveSafari:
Don't they have any pennants promoting the SAFARI ZONE?

How about some paper lanterns? Aren't there even any calendars?
texts.FuchsiaCity_Mart_Text_DidYouTryXSpeed: Did you try X SPEED? It speeds up a POKéMON in battle.
texts.FuchsiaCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_CantBe:
You can't become a good TRAINER with just one strong POKéMON.

But raising many POKéMON evenly is no easy task, either.
texts.FuchsiaCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Pokemo:
There's a narrow trail west of VIRIDIAN CITY.

It goes to the POKéMON LEAGUE HQ. The HQ governs all TRAINERS.
texts.FuchsiaCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_VisitS:
If you're working on a POKéDEX, visit the SAFARI ZONE.

All sorts of rare POKéMON breed there.
texts.FuchsiaCity_SafariZone_Entrance_Text_Pla:
For just ¥500, you can play the SAFARI GAME.

You can roam the wide-open safari and catch what you like.

Would you like to play?
texts.FuchsiaCity_SafariZone_Entrance_Text_Tha:
That'll be ¥500, please!

We only use a special kind of  POKé BALLS here.
texts.FuchsiaCity_SafariZone_Entrance_Text_Pla: {PLAYER} received 30 SAFARI BALLS from the attendant.
texts.FuchsiaCity_SafariZone_Entrance_Text_Cal:
We'll call you on the PA when you run out of time or SAFARI BALLS.

Well, I'll wish you the best of luck!
texts.FuchsiaCity_SafariZone_Entrance_Text_Goi: Are you going to leave the SAFARI ZONE early?
texts.FuchsiaCity_SafariZone_Entrance_Text_Ple: Please return any SAFARI BALLS you may have left.
texts.FuchsiaCity_SafariZone_Entrance_Text_Cat: Did you catch your fair share? Come again!
texts.FuchsiaCity_SafariZone_Entrance_Text_Fir: Hi! Is it your first time here at the SAFARI ZONE?
texts.FuchsiaCity_SafariZone_Entrance_Text_Exp:
The SAFARI ZONE actually has four zones in it.

Each zone has different kinds of POKéMON, even some rare ones.

Use the supplied SAFARI BALLS to catch them.

You can also throw BAIT or ROCKS besides the SAFARI BALLS.

If you throw BAIT, the POKéMON becomes less likely to flee, but harder to catch.

If you throw ROCKS, the POKéMON becomes more likely to flee, but easier to catch.

When you run out of time or SAFARI BALLS, it's game over for you!
texts.FuchsiaCity_SafariZone_Office_Text_Nickn:
We nicknamed the WARDEN “SLOWPOKE.”

You know, he has that vacant look like a SLOWPOKE.
texts.FuchsiaCity_SafariZone_Office_Text_Warde:
WARDEN SLOWPOKE is very knowledgeable about POKéMON.

He even has some fossils of rare, extinct POKéMON.
texts.FuchsiaCity_SafariZone_Office_Text_Could:
WARDEN SLOWPOKE came in, but I couldn't understand him.

I think he's got a speech problem!
texts.FuchsiaCity_SafariZone_Office_Text_Prize:
WARDEN SLOWPOKE is running a promotion campaign right now.

Try to get to the farthest corner of the SAFARI ZONE.

If you can make it, you'll win a very convenient prize.
texts.FuchsiaCity_WardensHouse_Text_HifFuffHef:
WARDEN: Hif fuff hefifoo!

Ha lof ha feef ee hafahi ho. Heff hee fwee!
texts.FuchsiaCity_WardensHouse_Text_AhHowheeHo: Ah howhee ho hoo! Eef ee hafahi ho!
texts.FuchsiaCity_WardensHouse_Text_HeOhayHeHa: Ha? He ohay heh ha hoo ee haheh!
texts.FuchsiaCity_WardensHouse_Text_GaveGoldTe: {PLAYER} gave the GOLD TEETH to the WARDEN.
texts.FuchsiaCity_WardensHouse_Text_WardenPopp: The WARDEN popped in his teeth!
texts.FuchsiaCity_WardensHouse_Text_ThanksSonG:
WARDEN: Thanks, son! You're a real lifesaver!

No one could understand a word that I said, not a one!

I was too ashamed to show my face around the OFFICE, even.

Let me give you something for your trouble.
texts.FuchsiaCity_WardensHouse_Text_ThanksLass:
WARDEN: Thank you, lassie! You're a real lifesaver!

No one could understand a word that I said, not a one!

I was too ashamed to show my face around the OFFICE, even.

Let me give you something for your trouble.
texts.FuchsiaCity_WardensHouse_Text_ExplainStr:
WARDEN: Inside HM04 you'll find STRENGTH.

It lets POKéMON move boulders when you're outside of battle.

Oh yes, did you find the SECRET HOUSE in the SAFARI ZONE?
texts.FuchsiaCity_WardensHouse_Text_YouHaveToo: なんや　にもつ いっぱいやんけ！
texts.FuchsiaCity_WardensHouse_Text_MonPhotosF: POKéMON photos and fossils are on display.
texts.FuchsiaCity_WardensHouse_Text_OldMonMerc: Old POKéMON merchandise is on display.
texts.IndigoPlateau_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_GymG:
Yo! Champ in the making!

At the POKéMON LEAGUE, you will face the ELITE FOUR all in a row.

If you lose, you have to start all over again!

This is it! Go for it!
texts.IndigoPlateau_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Face:
From here on, you face the ELITE FOUR one by one.

If you win, a door opens to the next TRAINER. Good luck!
texts.IndigoPlateau_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Lore:
I am so sorry, but you've wasted your time coming here.

LORELEI of the ELITE FOUR is absent, you see.

As a result, the POKéMON LEAGUE is closed for the time being.
texts.IndigoPlateau_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Agat:
AGATHA's GHOST-type POKéMON are horrifically terrifying in toughness.

I took my FIGHTING-type POKéMON and raised them to the max.

I went at AGATHA feeling pretty confident, but she whupped us.

That old lady's also got a really short fuse, too.

It doesn't take anything to get that scary lady hollering.
texts.IndigoPlateau_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Lanc:
Maybe becoming an ELITE FOUR member is in the blood.

From what I've heard, LANCE has a cousin who's a GYM LEADER somewhere far away.
texts.LavenderTown_Text_JustImaginingWhiteHand:
Hahaha, I guess not.

That white hand on your shoulder… I'm just imagining it.
texts.LavenderTown_Text_TownKnownAsMonGraveSit:
This town is known as the grave site of POKéMON.

Memorial services are held in POKéMON TOWER.
texts.LavenderTown_Text_GhostsAppearedInTower:
Ghosts appeared in POKéMON TOWER.

I think they're the spirits of POKéMON that the ROCKETS killed.
texts.LavenderTown_Text_TownSign: LAVENDER TOWN The Noble Purple Town
texts.LavenderTown_Text_SilphScopeNotice:
New SILPH SCOPE! Make the Invisible Plain to See!

SILPH CO.
texts.LavenderTown_Text_PokemonTowerSign: POKéMON TOWER Becalm the Spirits of POKéMON
texts.LavenderTown_House1_Text_RocketsKilledCu:
Those horrible ROCKETS! They deserve no mercy!

That poor CUBONE's mother…

It was killed trying to escape from TEAM ROCKET.
texts.LavenderTown_House1_Text_GhostOfPokemonT:
The ghost of POKéMON TOWER is gone!

Someone must have soothed its restless spirit!
texts.LavenderTown_House2_Text_WantMeToRateNic:
Hello, hello! I am the official NAME RATER!

Want me to rate the nicknames of your POKéMON?
texts.LavenderTown_House2_Text_CritiqueWhichMo: Which POKéMON's nickname should I critique?
texts.LavenderTown_House2_Text_GiveItANicerNam:
{STR_VAR_1}, is it? That is a decent nickname!

But, would you like me to give it a nicer name?

How about it?
texts.LavenderTown_House2_Text_WhatShallNewNic: Ah, good. Then, what shall the new nickname be?
texts.LavenderTown_House2_Text_FromNowOnShallB:
Done! From now on, this POKéMON shall be known as {STR_VAR_1}!

It is a better name than before! How fortunate for you!
texts.LavenderTown_House2_Text_ISeeComeVisitAg: I see. Do come visit again.
texts.LavenderTown_House2_Text_FromNowOnShallB:
Done! From now on, this POKéMON shall be known as {STR_VAR_1}!

It looks no different from before, and yet, this is vastly superior!

How fortunate for you!
texts.LavenderTown_House2_Text_TrulyImpeccable:
{STR_VAR_1}, is it? That is a truly impeccable name!

Take good care of {STR_VAR_1}!
texts.LavenderTown_House2_Text_ThatIsMerelyAnE: Now, now. That is merely an EGG!
texts.LavenderTown_Mart_Text_SearchingForStatR:
I'm searching for items that raise the stats of POKéMON.

They're effective over the course of a single battle.

X ATTACK, X DEFEND, X SPEED,  and X SPECIAL are what I'm after.

Do you know where I can get them?
texts.LavenderTown_Mart_Text_DidYouBuyRevives: Did you buy some REVIVES? They revive any fainted POKéMON!
texts.LavenderTown_Mart_Text_TrainerDuosCanCha:
Sometimes, a TRAINER duo will challenge you with two POKéMON at the same time.

If that happens, you have to send out two POKéMON to battle, too.
texts.LavenderTown_Mart_Text_SoldNuggetFromMou:
この　あいだ　やまおくで きんのたまを　ひろい　ましてね！

つかえない　しなもの　ですが うったら　なんと　5000¥でした
texts.LavenderTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Rocke:
TEAM ROCKET will do anything for the sake of money!

There is no job too dirty, no deed too heinous, no crime too wicked!
texts.LavenderTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Cubon:
I saw CUBONE's mother trying to escape from TEAM ROCKET.

She was killed trying to get away…
texts.LavenderTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Peopl:
You know how the CUBONE species wears skulls, right?

People will pay a lot for one.
texts.LavenderTown_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_HearM:
I recently moved to this town.

I hear that MR. FUJI's not from these parts originally, either.
texts.LavenderTown_VolunteerPokemonHouse_Text_: That's odd, MR. FUJI isn't here. Where'd he go?
MR. FUJI had been praying alone for CUBONE's mother.

This is really MR. FUJI's house.

He's really kind.

He looks after abandoned and orphaned POKéMON.
It's so warm! POKéMON are so nice to hug.

MR. FUJI: {PLAYER}…

Your POKéDEX quest is one that requires strong dedication.

Without deep love for POKéMON, your quest may fail.

I'm not sure if this will help you, but I'd like you to have it.
{PLAYER} received a POKé FLUTE from MR. FUJI.

Upon hearing the POKé FLUTE, sleeping POKéMON will spring awake.

Try using it on POKéMON that are sleeping obstacles.
You must make room for this!
MR. FUJI: Has my POKé FLUTE helped you?

POKéMON FAN MAGAZINE Monthly Grand Prize Drawing!

The application form is…

Gone! It's been clipped out. Someone must have applied already.

POKéMON magazines line the shelf.

POKéMON INSIDER…

POKéMON FAN…
texts.Text_ExplosionTeach:
Can you imagine? If this volcano were to erupt?

The explosion would be the end of us. How terrifying is that?

While we're terrified, would you like me to teach EXPLOSION?
texts.Text_ExplosionDeclined: Yeah, you're right. It is too terrifying.
texts.Text_ExplosionWhichMon:
You're terribly brave!

Which POKéMON should I teach EXPLOSION?
texts.Text_ExplosionTaught:
Using EXPLOSION while on this volcano…

What a terrifying thrill!
texts.Text_ExplosionTeachJP:
こ　この　かざんが もし　だいばくはつ　したら お　おれら　ひとたまりも ないなあ　‥ブルブル！

こ　こわい　ついでに だいばくはつ　でも　おぼえてみる？
texts.Text_ExplosionDeclinedJP: や　やっぱ　こわいもんな ブルブル
texts.Text_ExplosionWhichMonJP: つ　つよきだね！ じゃあ　どの　ポケモンに　する？
texts.Text_ExplosionTaughtJP: かざんで　だいばくはつを‥ す　すごい　スリル！
texts.MtEmber_Exterior_Text_WellTryDiggingHere:
Over here. We'll try digging here.

That treasure the ADMINS've been talking about should be here.
texts.MtEmber_Exterior_Text_YoureInTheWayGetLo: What the…? You're in the way. Get lost.
texts.MtEmber_Exterior_Text_PunchedThroughAtLa: Whew, punched through at last. Let's go treasure hunting!
texts.MtEmber_Exterior_Text_WhatsPasswordAgain:
Any treasure we find, we haul back to the WAREHOUSE, understood?

…Oh, and what're the passwords? At the ROCKET WAREHOUSE, I mean.
texts.MtEmber_Exterior_Text_FirstPasswordGolde:
What, you forgot the password? There're actually two.

The first one's “GOLDEEN need log.”

And the second one is…
texts.MtEmber_Exterior_Text_SnoopsBeenListenin: Hey! This snoop's been listening in!
texts.MtEmber_Exterior_Text_Grunt1Intro: You've been eavesdropping on us, haven't you?
texts.MtEmber_Exterior_Text_Grunt2Intro: Trying to horn in on our treasure? Don't bet on it!
texts.MtEmber_Exterior_Text_Grunt2PostBattle: Develop amnesia conveniently and forget everything you heard!
texts.MtEmber_Exterior_Text_WellRegroupDontSte:
What a setback… We'll have to regroup.

You! Don't even think about taking a step inside here!

If you know what's good for you, don't even think about this!
texts.MtEmber_Exterior_Text_LoganIntro: An active volcano is one that's erupting, or about to.
texts.MtEmber_Exterior_Text_LoganDefeat: Whew… That was hot! Sweat's erupting from me!
texts.MtEmber_Exterior_Text_LoganPostBattle:
They say there're over 1,500 active volcanoes in the world.

Just thinking about them makes me feel all hot and gooey inside!
texts.MtEmber_Exterior_Text_BethIntro: Do you know how caves form inside volcanoes?
texts.MtEmber_Exterior_Text_BethPostBattle: When lava at the surface of magma hardens, and the magma inside flows out, caverns are left behind.
texts.MtEmber_Exterior_Text_JocelynIntro:
I've been in training so I can mend my broken heart…

It toughened me up physically at least! Hi-yah!
texts.MtEmber_Exterior_Text_JocelynDefeat: I think I tried to overdo it…
texts.MtEmber_Exterior_Text_JocelynPostBattle: The way you battle, it reminds me of the guy who dumped me…
texts.MtMoon_1F_Text_MarcosIntro: WHOA! You shocked me! …Oh, you're just a kid!
texts.MtMoon_1F_Text_MarcosPostBattle: Kids like you shouldn't be wandering around here in the dark.
texts.MtMoon_1F_Text_JoshIntro: Did you come to explore the cave, too?
texts.MtMoon_1F_Text_JoshPostBattle: I came all the way down here to show off to girls.
texts.MtMoon_1F_Text_MiriamIntro: Wow! It's way bigger in here than I thought!
texts.MtMoon_1F_Text_MiriamPostBattle: How do you get out of here? It's so big, I may get lost.
texts.MtMoon_1F_Text_JovanIntro: What! Don't sneak up on me!
texts.MtMoon_1F_Text_JovanPostBattle: I have to find stronger POKéMON. Where might they be?
texts.MtMoon_1F_Text_IrisIntro: What? I'm waiting for my friends to find me here.
texts.MtMoon_1F_Text_IrisPostBattle: I came because I heard there are some very rare fossils here.
texts.MtMoon_1F_Text_KentIntro: Suspicious men are in the cave. What about you?
texts.MtMoon_1F_Text_KentPostBattle: I saw them! I'm sure they're from TEAM ROCKET!
texts.MtMoon_1F_Text_RobbyIntro: You need to go through this cave to get to CERULEAN CITY.
texts.MtMoon_1F_Text_RobbyPostBattle: ZUBAT is tough! But if you can catch one, you'll be able to count on it.
texts.MtMoon_1F_Text_BrockHelpsExcavateFossils:
Hi, I'm excavating for fossils here under MT. MOON.

Sometimes, BROCK of PEWTER GYM lends me a hand.
texts.MtMoon_B2F_Text_MiguelIntro:
Hey, stop!

I found these fossils! They're both mine!
texts.MtMoon_B2F_Text_WellEachTakeAFossil: We'll each take a fossil! No being greedy!
texts.MtMoon_B2F_Text_ThenThisFossilIsMine: All right. Then this fossil is mine!
texts.MtMoon_B2F_Text_LabOnCinnabarRegenerates:
Far away, on CINNABAR ISLAND, there's a POKéMON LAB.

They do research on regenerating fossils.
texts.MtMoon_B2F_Text_Grunt1Intro:
We, TEAM ROCKET, shall find the fossils!

Reviving POKéMON from them will earn us huge riches!
texts.MtMoon_B2F_Text_Grunt1PostBattle: You made me mad! TEAM ROCKET will blacklist you!
texts.MtMoon_B2F_Text_Grunt2Intro: We, TEAM ROCKET, are POKéMON gangsters! We strike fear with our strength!
texts.MtMoon_B2F_Text_Grunt2PostBattle: Darn it all! My associates won't stand for this!
texts.MtMoon_B2F_Text_Grunt3Intro: We're pulling a big job here! Get lost, kid!
texts.MtMoon_B2F_Text_Grunt3PostBattle: If you find a fossil, give it to me and scram!
texts.MtMoon_B2F_Text_Grunt4Intro:
Little kids shouldn't be messing around with grown-ups!

It could be bad news!
texts.MtMoon_B2F_Text_Grunt4PostBattle: POKéMON lived here long before people came.
texts.MtMoon_B2F_Text_YouWantDomeFossil: Do you want the DOME FOSSIL?
texts.MtMoon_B2F_Text_YouWantHelixFossil: Do you want the HELIX FOSSIL?
texts.OneIsland_Text_BillLetsGoSeeCelio:
BILL: Here we are! This is ONE ISLAND.

There are several islands around here, and this is one of them.

My friend CELIO sent the boat to fetch me here.

He's in charge of the island's PC network by his lonesome.

…Why am I telling you this now? Let's just go see CELIO!
