texts.Text_WhereDoYouWantToSail: Ahoy, there! Where do you want to sail?
texts.OneIsland_Text_LuckyToHaveCelioHere:
Here we are on an island smack in the middle of nowhere.

We're lucky to have an upstanding young man like CELIO here.

My granddaughter was in a tizzy over CELIO's friend.

Something about a famous POKéMANIAC?

I'm not sure what that means, but CELIO is quite the man!
texts.OneIsland_Text_HavePCLinkageWithKanto:
My granddaughter was in a tizzy over a new breakthrough.

She said we now have PC linkage with people in KANTO.

I'm not sure what that means, but CELIO is quite the man!
texts.OneIsland_Text_HavePCLinkageWithHoenn:
My granddaughter was in a tizzy over a new breakthrough.

She said we finally have PC linkage with people in HOENN.

I'm not sure what that means, but CELIO is quite the man.

He would make a fine husband for my granddaughter!
texts.OneIsland_Text_IslandSign: ONE ISLAND Friends Gather at Knot Island
texts.OneIsland_Text_PokemonNetCenterSign: Expanding the POKéMON World! POKéMON NET CENTER
texts.OneIsland_Text_ReturnToCinnabar: グレンタウンに　もどりますか？
texts.OneIsland_Text_IsntWarmClimateHereGreat: Hi, sight-seeing, are you? Isn't the warm climate here great?
texts.OneIsland_House1_Text_GazeUponVolcanoOnS:
On sunny days, I step out and gaze upon the volcano.

That's my daily routine.
texts.OneIsland_House1_Text_LastTimeMtEmberEru: Let me think… When was the last time MT. EMBER erupted?
texts.OneIsland_House2_Text_IWantToStayHereFor:
Young people all want to go off to big cities.

But I want to stay here forever!
texts.OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_MariaIntro: The weather's gorgeous! Perfect for a battle!
texts.OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_MariaPostBattl: Please don't splash my face! You'll ruin the makeup.
texts.OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_AbigailIntro: I'm beginning to get a sunburn…
texts.OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_AbigailPostBat: I like that cap you have. Maybe I should wear one, too…
texts.OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_FinnIntro: Seen from here, MT. EMBER towers into the sky.
texts.OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_FinnPostBattle: The sky is immense around these parts.
texts.OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_GarrettIntro: I took a break from swimming, only to have you challenge me?
texts.OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_GarrettDefeat: Hey, what the… You're good, you!
texts.OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_GarrettPostBat: Instead of using SURF all the time, you should swim some.
texts.OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_TommyIntro: Wait! Wait a second! I think I've hooked a big one!
texts.OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_TommyPostBattl: Not only did I lose, the big one got away from me, too!
texts.OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_SharonIntro: Could you help me out with my training?
texts.OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_SharonDefeat: You were a cut above me.
texts.OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_SharonPostBatt: It's clear that you're skilled. I like you!
texts.OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_TanyaIntro: There isn't a day in which we don't train!
texts.OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_TanyaPostBattl: I'll train even harder from now on!
texts.OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_SheaIntro: Every morning, before breakfast, I swim around this island.
texts.OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_SheaPostBattle: I lost because I'm pooped from all the running I did…
texts.OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_HughIntro: Dress appropriately for battle! Lose that frivolous outfit!
texts.OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_HughPostBattle: Even martial artists are becoming fashion conscious these days…
texts.OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_BryceIntro: You know, everything tastes great when you're out in the wild.
texts.OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_BrycePostBattl: The water in volcanic regions is delicious.
texts.OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_ClaireIntro: My lunch filled us up, so will you battle us for some exercise?
texts.OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_ClairePostBatt: What should I do? I feel famished again.
texts.OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_KiaIntro: KIA: My big brother and I make an awesome combination!
texts.OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_KiaDefeat: KIA: Huh?! I can't believe it!
texts.OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_KiaPostBattle: KIA: How could there be anyone better than my big brother?
texts.OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_KiaNotEnoughMo: KIA: If you want to battle with us, you have to bring at least two POKéMON with you.
texts.OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_MikIntro: MIK: Together with KIA, I'm afraid of nothing!
texts.OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_MikPostBattle: MIK: How could my combination with KIA fail?
texts.OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_MikNotEnoughMo:
MIK: Hey, do you want to battle with us two?

Bring two or more POKéMON with you, then.
texts.OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_RouteSign:
This is KINDLE ROAD.

Go straight for MT. EMBER.
texts.OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_EmberSpaSign: Light the Fire in Your Heart! EMBER SPA
texts.OneIsland_KindleRoad_EmberSpa_Text_Water:
Hm! Haaaaaaaaaaah!

Aaaah! This is heavenly! The water warms me to my core!

You should jump in, too.

Go to the middle, relax, and get good and warm!
texts.OneIsland_KindleRoad_EmberSpa_Text_Enjoy:
My favorite part of bathing comes up right after this.

I enjoy a bowl of chowder to warm me from the inside, too!
texts.OneIsland_KindleRoad_EmberSpa_Text_Water:
The water is perfectly warm. It feels exquisite…

{PLAYER} and the POKéMON were fully refreshed!
texts.OneIsland_KindleRoad_EmberSpa_Text_HotSp: Soaking in a hot spring pool is therapeutic, people say.
texts.OneIsland_KindleRoad_EmberSpa_Text_SeeHo:
Have a look at my face. See how smooth my skin is?

The hot spring's water keeps my skin younger than my age.
texts.OneIsland_KindleRoad_EmberSpa_Text_Bruno:
After an honest day of training, nothing beats a relaxing soak in the hot spring pool.

BRUNO, who's a senior ahead of me, visits the SPA on occasion.

He comes to rehab injuries, both his own and his POKéMON's.
texts.OneIsland_KindleRoad_EmberSpa_Text_UsedT:
Hot springs go hand-in-hand with volcanoes.

The EMBER SPA here, well, I made it years ago.

I hewed the pool right out of a gigantic boulder by hand.

I was using this at the time. I suppose I can part with it.
texts.OneIsland_KindleRoad_EmberSpa_Text_Expla: That shatters boulders as if they were made of crackers.
texts.OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_CelioCan: CELIO: BILL! I can't believe you came out here.
texts.OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_BillHows:
BILL: Well, absolutely! How's your research coming along?

…Oh, wait a sec.
texts.OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_ThisIsMy: {PLAYER}, this is my buddy CELIO. He's one dedicated PC MANIAC!
texts.OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_PlayerIs: CELIO, this is {PLAYER}, a rising contender as the POKéMON CHAMP!
CELIO, this is {PLAYER}, the reigning POKéMON CHAMP!
texts.OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_CelioTha:
CELIO: That's really impressive.

I hate to say it, but I have zero aptitude for battling.

Anyways, I'm glad to meet you.
texts.OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_BillBrin: BILL: So, bring me up to speed. How's your machine running?
texts.OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_CelioPCs:
CELIO: It's running fine, but we're too remote out here.

The PCs on this island just can't link with your PC, BILL.
texts.OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_BillLetM:
BILL: Oh, yeah? Okay, let me take a look-see.

…Hang on here… I think we can make it work. Let me help you, okay?
texts.OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_CanYouDe:
{PLAYER}, can I get you to wait for me just a bit?

…Actually, can I get you to do me a favor?

The island next to this one's called TWO ISLAND.

There's a guy there that runs a GAME CORNER.

He has this thing for rare rocks and gems.

We keep in touch, being fellow maniacs.

So, can I get you to deliver this METEORITE to him?
texts.OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_CelioPle: CELIO: {PLAYER}, if you are going to TWO ISLAND, please take this.
texts.OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_PassLets:
It's a PASS for the ferry service serving the local islands.

It will let you travel between the ISLANDS ONE, TWO, and THREE.

Oh, you should have this, too.
texts.OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Received: {PLAYER} received an extra page for the TOWN MAP!
texts.OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_BillCatc: BILL: I'll catch you later! Say hi to the guy for me!
texts.OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_HmmHowAb:
Hmm…

How about we try this like this…
texts.OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_GotPCWor:
Oh, hey, {PLAYER}!

Did you see? We got the PC working!

I've got a few things to show CELIO here.

Can you go out on a stroll or something for a while more?
texts.OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_SorryFor:
I'm sorry for taking up so much of BILL's time.

I'm also sorry for being such a  poor host on your visit here.
texts.OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_UsualPCS: The usual PC services aren't available…
texts.OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_BillWeGo:
BILL: What kept you so long? Been out having a good time?

We got it done. The PCs are up and running!
texts.OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_CelioJob:
CELIO: The job went incredibly quick.

BILL is one amazing guy…
texts.OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_BillYouv:
BILL: No, no! There was almost nothing left for me to do.

CELIO, I have to hand it to you. You've learned a lot.
texts.OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_BillWeSh:
BILL: Well, there you have it. I'm finished with the job. We should head back to KANTO.

CELIO, I'll be seeing you again.
texts.OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_CelioPro:
CELIO: {PLAYER}, I'm really sorry that we sent you off alone today.

I promise, I will show you around these islands sometime.
texts.OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_CelioImM:
CELIO: Hello! You look awfully busy as always.

How am I doing?

Well, I'm modifying my Network Machine.

When I get done with the machine, I hope you'll be first to use it, {PLAYER}.
texts.OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_CelioCau:
CELIO: {PLAYER}, how have things been for you?

Oh, is that right? You've caught more POKéMON.

Do you know what? Maybe I can be useful to you.
texts.OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_YoullBeT:
I'm modifying the Network Machine right now.

I'm changing it so it can handle trades over long distances.

When I get finished, you'll be trading for exotic POKéMON from TRAINERS far away.
texts.OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_NeedsSpe:
But, there is a slight catch.

For the link to work, the Machine needs a special gemstone.

It's supposed to be on ONE ISLAND, but I haven't found one yet.

Who knows where it could be.
texts.OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_TryingTo:
I was trying to find the gem even while I was studying.

As a result, I've made no headway in both my search and studies…

If I relied on BILL, I'm sure my research would progress.

But this time, I want to try to do things by myself.
texts.OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_MayIAskO:
Thank you! {PLAYER}, you're simply amazing.

… … …  … … …

Um… May I ask one more giant favor of you?
texts.OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_PleaseIN: It… It's not anything weird. Please, I need your help.
texts.OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_AnotherG:
While I was studying gemstones, I discovered something important.

There is another gem that forms a pair with this RUBY.

That other gemstone is supposed to be in the SEVII ISLANDS.

{PLAYER}, please, I need you to go find the other gem.

{PLAYER}, may I have your ferry PASS and the TOWN MAP?
texts.OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Returned: {PLAYER} returned the TRI-PASS and received the RAINBOW PASS.
texts.OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Obtained: Obtained an extra page for the TOWN MAP!
texts.OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_PassLetY:
This is my own ferry PASS.

It will let you get to all the SEVII ISLANDS.

{PLAYER}, please, I can't do it without your help.
texts.OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_ThankYou:
CELIO: So this is the gem that forms a pair with the RUBY…

{PLAYER}, you've gone through a lot to get this, didn't you?

You don't have to tell me. I know it wasn't easy.

Thank you so much!

Now it's my turn to work for you! Please give me a little time.
texts.OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_LinkedUp: I did it! I linked up with LANETTE!
texts.OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_ManagedT:
{PLAYER}… {PLAYER}, I did it!

I've managed to link up with TRAINERS in the HOENN region!

Finally, the Network Machine is fully operational!

{PLAYER}, I owe it all to you!

Thanks to you, my dream came true…
texts.OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_WishYouB:
I… I'm not crying.

That's enough about me!

{PLAYER}, you're going to keep looking for exotic POKéMON, right?

I wish you the best of luck!
texts.OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_CelioHea:
CELIO: Hello!

{PLAYER}, I've been hearing rumors about you.
texts.OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_BillsFir:
{PLAYER}, what's your favorite kind of POKéMON?

BILL is a POKéMANIAC, so he loves every kind.

Apparently, the first one he caught was an ABRA.
texts.OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_BillsHom:
By the way, {PLAYER}, you're from PALLET TOWN, aren't you?

I've heard that it's a quiet and pleasant place.

BILL's hometown is GOLDENROD CITY, where his folks still live.

I've heard that it's quite the festive, bustling city.

I'd like to go there one day.
texts.OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_BillCant:
{PLAYER}, is there anything that you can't stand?

Apparently, BILL simply can't stomach milk at all.
texts.OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_CameFrom:
Oh, you're a stranger here! Hi! Where did you come from?

…PALLET TOWN? I don't know it!
texts.OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Enormous:
On this island, there's an enormous volcano.

It hasn't erupted lately, so why not enjoy a hike?
texts.OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_WishICou: I wish I could trade POKéMON with my boyfriend who lives far away…
texts.OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_TradedWi:
I traded POKéMON with my boyfriend far away!

Everyone's saying that we can thank you and CELIO.

So, thank you!
texts.OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_MachineU:
Network Machine Link Level 0

…POKéMON Storage System under adjustment…
texts.OneIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_MachineL:
Network Machine Link Level 1

Link established with the KANTO region.

Network Machine Link Level 2

Link established with the KANTO and HOENN regions.
texts.OneIsland_TreasureBeach_Text_AmaraIntro: Lying back, rocked by the waves… It's exquisite.
texts.OneIsland_TreasureBeach_Text_AmaraPostBa: The sea is pleasantly warm in these parts.
texts.OneIsland_TreasureBeach_Text_GoodThingsW:
Good things get washed up by the ocean current onto this beach.

That's why I often come here for some beachcombing.
texts.PalletTown_Text_OakDontGoOut: OAK: Hey! Wait! Don't go out!
texts.PalletTown_Text_OakGrassUnsafeNeedMon:
OAK: It's unsafe! Wild POKéMON live in tall grass!

You need your own POKéMON for your protection.

I know! Here, come with me!
texts.PalletTown_Text_RaisingMonsToo:
I'm raising POKéMON, too.

When they get strong, they can protect me.
texts.PalletTown_Text_CanStoreItemsAndMonsInPC:
Technology is incredible!

You can now store and recall items and POKéMON as data via PC.
texts.PalletTown_Text_TownSign: PALLET TOWN Shades of your journey await!
texts.PalletTown_Text_OakLetMeSeePokedex:
OAK: Ah, {PLAYER}! You're back, are you?

How much have you filled in your POKéDEX?

May I see it?

Let's see…
texts.PalletTown_Text_CaughtXPuttingInHonestEf:
You've caught {STR_VAR_2}…

Hm, it looks as if you're putting in an honest effort.

When you manage to fill it some more, come show me, please.
texts.PalletTown_Text_CaughtXImpressiveFollowM:
You've caught… {STR_VAR_2}!? Now, this is impressive!

There's something I wanted to ask of you, {PLAYER}.

Come. Follow me.
texts.PalletTown_Text_OakYouEnjoyingTraveling:
OAK: Ah, {PLAYER}! You seem to be enjoying traveling.

Knowing you, {PLAYER}, I can easily imagine you going out to even more exotic locales.

Good for you, good for you. Hohoho.
texts.PalletTown_PlayersHouse_1F_Text_AllBoysL:
MOM: …Right. All boys leave home someday. It said so on TV.

Oh, yes. PROF. OAK, next door, was looking for you.
texts.PalletTown_PlayersHouse_1F_Text_AllGirls:
MOM: …Right. All girls dream of traveling. It said so on TV.

Oh, yes. PROF. OAK, next door, was looking for you.
texts.PalletTown_PlayersHouse_1F_Text_YouShoul: MOM: {PLAYER}! You should take a quick rest.
texts.PalletTown_PlayersHouse_1F_Text_LookingG: MOM: Oh, good! You and your POKéMON are looking great. Take care now!
texts.PalletTown_PlayersHouse_1F_Text_MovieOnT:
There's a movie on TV. Four boys are walking on railroad tracks.

…I better go, too.

There's a movie on TV. A girl with her hair in pigtails is walking up a brick road.

…I better go, too.
texts.PalletTown_PlayersHouse_2F_Text_PlayedWi:
{PLAYER} played with the NES.

…Okay! It's time to go!
texts.PalletTown_PlayersHouse_2F_Text_PressLRF:
It's a posted notice…

If you're confused, ask for HELP! Press the L or R Button!
texts.PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_RivalGr: {RIVAL}: What, it's only {PLAYER}? Gramps isn't around.
texts.PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_RivalFe: {RIVAL}: Gramps! I'm fed up with waiting!
texts.PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_RivalNo: {RIVAL}: Hey! Gramps! No fair! What about me?
texts.PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_RivalGo:
{RIVAL}: Heh, I don't need to be greedy like you. I'm mature!

Go ahead and choose, {PLAYER}!
texts.PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_RivalMy: {RIVAL}: My POKéMON looks a lot tougher than yours.
texts.PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_RivalLe:
{RIVAL}: Wait, {PLAYER}! Let's check out our POKéMON!

Come on, I'll take you on!
texts.PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_RivalDe: WHAT? Unbelievable! I picked the wrong POKéMON!
texts.Text_RivalVictory: {RIVAL}: Yeah! Am I great or what?
texts.PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_RivalGo:
{RIVAL}: Okay! I'll make my POKéMON battle to toughen it up!

{PLAYER}! Gramps! Smell you later!
texts.PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_RivalWh: {RIVAL}: I almost forgot! What did you call me for?
texts.PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_RivalLe: {RIVAL}: All right, Gramps! Leave it all to me!
texts.PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_RivalTe:
{PLAYER}, I hate to say it, but you won't be necessary for this.

I know! I'll borrow a TOWN MAP from my sis!

I'll tell her not to lend you one, {PLAYER}! Hahaha!

Don't bother coming around to my place after this!
texts.PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_OakThre:
OAK: {RIVAL}? Let me think…

Oh, that's right, I told you to come! Just wait!

Here, {PLAYER}.

There are three POKéMON here.

Haha!

The POKéMON are held inside these POKé BALLS.

When I was young, I was a serious POKéMON TRAINER.

But now, in my old age, I have only these three left.

You can have one. Go on, choose!
texts.PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_OakBePa: OAK: Be patient, {RIVAL}. You can have one, too!
texts.PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_OakWhic:
OAK: Now, {PLAYER}.

Inside those three POKé BALLS are POKéMON.

Which one will you choose for yourself?
texts.PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_OakHeyD: OAK: Hey! Don't go away yet!
texts.PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_OakChoo:
Ah! CHARMANDER is your choice. You should raise it patiently.

So, {PLAYER}, you're claiming the FIRE POKéMON CHARMANDER?

Hm! SQUIRTLE is your choice. It's one worth raising.

So, {PLAYER}, you've decided on the WATER POKéMON SQUIRTLE?

I see! BULBASAUR is your choice. It's very easy to raise.

So, {PLAYER}, you want to go with the GRASS POKéMON BULBASAUR?
texts.PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_OakThis: This POKéMON is really quite energetic!
texts.PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_OakCanR:
OAK: If a wild POKéMON appears, your POKéMON can battle it.

With it at your side, you should be able to reach the next town.
texts.PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_OakBatt:
OAK: {PLAYER}, raise your young POKéMON by making it battle.

It has to battle for it to grow.
texts.PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_OakHave:
OAK: Oh, {PLAYER}! How is my old POKéMON?

Well, it seems to be growing more attached to you.

You must be talented as a POKéMON TRAINER.

What's that? You have something for me?
texts.PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_OakCust:
Ah!  It's the custom POKé BALL!

I had it on order. Thank you!
texts.PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_OakHave: OAK: Oh, right! I have a request for you two.
texts.PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_OakPoke:
On the desk there is my invention, the POKéDEX!

It automatically records data on POKéMON you've seen or caught.

It's a high-tech encyclopedia!
texts.PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_OakTake: OAK: {PLAYER} and {RIVAL}. Take these with you.
texts.PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_Receive: {PLAYER} received the POKéDEX from PROF. OAK.
texts.PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_OakCatc:
OAK: You can't get detailed data on POKéMON by just seeing them.

You must catch them to obtain complete data.

So, here are some tools for catching wild POKéMON.
texts.PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_OakExpl:
When a wild POKéMON appears, it's fair game.

Just throw a POKé BALL at it and try to catch it!

This won't always work, however.

A healthy POKéMON can escape. You have to be lucky!
texts.PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_OakComp:
To make a complete guide on all the POKéMON in the world…

That was my dream!

But, I'm too old. I can't get the job done.

So, I want you two to fulfill my dream for me.

Get moving, you two.

This is a great undertaking in POKéMON history!
texts.PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_OakMons: POKéMON around the world wait for you, {PLAYER}!
texts.PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_OakAdde:
Ah, {PLAYER}! How is your POKéDEX shaping up?

{RIVAL} has already caught some POKéMON and added to the data.

So, {PLAYER}, let's have a look at your POKéDEX.

…What's the matter? You've added no new data at all.

I'll give you these, so do try a little harder.
texts.PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_OakCome:
OAK: Come see me sometime.

After all, I want to know how your POKéDEX is coming along.
texts.PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_BlankEn: It's like an encyclopedia, but the pages are blank.
texts.PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_ThoseAr: Those are POKé BALLS. They contain POKéMON!
texts.PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_PressSt: Press START to open the MENU!
texts.PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_SaveOpt: The SAVE option is on the MENU. Use it regularly.
texts.PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_AllMonT: All POKéMON types have strong and weak points against others.
texts.PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_EmailMe:
There's an e-mail message here.

…

Finally! The ultimate TRAINERS of the POKéMON LEAGUE are ready to take on all comers!

Bring your best POKéMON and see how you rate as a TRAINER!

POKéMON LEAGUE HQ INDIGO PLATEAU

PROF. OAK, please visit us! …
texts.PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_StudyAs: I study POKéMON as PROF. OAK's AIDE.
texts.PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_DaisyWi:
Hi, {PLAYER}. I bet you've become good friends with your POKéMON.

By the way, did you know about DAISY?

If you show DAISY your POKéMON, she can tell how much it likes you.

Occasionally, she will even groom a POKéMON for you.

This is a secret, so please don't tell anyone.
texts.PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_OakIsGo:
PROF. OAK is going to have his own radio show soon.

The program will be called PROF. OAK's POKéMON SEMINAR.
texts.PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_OakIsAu:
PROF. OAK may not look like much, but he's the authority on POKéMON.

Many POKéMON TRAINERS hold him in high regard.
texts.PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_OakFavo:
Ah, now this is excellent!

{PLAYER}, I have another important favor to ask of you.

I need you to listen closely.
texts.PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_OakSigh:
Recently, there have been sightings of many rare POKéMON species.

I'm talking about POKéMON that have never been seen in KANTO.

I would love to go see things for myself, but I'm much too old.

Since I can't do it, {PLAYER}, I'd like you to go in my place.
texts.PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_RivalJu:
{RIVAL}: Hey, I heard that!

Gramps, what's with favoring {PLAYER} over me all the time?

I went and collected more POKéMON, and faster, too.

You should just let me handle everything.
texts.PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_OakNeed:
OAK: I know, I know. Of course I need your help, too.

Now, I need to see both your POKéDEXES.
texts.PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_OakTook: PROF. OAK took both POKéDEX units.
texts.PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_OakNowT:
… … …  … … …

… … …  … … …

…And that's done!

Now these units can record data on a lot more POKéMON.
texts.PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_OakMust:
Now, {PLAYER} and {RIVAL}!

This time, you really must work towards filling your POKéDEXES.

I urge you to make them the best and the most complete of all time!

Truly, this is a monumentally great undertaking in POKéMON history!
texts.PalletTown_ProfessorOaksLab_Text_RivalIl:
{RIVAL}: Gramps, calm down. Don't get so excited.

I'll get the POKéDEX completed, don't you worry about a thing.

I think I'll try looking around ONE ISLAND first…

Anyways, I'm outta here!
texts.PalletTown_RivalsHouse_Text_HiBrothersAt:
DAISY: Hi, {PLAYER}!

My brother, {RIVAL}, is out at Grandpa's LAB.
texts.PalletTown_RivalsHouse_Text_HeardYouBatt:
DAISY: {PLAYER}, I heard you had a battle against {RIVAL}.

I wish I'd seen that!
texts.PalletTown_RivalsHouse_Text_ErrandForGra:
Grandpa asked you to run an errand?

Gee, that's lazy of him. Here, this will help you.
texts.PalletTown_RivalsHouse_Text_ReceivedTown: {PLAYER} received a TOWN MAP from DAISY.
texts.PalletTown_RivalsHouse_Text_DontHaveSpac: You don't have space for this in your BAG.
texts.PalletTown_RivalsHouse_Text_ExplainTownM: You can use the TOWN MAP to find out where you are, or check the names of places.
texts.PalletTown_RivalsHouse_Text_PleaseGiveMo:
DAISY: Just like people, POKéMON are living things.

When they get tired, please give them a rest.
texts.PalletTown_RivalsHouse_Text_ItsBigMapOfK: It's a big map of the KANTO region. Now this would be useful!
texts.PalletTown_RivalsHouse_Text_ShelvesCramm: The shelves are crammed full of books on POKéMON.
texts.PalletTown_RivalsHouse_Text_LikeMeToGroo:
DAISY: Hi, {PLAYER}! Good timing.

I'm about to have some tea. Would you like to join me?

Oh, but look. Your POKéMON are a little dirty.

Would you like me to groom one?
texts.PalletTown_RivalsHouse_Text_DontNeedAnyG: You don't need any grooming done? Okay, we'll just have tea.
texts.PalletTown_RivalsHouse_Text_LookingNiceI: DAISY: Okay, I'll get it looking nice in no time.
texts.PalletTown_RivalsHouse_Text_ThereYouGoAl:
{COLOR DARK_GRAY}{STR_VAR_1} looks dreamily content…

{COLOR RED}DAISY: There you go! All done. {FONT_NORMAL}{STR_VAR_1} looks dreamily content…

{FONT_FEMALE}DAISY: There you go! All done. See? Doesn't it look nice?

Giggle… It's such a cute POKéMON.
texts.PalletTown_RivalsHouse_Text_CantGroomAnE: Oh, sorry. I honestly can't groom an EGG.
texts.PalletTown_RivalsHouse_Text_MayISeeFirst:
DAISY: Your POKéMON grow to love you if you raise them with love.

For example, {PLAYER}, may I see your first POKéMON?
texts.PalletTown_RivalsHouse_Text_CouldntLoveY:
It couldn't possibly love you any more than it does now.

Your POKéMON is happy beyond words.
texts.PalletTown_RivalsHouse_Text_ItLooksVeryH:
It looks very happy.

I wish {RIVAL} could see this and learn something from it.
texts.PalletTown_RivalsHouse_Text_ItsQuiteFrie: It's quite friendly with you. Keep being good to it!
texts.PalletTown_RivalsHouse_Text_ItsWarmingUp: It's warming up to you. Trust must be growing between you.
texts.PalletTown_RivalsHouse_Text_NotFamiliarW:
It's not quite familiar with you yet.

POKéMON are all quite wary when you first get them.
texts.PalletTown_RivalsHouse_Text_DontLikeWayI:
{PLAYER}, I don't like the way it glares at you.

Could you try being a little nicer to it?
texts.PalletTown_RivalsHouse_Text_WhyWouldMonH:
…Um, it's not easy for me to say this, but…

Is there some reason why your POKéMON would hate you so much?
texts.Text_DreamEaterTeach:
Yawn! I must have dozed off in the sun.

I had this weird dream about a DROWZEE eating my dream.

And… I learned how to eat dreams…

Oogh, this is too spooky!

Let me teach it to a POKéMON so I can forget about it!
texts.Text_DreamEaterWhichMon: Which POKéMON wants to learn DREAM EATER?
texts.PewterCity_Text_ClefairyCameFromMoon:
CLEFAIRY came from the moon. That's what the rumor is.

They appeared after MOON STONES fell on MT. MOON.
texts.PewterCity_Text_BrockOnlySeriousTrainerH:
There aren't many serious POKéMON TRAINERS here.

They're all like BUG CATCHERS, you know, just hobbyists.

But PEWTER GYM's BROCK isn't like that, not one bit.
texts.PewterCity_Text_DidYouCheckOutMuseum: Did you check out the MUSEUM?
texts.PewterCity_Text_WerentThoseFossilsAmazin: Weren't those fossils from MT. MOON amazing?
texts.PewterCity_Text_ReallyYouHaveToGo: Really? You absolutely have to go!
texts.PewterCity_Text_ThisIsTheMuseum:
This is it, the MUSEUM.

You have to pay to get in, but it's worth it. See you around!
texts.PewterCity_Text_DoYouKnowWhatImDoing: Psssst! Do you know what I'm doing?
texts.PewterCity_Text_SprayingRepelToKeepWildM: I'm spraying REPEL to keep wild POKéMON out of my garden!
texts.PewterCity_Text_BrocksLookingForChalleng:
You're a TRAINER, right?

BROCK's looking for new challengers. Follow me!
texts.PewterCity_Text_GoTakeOnBrock: If you have the right stuff, go take on BROCK!
texts.PewterCity_Text_TrainerTipsEarningEXP:
TRAINER TIPS

All POKéMON that appear in battle, however briefly, earn EXP Points.
texts.PewterCity_Text_CallPoliceIfInfoOnThieve:
NOTICE!

Thieves have been stealing POKéMON fossils from MT. MOON.

Please call the PEWTER POLICE if you have any information.
texts.PewterCity_Text_GymSign: PEWTER CITY POKéMON GYM LEADER: BROCK The Rock-Solid POKéMON TRAINER!
texts.PewterCity_Text_CitySign: PEWTER CITY A Stone Gray City
texts.PewterCity_Text_DefeatedBrockYouCanHaveT:
あッれー！ その　ジムバッジ‥‥ すげえな　タケシに　かったのかよ！

かんどう　したから おれの　たからもの　やるよ！
texts.PewterCity_Text_BerriesInsideUseCarefull:
なかには　きのみが　はいってるぜ

やくに　たつ　きのみも はいって　いるから だいじに　つかって　くれよ！

ポケモンに　きのみを もたせて　おけば たたかっている　ときに かってに　つかって　くれるんだ

texts.PewterCity_Text_AskedToDeliverThis:
I'm glad I caught up to you. I'm PROF. OAK's AIDE.

I've been asked to deliver this, so here you go.
texts.PewterCity_Text_ReceivedRunningShoesFrom: {PLAYER} received the RUNNING SHOES from the AIDE.
texts.PewterCity_Text_SwitchedShoesWithRunning: {PLAYER} switched shoes with the RUNNING SHOES.
texts.PewterCity_Text_ExplainRunningShoes: Press the B Button to run. But only where there's room to run!
texts.PewterCity_Text_MustBeGoingBackToLab:
Well, I must be going back to the LAB.

Bye-bye!
texts.PewterCity_Text_RunningShoesLetterFromMo:
There's a letter attached…

Dear {PLAYER},

Here is a pair of RUNNING SHOES for my beloved challenger.

Remember, I'll always cheer for you! Don't ever give up!

From Mom
texts.PewterCity_Gym_Text_BrockIntro:
So, you're here. I'm BROCK. I'm PEWTER's GYM LEADER.

My rock-hard willpower is evident even in my POKéMON.

My POKéMON are all rock hard, and have true-grit determination.

That's right - my POKéMON are all the ROCK type!

Fuhaha! You're going to challenge me knowing that you'll lose?

That's the TRAINER's honor that compels you to challenge me.

Fine, then! Show me your best!{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}
texts.PewterCity_Gym_Text_BrockDefeat:
I took you for granted, and so I lost.

As proof of your victory, I confer on you this…the official POKéMON LEAGUE BOULDERBADGE.

{FONT_NORMAL}{PLAYER} received the BOULDERBADGE from BROCK!{PAUSE_MUSIC}{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_OBTAIN_BADGE}{PAUSE 0xFE}{PAUSE 0x56}{RESUME_MUSIC}

{FONT_MALE}Just having the BOULDERBADGE makes your POKéMON more powerful.

It also enables the use of the move FLASH outside of battle.

Of course, a POKéMON must know the move FLASH to use it.
texts.PewterCity_Gym_Text_ExplainTM39:
A TM, Technical Machine, contains a technique for POKéMON.

Using a TM teaches the move it contains to a POKéMON.

A TM is good for only one use.

So, when you use one, pick the POKéMON carefully.

Anyways… TM39 contains ROCK TOMB.

It hurls boulders at the foe and lowers its SPEED.
texts.PewterCity_Gym_Text_BrockPostBattle:
There are all kinds of TRAINERS in this huge world of ours.

You appear to be very gifted as a POKéMON TRAINER.

So let me make a suggestion.

Go to the GYM in CERULEAN and test your abilities.
texts.PewterCity_Gym_Text_DontHaveRoomForThis: You don't have room for this.
texts.PewterCity_Gym_Text_LiamIntro:
Stop right there, kid!

You're ten thousand light-years  from facing BROCK!
texts.PewterCity_Gym_Text_LiamDefeat:
Darn!

Light-years isn't time… It measures distance!
texts.PewterCity_Gym_Text_LiamPostBattle: You're pretty hot. …But not as hot as BROCK!
texts.PewterCity_Gym_Text_LetMeTakeYouToTheTop:
Hiya! Do you want to dream big?

Do you dare to dream of becoming the POKéMON champ?

I'm no TRAINER, but I can advise you on how to win.

Let me take you to the top!
texts.PewterCity_Gym_Text_TryDifferentPartyOrd:
The first POKéMON out in a match is at the left of the POKéMON LIST.

By changing the order of POKéMON, you may gain an advantage.

Try different orders to suit your opponent's party.
texts.PewterCity_Gym_Text_ItsFreeLetsGetHappen: It's a free service! Let's get happening!
texts.PewterCity_Gym_Text_YoureChampMaterial: Just as I thought! You're POKéMON champ material!
texts.PewterCity_Gym_Text_GymStatue:
PEWTER POKéMON GYM LEADER: BROCK

WINNING TRAINERS: {RIVAL}
texts.PewterCity_Gym_Text_GymStatuePlayerWon:
PEWTER POKéMON GYM LEADER: BROCK

WINNING TRAINERS: {RIVAL}, {PLAYER}
texts.PewterCity_House1_Text_TradeMonsAreFinic:
Our POKéMON's an outsider, so it's finicky and hard to handle.

An outsider is a POKéMON that you get in a trade.

It grows fast, but it may ignore an unskilled TRAINER in battle.

If only we had some BADGES…
texts.PewterCity_House2_Text_MonsLearnTechniqu:
POKéMON learn new techniques as they grow.

But some moves must be taught to them by people.
texts.PewterCity_House2_Text_MonsEasierCatchIf:
A POKéMON becomes easier to  catch if it has a status problem.

Sleep, poison, burn, or paralysis… Those are all effective.

But catching POKéMON is never a sure thing!
texts.PewterCity_Mart_Text_BoughtWeirdFishFrom:
A shady old guy sucked me into buying this weird fish POKéMON!

It's totally weak and it cost ¥500!
texts.PewterCity_Mart_Text_GoodThingsIfRaiseMo:
Good things can happen if you raise POKéMON diligently.

Even the weak ones can surprise you if you don't give up on them.
texts.PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_Its50YForChild:
Yes, yes. It's ¥50 for a child's ticket.

Would you like to come in?
texts.PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_DoYouKnowWhatA:
You can't sneak in the back way! Nice try, kid, but no.

Oh, whatever! Do you know what AMBER is?
texts.PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_AmberContainsG:
AMBER contains the genetic matter of ancient POKéMON.

There's a LAB somewhere trying to resurrect POKéMON from AMBER.
texts.PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_AmberIsFossili:
AMBER is actually sap, that gooey stuff that oozes from trees.

The ancient sap fossilized over time to become rock-hard AMBER.
texts.PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_PleaseGoAround: あちらへ　おまわりください
texts.PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_ShouldBeGratef:
I should be grateful for my long life.

Never did I think I would get to see the bones of a dragon!
texts.PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_WantYouToGetAm:
Ssh! Listen, I need to share a secret with someone.

I think that this chunk of AMBER contains POKéMON DNA!

It would be a shattering scientific breakthrough if POKéMON could be resurrected from it.

But, my colleagues just ignore what I have to say.

So, I have a favor to ask!

I want you to get this examined at a POKéMON LAB somewhere.
texts.PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_ReceivedOldAmb: {PLAYER} received the OLD AMBER from the man.
texts.PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_GetOldAmberChe: Ssh! Get the OLD AMBER checked!
texts.PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_DontHaveSpaceF: You don't have space for this.
texts.PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_WeHaveTwoFossi: We have two fossils of rare, prehistoric POKéMON on exhibit.
texts.PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_BeautifulPiece: There is a beautiful piece of AMBER in a clear gold color.
texts.PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_AerodactylFoss: AERODACTYL Fossil A primitive and rare POKéMON.
texts.PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_KabutopsFossil: KABUTOPS Fossil A primitive and rare POKéMON.
texts.Text_SeismicTossTeach:
The secrets of space… The mysteries of earth…

There are so many things about which we know so little.

But that should spur us to study harder, not toss in the towel.

The only thing you should toss…

Well, how about SEISMIC TOSS? Should I teach that to a POKéMON?
texts.Text_SeismicTossDeclined: Is that so? I'm sure you'll be back for it.
texts.Text_SeismicTossWhichMon: Which POKéMON wants to learn SEISMIC TOSS?
texts.Text_SeismicTossTaught: I hope you won't toss in the towel. Keep it up.
texts.PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_WhatsSpecialAb:
MOON STONE, huh?

What's so special about it? Looks like an ordinary rock to me.
texts.PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_BoughtColorTVF:
July 20, 1969!

Humankind first set foot on the moon that day.

I bought a color TV just so I could watch that news.
texts.PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_RunningSpaceEx: This month, we're running a space exhibit.
texts.PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_AskedDaddyToCa:
I want a PIKACHU! It's so cute!

I asked my daddy to catch me one!
texts.PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_PikachuSoonIPr: Yeah, a PIKACHU soon, I promise!
texts.PewterCity_Museum_1F_Text_MeteoriteThatF: A meteorite that fell on MT. MOON. It is thought to be a MOON STONE.
texts.PewterCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_TeamRoc:
What!?

TEAM ROCKET is at MT. MOON? Huh?

I'm on the phone! Scram!
texts.PewterCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_WhenJig:
Yawn!

When JIGGLYPUFF sings, POKéMON get drowsy…

…Me, too… Snore…
texts.PewterCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Trading: I really want a PIKACHU, so I'm trading my CLEFAIRY for one.

I'm trading POKéMON with that kid there.

I had two PIKACHU, so I figured I might as well trade one.
texts.PokemonLeague_AgathasRoom_Text_Intro:
I am AGATHA of the ELITE FOUR.

I hear OAK's taken a lot of interest in you, child.

That old duff was once tough and handsome.

But that was decades ago. He's a shadow of his former self.

Now he just wants to fiddle with his POKéDEX.

He's wrong. POKéMON are for battling!

{PLAYER}! I'll show you how a real TRAINER battles!{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}
texts.PokemonLeague_AgathasRoom_Text_RematchIn:
I am AGATHA of the ELITE FOUR.

You're the child that OAK's taken under his wing, aren't you?

That old duff was once tough and handsome.

But that was decades ago. He's a shadow of his former self.

Now he just wants to fiddle with his POKéDEX.

He's wrong. POKéMON are for battling!

{PLAYER}! I'll show you how a real TRAINER battles!{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}
texts.PokemonLeague_AgathasRoom_Text_Defeat: Oh, my! You're something special, child!
texts.PokemonLeague_AgathasRoom_Text_PostBattl:
You win!

I see what the old duff sees in you now.

I have nothing else to say. Run along now, child!
texts.PokemonLeague_BrunosRoom_Text_Intro:
I am BRUNO of the ELITE FOUR!

Through rigorous training, people and POKéMON can become stronger without limit.

I've lived and trained with my fighting POKéMON! And that will never change!

{PLAYER}!

We will grind you down with our superior power!

Hoo hah!{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}
texts.PokemonLeague_BrunosRoom_Text_RematchInt:

texts.PokemonLeague_BrunosRoom_Text_PostBattle: My job is done. Go face your next challenge.
texts.PokemonLeague_ChampionsRoom_Text_Intro:
{RIVAL}: Hey, {PLAYER}!

I was looking forward to seeing you, {PLAYER}.

My rival should be strong to keep me sharp.

While working on my POKéDEX, I looked all over for POKéMON.

Not only that, I assembled teams that would beat any POKéMON type.

And now…

I'm the POKéMON LEAGUE CHAMPION!

{PLAYER}! Do you know what that means?

I'll tell you.

I am the most powerful TRAINER in the world!
texts.PokemonLeague_ChampionsRoom_Text_Rematch:
{RIVAL}: Hey, {PLAYER}!

You came back, {PLAYER}! Hahah, that is so great!

My rival should be strong to keep me sharp.

While working on my POKéDEX, I looked all over for POKéMON.

Not only that, I assembled teams that would beat any POKéMON type.

And now…

I'm the POKéMON LEAGUE CHAMPION!

{PLAYER}! Do you know what that means?

I'll tell you.

I am the most powerful TRAINER in the world!
texts.PokemonLeague_ChampionsRoom_Text_Defeat:
NO! That can't be! You beat me at my best!

After all that work to become the LEAGUE CHAMP?

My reign is over already? It's not fair!
texts.PokemonLeague_ChampionsRoom_Text_Victory:
はーはッ！ かった！　かった！　かった！

{PLAYER}に　まける　ような おれさま　では　なーい！

ま！　ポケモンの てんさい　{RIVAL}さま　あいてに ここまで　よく　がんばった！

ほめて　つかわす！ はーッ！　はーはッはッ！
texts.PokemonLeague_ChampionsRoom_Text_PostBat:
Why? Why did I lose?

I never made any mistakes raising my POKéMON…

Darn it! You're the new POKéMON LEAGUE CHAMPION!

Although I don't like to admit it…
texts.PokemonLeague_ChampionsRoom_Text_OakCong:
OAK: So, you've won! Sincerely, congratulations!

You're the new POKéMON LEAGUE CHAMPION!

You've grown up so much since you first left with {STR_VAR_1} to work on the POKéDEX.

{PLAYER}, you have come of age!
texts.PokemonLeague_ChampionsRoom_Text_OakImDi:
OAK: {RIVAL}… I'm disappointed in you.

I came when I heard you'd beaten the ELITE FOUR.

But, when I got here, you had already lost!

{RIVAL}, do you understand why you lost?

You have forgotten to treat your POKéMON with love and trust.

Without them, you will never become a CHAMP again!
texts.PokemonLeague_ChampionsRoom_Text_OakPlay:
OAK: {PLAYER}.

You understand that your victory was not just your own doing.

The bond you share with your POKéMON is marvelous.

{PLAYER}! Come with me!
texts.PokemonLeague_HallOfFame_Text_OakCongrat:
OAK: Er-hem! Congratulations, {PLAYER}!

This floor is the POKéMON HALL OF FAME.

POKéMON LEAGUE CHAMPIONS are honored for their exploits here.

Their POKéMON are also recorded in the HALL OF FAME.

{PLAYER}!

You have worked hard to become the new LEAGUE CHAMPION.

Congratulations, {PLAYER}, you and your POKéMON are HALL OF FAMERS!
texts.PokemonLeague_LancesRoom_Text_Intro:
Ah! I've heard about you, {PLAYER}!

I lead the ELITE FOUR.

You can call me LANCE the dragon TRAINER.

You know that dragons are mythical POKéMON.

They're hard to catch and raise, but their powers are superior.

They're virtually indestructible. There's no being clever with them.

Well, are you ready to lose?

Your LEAGUE challenge ends with me, {PLAYER}!{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}
texts.PokemonLeague_LancesRoom_Text_RematchInt:
Ah! So, you've returned, {PLAYER}!

I lead the ELITE FOUR.

You can call me LANCE the dragon TRAINER.

You know that dragons are mythical POKéMON.

They're hard to catch and raise, but their powers are superior.

They're virtually indestructible. There's no being clever with them.

Well, are you ready to lose?

Your LEAGUE challenge ends with me, {PLAYER}!{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}
texts.PokemonLeague_LancesRoom_Text_Defeat:
That's it!

I hate to admit it, but you are a POKéMON master!
texts.PokemonLeague_LancesRoom_Text_PostBattle:
I still can't believe my dragons lost to you, {PLAYER}.

You are now the POKéMON LEAGUE CHAMPION!

…Or, you would have been, but you have one more challenge left.

There is one more TRAINER to face! His name is…

{RIVAL}!

He beat the ELITE FOUR before you.

He is the real POKéMON LEAGUE CHAMPION.
texts.PokemonLeague_LoreleisRoom_Text_Intro:
Welcome to the POKéMON LEAGUE.

I am LORELEI of the ELITE FOUR.

No one can best me when it comes to icy POKéMON.

Freezing moves are powerful.

Your POKéMON will be at my mercy when they are frozen solid.

Hahaha! Are you ready?{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}
texts.PokemonLeague_LoreleisRoom_Text_RematchI:
Welcome to the POKéMON LEAGUE.

I, LORELEI of the ELITE FOUR, have returned!

You know how it goes. No one can best me when it comes to icy POKéMON.

Freezing moves are powerful.

Your POKéMON will be at my mercy when they are frozen solid.

Hahaha! Are you ready?{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}
texts.PokemonLeague_LoreleisRoom_Text_PostBatt:
You're better than I thought. Go on ahead.

You only got a taste of the POKéMON LEAGUE's power.
texts.PokemonMansion_1F_Text_TedIntro: Who are you? There shouldn't be anyone here.
texts.PokemonMansion_1F_Text_TedPostBattle: A key? I don't know what you're talking about.
texts.PokemonMansion_1F_Text_JohnsonIntro: W-w-waah! You startled me! I thought you were a ghost.
texts.PokemonMansion_1F_Text_JohnsonDefeat: Tch! I can't get any wins.
texts.PokemonMansion_1F_Text_JohnsonPostBattle:
I was exploring here by myself, but I feel spooked.

I ought to go soon.
texts.PokemonMansion_1F_Text_ArnieIntro: I can't get out! This old place is one big puzzle.
texts.PokemonMansion_1F_Text_ArnieDefeat: Oh, no! My bag of loot!
texts.PokemonMansion_1F_Text_ArniePostBattle: The switches here open and close alternating sets of doors.
texts.PokemonMansion_1F_Text_NewMonDiscoveredI:
Diary: July 5 Guyana, South America

A new POKéMON was discovered deep in the jungle.
texts.PokemonMansion_1F_Text_ChristenedDiscove: Diary: July 10 We christened the newly discovered POKéMON, MEW.
texts.PokemonMansion_Text_PressSecretSwitchJP:
ひみつの　スイッチが　ある！

おして　みますか？
texts.PokemonMansion_Text_LetsTryIt: おしてみよう！　‥ポチッとな
texts.PokemonMansion_Text_GaveUpOnPressingSwit: おすのは　あきらめた
texts.PokemonMansion_1F_Text_SimonPostBattle: I wonder where my partner went.
texts.PokemonMansion_1F_Text_BraydonPostBattle: So, you're stuck? Try jumping off over there!
texts.PokemonMansion_1F_Text_MewGaveBirthToMew:
Diary: Feb. 6 MEW gave birth.

We named the newborn MEWTWO.
texts.PokemonMansion_B1F_Text_LewisPostBattle: You can find stuff lying around. The residents must've left them.
texts.PokemonMansion_B1F_Text_IvanIntro: This place is ideal for a lab. Look at all this space.
texts.PokemonMansion_B1F_Text_IvanPostBattle: I like it here. It's conducive to my studies.
texts.PokemonMansion_B1F_Text_MewtwoIsFarTooPo:
Diary: Sept. 1 MEWTWO is far too powerful.

We have failed to curb its vicious tendencies…
texts.PokemonTower_1F_Text_ErectedInMemoryOfDe: POKéMON TOWER was erected in the memory of POKéMON that died.
texts.PokemonTower_1F_Text_ComeToPayRespectsSo:
Did you come to pay respects?

Bless your POKéMON-loving heart, son.
texts.PokemonTower_1F_Text_ComeToPayRespectsGi:
Did you come to pay respects?

Bless your POKéMON-loving heart, girl.
texts.PokemonTower_1F_Text_CameToPrayForDepart:
I came to pray for my dearly departed CLEFAIRY.

Sniff! I'm awash in tears…
texts.PokemonTower_1F_Text_GrowlitheWhyDidYouD: My GROWLITHE… Why did you die?
texts.PokemonTower_1F_Text_SenseSpiritsUpToMis:
I am a CHANNELER.

There are spirits up to mischief. I sense them high in the TOWER.
texts.PokemonTower_2F_Text_RivalIntro:
{RIVAL}: Hey, {PLAYER}! What brings you here? Is your POKéMON dead?

Hey! It's alive!

I can at least make them faint! Let's go!
texts.PokemonTower_2F_Text_RivalDefeat:
What? You stinker!

I took it easy on you, too!
texts.PokemonTower_2F_Text_RivalVictory: {RIVAL}“あーあ‥！ ほんとに　くたばっちまったぞ！ よわいなー！ もっと　ちゃんと　そだてて　やれよ
