How's your POKéDEX coming? I just caught a CUBONE!

I can't find the bigger MAROWAK. Where could they be?

I bet there aren't any left!

Well, I better get going. I've got a lot to accomplish, unlike you.

Smell ya later!
texts.PokemonTower_2F_Text_SilphScopeCouldUnma:
Even we could not identify the wayward ghosts.

A SILPH SCOPE might be able to unmask them.
texts.PokemonTower_3F_Text_HopePostBattle: The ghosts can be identified by the SILPH SCOPE.
texts.PokemonTower_3F_Text_PatriciaPostBattle: The others above… They must have been possessed.
texts.PokemonTower_4F_Text_LaurelPostBattle: We can't determine the identity of the ghosts…
texts.PokemonTower_4F_Text_JodyPostBattle: May the departed POKéMON rest in peace…
texts.PokemonTower_5F_Text_RestHereInPurifiedS: Come, child! I have purified this space. You can rest here.
texts.PokemonTower_5F_Text_JanaePostBattle: I fell to evil spirits despite my training in the mountains…
texts.PokemonTower_5F_Text_PurifiedZoneMonsFul:
Entered the purified and protected zone.

{PLAYER}'s POKéMON were fully healed.
texts.PokemonTower_6F_Text_EmiliaPostBattle: My hair didn't fall out! It was a malevolent spirit!
texts.PokemonTower_6F_Text_GhostWasCubonesMoth: The ghost was the restless spirit of CUBONE's mother!
texts.PokemonTower_6F_Text_MothersSpiritWasCal:
The mother's spirit was calmed.

It departed to the afterlife…
texts.PokemonTower_7F_Text_Grunt1Intro: What do you want? Why are you here?
texts.PokemonTower_7F_Text_Grunt1PostBattle: I'm not going to forget this!
texts.PokemonTower_7F_Text_Grunt2Intro:
This old guy marched right up to our HIDEOUT.

Then, he starts ranting about how TEAM ROCKET's abusing POKéMON.

So, we're just talking it over as adults.
texts.PokemonTower_7F_Text_Grunt2PostBattle:
POKéMON are only good for making money. Why not use them?

You stay out of our business!
texts.PokemonTower_7F_Text_Grunt3PostBattle: You're not getting away with this!
texts.PokemonTower_7F_Text_MrFujiThankYouFollo:
MR. FUJI: Heh? You came to save me?

Thank you. But, I came here of my own free will.

I came to calm the spirit of CUBONE's mother.

I think MAROWAK's spirit has finally left us.

I must thank you for your kind concern.

Follow me to my home, POKéMON HOUSE, at the foot of this tower.
texts.RocketHideout_B1F_Text_Grunt1Intro: Who are you? How did you get here?
texts.RocketHideout_B1F_Text_Grunt1PostBattle: Blast it… You're dissing TEAM ROCKET, aren't you?
texts.RocketHideout_B1F_Text_Grunt2Intro: You broke into TEAM ROCKET's operation? What nerve!
texts.RocketHideout_B1F_Text_Grunt2PostBattle: You're not going to get away with this, brat!
texts.RocketHideout_B1F_Text_Grunt3PostBattle: SILPH SCOPE? Humph! I don't know where it is.
texts.RocketHideout_B1F_Text_Grunt4PostBattle: Okay, I'll talk… Take the elevator to see my BOSS.
texts.RocketHideout_B1F_Text_Grunt5Intro: Are you lost, you little mouse?
texts.RocketHideout_B1F_Text_Grunt5PostBattle: Uh-oh, that ruckus somehow opened the door!
texts.RocketHideout_B2F_Text_GruntIntro: BOSS said you can see ghosts with the SILPH SCOPE.
texts.RocketHideout_B2F_Text_GruntPostBattle:
The TEAM ROCKET HQ has four underground floors.

Think you can reach the BOSS?
texts.RocketHideout_B3F_Text_Grunt1Intro: Stop meddling in TEAM ROCKET's affairs or else!
texts.RocketHideout_B3F_Text_Grunt1PostBattle:
SILPH SCOPE? Oh, that machine the BOSS stole.

It's here somewhere.
texts.RocketHideout_B3F_Text_Grunt2Intro: We got word from upstairs that you were coming!
texts.RocketHideout_B3F_Text_Grunt2PostBattle:
Go ahead and go!

But you can't run the elevator without the LIFT KEY.
texts.RocketHideout_B4F_Text_GiovanniIntro:
So! I must say, I am impressed you got here.

TEAM ROCKET captures POKéMON from around the world.

They're important tools for keeping our criminal enterprise going.

I am the leader, GIOVANNI!

For your insolence, you will feel a world of pain!
texts.RocketHideout_B4F_Text_GiovanniPostBattl:
I see that you raise POKéMON with utmost care.

A child like you would never understand what I hope to achieve.

I shall step aside this time!

I hope we meet again…
texts.RocketHideout_B4F_Text_Grunt2Intro: I know you! You ruined our plans at MT. MOON!
texts.RocketHideout_B4F_Text_Grunt2PostBattle: Do you have something against TEAM ROCKET?
texts.RocketHideout_B4F_Text_Grunt3Intro: How can you not see the beauty of our evil?
texts.RocketHideout_B4F_Text_Grunt3PostBattle: BOSS! I'm sorry I failed you!
texts.RocketHideout_B4F_Text_Grunt1Intro: The elevator doesn't work? Who has the LIFT KEY?
texts.RocketHideout_B4F_Text_Grunt1PostBattle: Oh, no! I dropped the LIFT KEY!
texts.RocketHideout_Elevator_Text_AppearsToNee: It appears to need a key.
texts.RockTunnel_1F_Text_LennyIntro: This tunnel goes a long way, kid!
texts.RockTunnel_1F_Text_LennyPostBattle:
Watch for ONIX. They appear only occasionally.

High-level ones can put the squeeze on you!
texts.RockTunnel_1F_Text_OliverIntro: Hmm. Maybe I'm lost in here…
texts.RockTunnel_1F_Text_OliverDefeat: Ease up! What am I doing? Which way is out?
texts.RockTunnel_1F_Text_OliverPostBattle: That sleeping POKéMON on ROUTE 12 forced me to take this detour.
texts.RockTunnel_1F_Text_LucasIntro: Outsiders like you need to show me some respect!
texts.RockTunnel_1F_Text_AshtonPostBattle: Oh well, I'll get a ZUBAT as I go!
texts.RockTunnel_1F_Text_LeahIntro:
Eek!

Don't try anything funny in the dark!
texts.RockTunnel_1F_Text_LeahPostBattle: I saw a MACHOP in this tunnel.
texts.RockTunnel_1F_Text_DanaIntro: I came this far looking for wild POKéMON.
texts.RockTunnel_1F_Text_DanaPostBattle: You looked cute and harmless. Was I ever wrong!
texts.RockTunnel_1F_Text_RouteSign: ROCK TUNNEL CERULEAN CITY - LAVENDER TOWN
texts.RockTunnel_B1F_Text_SofiaIntro:
Do you know how you can avoid getting lost in the mountains?

You can bend twigs as trail markers.
texts.RockTunnel_B1F_Text_DudleyIntro: Hahaha! Can you beat my power?
texts.RockTunnel_B1F_Text_DudleyPostBattle: I go for power because I hate thinking.
texts.RockTunnel_B1F_Text_CooperIntro: You have a POKéDEX? I want one, too.
texts.RockTunnel_B1F_Text_CooperPostBattle: When you finish your POKéDEX, can I have it?
texts.RockTunnel_B1F_Text_SteveIntro: Um… Do you know about POKéMON cosplay?
texts.RockTunnel_B1F_Text_StevePostBattle:
POKéMON cosplay is dressing up as POKéMON for fun.

CLEFAIRY is a favorite.
texts.RockTunnel_B1F_Text_AllenIntro: My POKéMON techniques will leave you crying!
texts.RockTunnel_B1F_Text_AllenDefeat: I give! You're a better technician!
texts.RockTunnel_B1F_Text_AllenPostBattle: In mountains, you'll often find ROCK-type POKéMON.
texts.RockTunnel_B1F_Text_MarthaIntro: I don't often come here, but I will battle you.
texts.RockTunnel_B1F_Text_MarthaPostBattle: I like tiny POKéMON. Big ones are too scary!
texts.RockTunnel_B1F_Text_EricIntro: Hit me with your best shot!
texts.RockTunnel_B1F_Text_EricPostBattle: I'll raise my POKéMON to beat yours, kid.
texts.RockTunnel_B1F_Text_WinstonIntro: I draw illustrations of POKéMON when I'm home.
texts.RockTunnel_B1F_Text_WinstonPostBattle: I'm an artist, not a fighter. I'll go home to draw.
texts.Route1_Text_WorkAtPokeMartTakeSample:
Hi! I work at a POKéMON MART.

It's part of a convenient chain selling all sorts of items.

Please, visit us in VIRIDIAN CITY.

I know, I'll give you a sample. Here you go!
texts.Route1_Text_ComeSeeUsIfYouNeedPokeBalls: Please come see us if you need POKé BALLS for catching POKéMON.
texts.Route1_Text_PutPotionAway: {PLAYER} put the POTION away in the BAG's ITEMS POCKET.
texts.Route1_Text_CanJumpFromLedges:
See those ledges along the road?

It's a bit scary, but you can jump from them.

You can get back to PALLET TOWN quicker that way.
texts.Route10_Text_MarkIntro: Wow, you came all the way here? Maybe you're a POKéMANIAC, too? Want to see my collection?
texts.Route10_Text_MarkPostBattle: I have more rare POKéMON at home!
texts.Route10_Text_ClarkDefeat: Ha-haha! Not laughing! Ha-hay fever! Haha-ha-choo!
texts.Route10_Text_HermanIntro: Hi, kid! Want to see my POKéMON?
texts.Route10_Text_HermanPostBattle: I don't like you. I don't like anyone better than me!
texts.Route10_Text_HeidiIntro:
I've been out at a POKéMON GYM a few times.

…But I always lose.
texts.Route10_Text_HeidiPostBattle:
I noticed some POKéMANIACS prowling around.

Can you imagine? Them? Up here in the mountains?
texts.Route10_Text_TrentIntro: Ah! This mountain air is delicious!
texts.Route10_Text_TrentPostBattle: I feel bloated on mountain air!
texts.Route10_Text_CarolIntro: I'm feeling a bit faint. I haven't hiked in some time.
texts.Route10_Text_CarolDefeat: I'm too tired. I wasn't up for it.
texts.Route10_Text_CarolPostBattle:
The POKéMON here in the mountains are so chunky…

I wish there were pink POKéMON with a floral pattern!
texts.Route10_Text_RockTunnelDetourToLavender: ROCK TUNNEL Detour to LAVENDER TOWN
texts.Route10_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_EveryTypeS:
The types of POKéMON match up differently with each other.

Every type is stronger than some types and weaker than others.
texts.Route10_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_NuggetUsel: A NUGGET is totally useless. So I sold it for ¥5000.
texts.Route10_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_HeardGhost: I heard that ghosts haunt LAVENDER TOWN.
texts.Route10_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_GiveEverst:
Oh… {PLAYER}! I've been looking for you!

It's me, one of the ever-present AIDES to PROF. OAK.

If your POKéDEX has complete data on twenty species, I'm supposed to give you a reward from PROF. OAK.

He entrusted me with this EVERSTONE.

So, {PLAYER}, let me ask you.

Have you gathered data on at least twenty kinds of POKéMON?
texts.Route10_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_GreatHereY:
Great! You have caught or owned {STR_VAR_3} kinds of POKéMON!

Congratulations! Here you go!
texts.Route10_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_ReceivedEv: {PLAYER} received the EVERSTONE from the AIDE.
texts.Route10_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_ExplainEve:
Making POKéMON evolve certainly can add to the POKéDEX.

However, at times, you may not want a certain POKéMON to evolve.

In that case, give the EVERSTONE to that POKéMON.

It will prevent evolution according to the PROFESSOR.
texts.Route11_Text_HugoPostBattle: POKéMON is life! And to live is to play games!
texts.Route11_Text_JasperPostBattle: You can't be a coward in the world of POKéMON!
texts.Route11_Text_EddiePostBattle: I did my best. I have no regrets.
texts.Route11_Text_BraxtonIntro: Careful! I'm laying down some cables!
texts.Route11_Text_BraxtonPostBattle: Spread the word to save energy!
texts.Route11_Text_DillonIntro: I just became a TRAINER. But, I think I can win.
texts.Route11_Text_DillonDefeat: My POKéMON couldn't win… Haven't they grown enough?
texts.Route11_Text_DirkPostBattle: You were just lucky, that's all.
texts.Route11_Text_YasuIntro: I'm the best in my class. I train every morning.
texts.Route11_Text_YasuDefeat: Darn! My POKéMON need to be stronger!
texts.Route11_Text_YasuPostBattle:
There's a fat POKéMON that comes down from the mountains.

I bet it'd be strong if you can catch it.
texts.Route11_Text_BerniePostBattle: Well, better get back to work.
texts.Route11_Text_DaveIntro: I raised my POKéMON carefully. They should be ready by now!
texts.Route11_Text_DavePostBattle: Tch… I better go find stronger ones!
texts.Route11_EastEntrance_1F_Text_BagIsFull: {PLAYER}{KUN}の　バッグ いっぱい　みたい　だね
texts.Route11_EastEntrance_1F_Text_ManInLavend:
Don't you think it's hard to think up good names for POKéMON?

Especially if you've caught a whole bunch?

In LAVENDER TOWN, there's a man who rates POKéMON nicknames.

He can even help you rename your POKéMON, too.
texts.Route11_EastEntrance_1F_Text_RockTunnelT:
If you're aiming to reach LAVENDER TOWN, take ROCK TUNNEL.

You can get to ROCK TUNNEL from CERULEAN CITY.
texts.Route11_EastEntrance_2F_Text_GiveItemfin:
Hi! Remember me? I'm one of PROF. OAK's AIDES.

If your POKéDEX has complete data on {STR_VAR_1} species, I'm supposed to give you a reward.

PROF. OAK entrusted me with the {STR_VAR_2} for you.

So, {PLAYER}, let me ask you.

Have you gathered data on at least {STR_VAR_1} kinds of POKéMON?
texts.Route11_EastEntrance_2F_Text_GreatHereYo:
Great! You have caught or owned {STR_VAR_3} kinds of POKéMON!

Congratulations! Here you go!
texts.Route11_EastEntrance_2F_Text_ExplainItem:
There are items on the ground that may be hidden from view.

Use the ITEMFINDER to detect any hidden items close to you.

The machine is a bit limited. It can't pinpoint item locations.

What it does is show the direction where the item is.

Use it to get your bearings, then search the suspect area by hand.
texts.Route11_EastEntrance_2F_Text_BigMonAslee:
Let's see what the binoculars have to show…

A big POKéMON is asleep on a road!
texts.Route11_EastEntrance_2F_Text_WhatABreath:
Let's see what the binoculars have to show…

What a breathtaking view!
texts.Route11_EastEntrance_2F_Text_RockTunnelG:
Let's see what the binoculars have to show…

To get to LAVENDER TOWN from CERULEAN CITY…

ROCK TUNNEL appears to be a good route to take.
texts.Route12_Text_MonSprawledOutInSlumber: A POKéMON is sprawled out in a deep and comfortable slumber.
texts.Text_SnorlaxWokeUp:
SNORLAX woke up!

It attacked in a grumpy rage!
texts.Text_SnorlaxReturnedToMountains: SNORLAX calmed down. It gave a huge yawn… And returned to the mountains.
texts.Text_WantToUsePokeFlute: Want to use the POKé FLUTE?
texts.Route12_Text_NedIntro: Yeah! I got a bite here!
texts.Route12_Text_ChipIntro: Be patient. Fishing is a waiting game.
texts.Route12_Text_ChipPostBattle: With a better ROD, I could catch better POKéMON…
texts.Route12_Text_JustinIntro: I'm searching for a MOON STONE. Have you found one?
texts.Route12_Text_JustinPostBattle:
I could have made my POKéMON evolve with a MOON STONE.

I would have won then, I bet.
texts.Route12_Text_LucaIntro:
Electricity is my specialty.

I don't know a thing about POKéMON of the sea, though.
texts.Route12_Text_LucaPostBattle: Water conducts electricity, so you should zap sea POKéMON.
texts.Route12_Text_HankIntro: The FISHING FOOL versus POKéMON KID!
texts.Route12_Text_HankPostBattle:
I guess you get to be good at what you like.

Well, you beat me at POKéMON, but you can't top me at fishing.
texts.Route12_Text_ElliotIntro:
I love fishing, don't get me wrong.

But it'd be best if I also had more work.
texts.Route12_Text_ElliotPostBattle: It's all right. Losing doesn't bug me anymore.
texts.Route12_Text_AndrewIntro:
What's catching?

You never know what you could catch!
texts.Route12_Text_AndrewPostBattle:
What, MAGIKARP?

I catch them all the time, sure. But, boy are they wimpy.
texts.Route12_Text_JesIntro: JES: If I win, I'm going to propose to GIA.
texts.Route12_Text_JesDefeat: JES: Oh, please, why couldn't you let us win?
texts.Route12_Text_JesPostBattle: JES: Oh, GIA, forgive me, my love!
texts.Route12_Text_JesNotEnoughMons:
JES: GIA and I, we'll be together forever.

We won't battle unless you have two POKéMON of your own.
texts.Route12_Text_GiaIntro:
GIA: Hey, JES…

If we win, I'll marry you!
texts.Route12_Text_GiaPostBattle: GIA: JES, you silly! You ruined this!
texts.Route12_Text_GiaNotEnoughMons:
GIA: I can't bear to battle without my JES!

Don't you have one more POKéMON?
texts.Route12_FishingHouse_Text_DoYouLikeToFis:
I'm the FISHING GURU's younger brother.

I simply looove fishing! I can't bear to go without.

Tell me, do you like to fish?
texts.Route12_FishingHouse_Text_TakeThisAndFis:
Grand! I like your style. I think we can be friends.

Take this and fish, young friend!
texts.Route12_FishingHouse_Text_ReceivedSuperR: {PLAYER} received a SUPER ROD from the FISHING GURU's brother.
texts.Route12_FishingHouse_Text_IfYouCatchBigM:
Fishing is a way of life! It is like the finest poetry.

From the seas to rivers, go out and land the big one, my friend.

Now, I have a request.

If you catch a big MAGIKARP  with that ROD, I want to see it.

As much as I love to fish, I also love seeing gigantic MAGIKARP.
texts.Route12_FishingHouse_Text_TryFishingBrin:
Hello there, {PLAYER}! Have you been fishing?

Try fishing with the SUPER ROD in any body of water.

You'll find different POKéMON in different places.

Oh, and don't forget to bring me gigantic MAGIKARP.
texts.Route12_FishingHouse_Text_OhMagikarpAllo:
Oh? {PLAYER}? Why, if it isn't a MAGIKARP!

Allow me to see it, quick!
texts.Route12_FishingHouse_Text_WhoaXInchesTak:
… … …Whoa! {STR_VAR_2} inches!

You have a rare appreciation for the fine, poetic aspects of fishing!

You must take this. I insist!
texts.Route12_FishingHouse_Text_LookForwardToG: I'll look forward to seeing greater records from you!
texts.Route12_FishingHouse_Text_HuhXInchesSame:
Huh? {STR_VAR_2} inches?

This is the same size as the one I saw before.
texts.Route12_FishingHouse_Text_HmmXInchesDoes:
Hmm… This one is {STR_VAR_2} inches long.

It doesn't measure up to the {STR_VAR_3}-inch one you brought before.
texts.Route12_FishingHouse_Text_DoesntLookLike: Uh… That doesn't look much like a MAGIKARP.
texts.Route12_FishingHouse_Text_NoRoomForGift:
Oh, no!

I had a gift for you, but you have no room for it.
texts.Route12_FishingHouse_Text_MostGiganticMa:
The most gigantic MAGIKARP I have ever witnessed…

{STR_VAR_3} inches!
texts.Route12_FishingHouse_Text_BlankChartOfSo:
It's a blank chart of some sort.

It has spaces for writing in records of some kind.
texts.Route12_NorthEntrance_1F_Text_LookoutSpo: There's a lookout spot upstairs. The view is magnificent.
texts.Route12_NorthEntrance_2F_Text_TakeTMDont:
My POKéMON's ashes are stored in POKéMON TOWER.

You can have this TM. I don't need it anymore…

My POKéMON's ashes are stored in POKéMON TOWER.

You can have this TM. I don't need it anymore…
texts.Route12_NorthEntrance_2F_Text_ReceivedTM: {PLAYER} received TM27 from the little girl.
texts.Route12_NorthEntrance_2F_Text_ExplainTM2:
TM27 is a move called RETURN…

If you treat your POKéMON good, it will return your love by working its hardest in battle.
texts.Route12_NorthEntrance_2F_Text_DontHaveRo: You don't have room for this.
texts.Route12_NorthEntrance_2F_Text_TheresManF:
Let's see what the binoculars have to show…

There's a man fishing!
texts.Route12_NorthEntrance_2F_Text_ItsPokemon:
Let's see what the binoculars have to show…

It's POKéMON TOWER!
texts.Route13_Text_SebastianIntro: My bird POKéMON want to battle with you!
texts.Route13_Text_SebastianDefeat: My PIDGEY and PIDGEOTTO combo lost?
texts.Route13_Text_SebastianPostBattle: My POKéMON look happy even though they lost.
texts.Route13_Text_SusieIntro: I'm told I'm good for a kid.
texts.Route13_Text_SusiePostBattle: I want to become a good TRAINER. I'll train hard, just watch.
texts.Route13_Text_ValerieIntro: Wow! Your BADGES are too cool!
texts.Route13_Text_ValeriePostBattle: You got those BADGES from GYM LEADERS. I know!
texts.Route13_Text_GwenIntro: My cute POKéMON wish to make your acquaintance.
texts.Route13_Text_GwenPostBattle: You have to make POKéMON battle to toughen them up.
texts.Route13_Text_AlmaIntro: I found CARBOS in a cave once while I was spelunking.
texts.Route13_Text_AlmaDefeat: Oh, too bad! I just messed up!
texts.Route13_Text_AlmaPostBattle: CARBOS boosted the SPEED of my POKéMON.
texts.Route13_Text_PerryIntro: I'm not going to lose. Not when the wind's blowing my way!
texts.Route13_Text_PerryPostBattle: I'm beat. I guess I'll FLY home.
texts.Route13_Text_LolaIntro: Sure, I'll play with you, sweetie.
texts.Route13_Text_LolaPostBattle: I wonder which is stronger, male or female POKéMON?
texts.Route13_Text_SheilaIntro: Do you want to battle some POKéMON with me?
texts.Route13_Text_SheilaPostBattle:
I don't know anything about POKéMON actually.

The ones I use… I picked them for their looks!
texts.Route13_Text_RobertIntro: I always go with bird POKéMON. I've dedicated myself to them.
texts.Route13_Text_RobertPostBattle: I wish I could fly like PIDGEY and PIDGEOTTO…
texts.Route13_Text_LookToLeftOfThatPost:
TRAINER TIPS

Look, look! Look to the left of that post!
texts.Route13_Text_SelectToSwitchItems:
TRAINER TIPS

Use SELECT to switch items in the ITEMS window.
texts.Route14_Text_CarterIntro: You need to use TMs to teach good moves to POKéMON.
texts.Route14_Text_CarterPostBattle: You have some HMs, right? POKéMON can't forget those moves easily.
texts.Route14_Text_MitchIntro: My bird POKéMON should be ready for battle.
texts.Route14_Text_MitchPostBattle: My bird POKéMON need to learn better moves.
texts.Route14_Text_BeckIntro:
They have TMs on sale at the CELADON DEPT. STORE.

TMs aren't really rare, but not many people have HMs.
texts.Route14_Text_BeckPostBattle:
Try teaching POKéMON a move that's the same type as it.

That apparently boosts the power of the move.
texts.Route14_Text_MarlonIntro:
Have you taught your bird POKéMON how to FLY?

You'll be able to soar with it into the sky!
texts.Route14_Text_MarlonPostBattle: Bird POKéMON are my one true love. I don't want to raise anything else.
texts.Route14_Text_DonaldIntro: Have you heard the legend of the winged mirages?
texts.Route14_Text_DonaldPostBattle:
Well, the winged mirages are the legendary bird POKéMON.

There are three of them: ARTICUNO, ZAPDOS, and MOLTRES.
texts.Route14_Text_BennyIntro: I'm not into it, but okay. Let's go!
texts.Route14_Text_BennyPostBattle: Winning, losing… It's insignificant under this huge sky.
texts.Route14_Text_LukasIntro: C'mon, c'mon. Let's go, let's go, let's go!
texts.Route14_Text_LukasPostBattle: What, what, what? What do you want still?
texts.Route14_Text_IsaacIntro: I need to burn some time. Shut up and battle.
texts.Route14_Text_IsaacPostBattle: Raising POKéMON is a drag, man.
texts.Route14_Text_GeraldIntro: We ride out here because of the wide-open spaces.
texts.Route14_Text_GeraldPostBattle:
It's cool you made your POKéMON so strong.

Might is right! And you know it!
texts.Route14_Text_MalikPostBattle: You know who'd win, you and me one-on-one!
texts.Route14_Text_KiriIntro: KIRI: JAN, let's try really, really hard together.
texts.Route14_Text_KiriDefeat: KIRI: Whimper… We lost, didn't we?
texts.Route14_Text_KiriPostBattle: KIRI: Did we lose because of me?
texts.Route14_Text_KiriNotEnoughMons: KIRI: We can battle if you have two POKéMON.
texts.Route14_Text_JanIntro: JAN: KIRI, here we go! We have to try hard!
texts.Route14_Text_JanPostBattle: JAN: KIRI, don't cry! We'll just try harder next time.
texts.Route14_Text_JanNotEnoughMons: JAN: You want to battle? You don't have enough POKéMON.
texts.Route15_Text_KindraIntro: I just got some POKéMON in trades. Can I try them out on you?
texts.Route15_Text_KindraPostBattle:
You can't change the nickname of any POKéMON you get in a trade.

Only the Original TRAINER can get the nickname changed.
texts.Route15_Text_BeckyIntro:
You look gentle, so I think I can beat you.

I'll give it a go!
texts.Route15_Text_BeckyPostBattle: I'm afraid of BIKERS. They look so ugly and mean!
texts.Route15_Text_EdwinIntro: When I whistle, I can summon bird POKéMON.
texts.Route15_Text_EdwinPostBattle: Maybe I'm not cut out for battles. I'm not the right type, I guess.
texts.Route15_Text_ChesterIntro: Hmm? My birds are shivering! You're good, aren't you?
texts.Route15_Text_ChesterPostBattle:
This is so obvious, you should know this, but…

Moves like EARTHQUAKE and FISSURE have no effect on bird POKéMON.
texts.Route15_Text_GraceIntro: Oh, you're a little cutie! So like a darling POKéMON!
texts.Route15_Text_GracePostBattle: I forgive you. I can take it. I'm a big girl now.
texts.Route15_Text_OliviaIntro: I raise POKéMON for protection because I live alone.
texts.Route15_Text_OliviaDefeat: POKéMON isn't about winning or losing for me.
texts.Route15_Text_OliviaPostBattle:
I love having my POKéMON greet me when I get home.

It's so reassuring.
texts.Route15_Text_ErnestIntro: Hey, kid! C'mon! I just got these off some loser!
texts.Route15_Text_ErnestPostBattle: Life's too short. It's cool to live as an outlaw. TEAM ROCKET RULES!
texts.Route15_Text_AlexIntro: Fork over all your cash when you lose to me, kid!
texts.Route15_Text_AlexPostBattle: I was just joking about the money. Don't take me all serious.
texts.Route15_Text_CeliaIntro: What's cool and happening? Trading POKéMON!
texts.Route15_Text_CeliaPostBattle: I trade POKéMON with my friends all the time.
texts.Route15_Text_YazminIntro: Want to play with my POKéMON?
texts.Route15_Text_YazminPostBattle: I'll go train with weaker people.
texts.Route15_Text_MyaIntro: MYA: You're perfect. Help me train my little brother?
texts.Route15_Text_MyaDefeat: MYA: RON, you have to focus! Concentrate on what you're doing!
texts.Route15_Text_MyaPostBattle: MYA: Okay, we'll turn it up. I'll add to our training menu!
texts.Route15_Text_MyaNotEnoughMons: MYA: Do you want to challenge us? You'll need two POKéMON, though.
texts.Route15_Text_RonIntro: RON: My sister gets scary when we lose.
texts.Route15_Text_RonDefeat: RON: Oh, no, no… Sis, I'm sorry!
texts.Route15_Text_RonPostBattle: RON: Oh, bleah… I wish I had a nice sister…
texts.Route15_Text_RonNotEnoughMons:
RON: Did you want to battle with my sister and me?

You need two POKéMON, then.
texts.Route15_WestEntrance_1F_Text_OaksAideCam:
Are you the kid who's working on a POKéDEX?

PROF. OAK's AIDE came by here.
texts.Route15_WestEntrance_2F_Text_GiveItemIfC:
Hi! Remember me? I'm one of PROF. OAK's AIDES.

If your POKéDEX has complete data on {STR_VAR_1} species, I'm supposed to give you a reward.

PROF. OAK entrusted me with the {STR_VAR_2} for you.

So, {PLAYER}, let me ask you.

Have you gathered data on at least {STR_VAR_1} kinds of POKéMON?
texts.Route15_WestEntrance_2F_Text_GreatHereYo:
Great! You have caught or owned {STR_VAR_3} kinds of POKéMON!

Congratulations! Here you go!
texts.Route15_WestEntrance_2F_Text_ExplainExpS:
EXP. SHARE is an item to be held by a POKéMON.

The POKéMON will receive a share of the EXP. Points without having to battle.
texts.Route15_WestEntrance_2F_Text_LargeShinin:
Let's see what the binoculars have to show…

A large, shining bird is flying toward the sea.
texts.Route15_WestEntrance_2F_Text_SmallIsland:
Let's see what the binoculars have to show…

It looks like a small island on the horizon!
texts.Route16_Text_LaoPostBattle: We like just hanging here. What's it to you?
texts.Route16_Text_KojiPostBattle: Forget it, who needs your BIKE!
texts.Route16_Text_LukeIntro: Come out and play, little mouse!
texts.Route16_Text_LukePostBattle: I hate losing! Get out of my face!
texts.Route16_Text_HideoPostBattle:
We'll always be hanging around here even if you don't like it.

You can detour to VERMILION from FUCHSIA going along the coast.
texts.Route16_Text_CamronIntro: I'm feeling hungry and mean! I need a punching bag!
texts.Route16_Text_CamronPostBattle:
If I'm going to have POKéMON, they may as well be ferocious.

I'd use them to leave my enemies in tatters.
texts.Route16_Text_RubenIntro: Hey, there! Let's have ourselves a good time!
texts.Route16_Text_RubenPostBattle:
I get my kicks by harassing people with my stinking POKéMON.

They're great for startling people. And, they bite, too.
texts.Route16_Text_MonSprawledOutInSlumber: A POKéMON is sprawled out in a deep and comfortable slumber.
texts.Route16_Text_JedIntro: JED: Our love knows no bounds. We're in love and we show it!
texts.Route16_Text_JedDefeat: JED: Oh, no! My love has seen me as a loser!
texts.Route16_Text_JedPostBattle: JED: Listen, LEA. You need to focus less on me.
texts.Route16_Text_JedNotEnoughMons: JED: You have just one POKéMON? Is there no love in your heart?
texts.Route16_Text_LeaIntro: LEA: Sometimes, the intensity of our love scares me.
texts.Route16_Text_LeaDefeat: LEA: Ohh! But JED looks cool even in a loss!
texts.Route16_Text_LeaPostBattle: LEA: Ehehe, I'm sorry. JED is so cool.
texts.Route16_Text_LeaNotEnoughMons:
LEA: Oh, you don't have two POKéMON with you?

Doesn't it feel lonely for you or your POKéMON?
texts.Route16_House_Text_FoundMySecretRetreat:
Oh, dear. You've found my secret retreat.

Please don't tell anyone I'm here. I'll make it up to you with this!
texts.Route16_House_Text_ExplainHM02:
HM02 is FLY. It's a wonderfully convenient move.

Please, put it to good use.
texts.Route16_House_Text_DontHaveAnyRoomForThi: You don't have any room for this.
texts.Route16_NorthEntrance_1F_Text_NoPedestri: No pedestrians are allowed on CYCLING ROAD!
texts.Route16_NorthEntrance_1F_Text_CyclingRoa: CYCLING ROAD is a downhill course by the sea. It's a great ride.
texts.Route16_NorthEntrance_1F_Text_HowdYouGet: How'd you get in? Good effort!
texts.Route16_NorthEntrance_2F_Text_OnBikeRide: I'm on a relaxing ride on my new bike with my girlfriend.
texts.Route16_NorthEntrance_2F_Text_RidingToge: We're going riding together on our new bikes.
texts.Route16_NorthEntrance_2F_Text_ItsCeladon:
Let's see what the binoculars have to show…

It's the CELADON DEPT. STORE!
texts.Route16_NorthEntrance_2F_Text_LongPathOv:
Let's see what the binoculars have to show…

There's a long path over water far away.
texts.Route16_NorthEntrance_2F_Text_GiveAmulet:
Hi! Remember me? I'm one of PROF. OAK's AIDES.

If your POKéDEX has complete data on 40 species, I'm supposed to give you a reward.

PROF. OAK entrusted me with an AMULET COIN for you.

So, {PLAYER}, let me ask you.

Have you gathered data on at least 40 kinds of POKéMON?
texts.Route16_NorthEntrance_2F_Text_GreatHereY:
Great! You have caught or owned {STR_VAR_3} kinds of POKéMON!

Congratulations! Here you go!
texts.Route16_NorthEntrance_2F_Text_ReceivedAm: {PLAYER} received the AMULET COIN from the AIDE.
texts.Route16_NorthEntrance_2F_Text_ExplainAmu:
An AMULET COIN is an item to be held by a POKéMON.

If the POKéMON appears in a winning battle, you will earn more money.
texts.Route17_Text_RaulIntro: There's no getting rich quick in battling kids.
texts.Route17_Text_RaulPostBattle:
You can find good stuff lying around on CYCLING ROAD.

There's good money in picking them up and selling them.
texts.Route17_Text_IsaiahIntro: I'm mighty proud of my bod, kiddo. Come on!
texts.Route17_Text_IsaiahPostBattle: I could belly-bump you outta here!
texts.Route17_Text_BillyIntro: We're BIKERS! We rule the roads, man!
texts.Route17_Text_NikolasPostBattle: I got my VOLTORB at the abandoned POWER PLANT.
texts.Route17_Text_ZeekIntro: I leveled up my POKéMON, but it won't evolve. Why?
texts.Route17_Text_ZeekPostBattle: Maybe some POKéMON need element STONES to evolve.
texts.Route17_Text_JamalPostBattle: I'm sure I lost weight there!
texts.Route17_Text_CoreyPostBattle: Be ready to fight for your beliefs!
texts.Route17_Text_JaxonPostBattle: The slope makes it hard to steer.
texts.Route17_Text_WilliamPostBattle: I need to catch a few z's!
texts.Route17_Text_WatchOutForDiscardedItems:
It's a notice.

Watch out for discarded items.
texts.Route17_Text_SameSpeciesGrowDifferentRat:
TRAINER TIPS

All POKéMON are unique.

Even POKéMON of the same species and level grow at different rates.
texts.Route17_Text_PressBToStayInPlace:
TRAINER TIPS

Press the B Button to stay in place while on a slope.
texts.Route17_Text_DontThrowGameThrowBalls:
It's a notice!

Don't throw the game, throw POKé BALLS instead!
texts.Route18_Text_WiltonIntro: I always check every grassy area for new POKéMON.
texts.Route18_Text_WiltonPostBattle: I wish I had a BIKE!
texts.Route18_Text_RamiroIntro: Kurukkoo! How do you like my birdcall?
texts.Route18_Text_RamiroPostBattle: I collect sea POKéMON on weekends because the sea is so close.
texts.Route18_Text_JacobIntro: This is my turf! Get out of here!
texts.Route18_Text_JacobPostBattle: This is my fave area for catching POKéMON.
texts.Route18_EastEntrance_1F_Text_NeedBicycle: You need a BICYCLE to go out on CYCLING ROAD!
texts.Route18_EastEntrance_1F_Text_CyclingRoad: CYCLING ROAD is all uphill from here.
texts.Route18_EastEntrance_2F_Text_PalletTownI:
Let's see what the binoculars have to show…

PALLET TOWN is in the west.
texts.Route18_EastEntrance_2F_Text_PeopleSwimm:
Let's see what the binoculars have to show…

There are people swimming.
texts.Route19_Text_RichardIntro: I have to exercise and warm up before going out for a swim.
texts.Route19_Text_RichardPostBattle: Thanks, kid! I'm ready for a swim.
texts.Route19_Text_ReeceIntro: Wait! Slow down! You'll have a heart attack!
texts.Route19_Text_ReecePostBattle: Watch out for TENTACOOL. They sting so painfully.
texts.Route19_Text_MatthewIntro: I love swimming! What about you?
texts.Route19_Text_MatthewPostBattle: I can beat even marine POKéMON at swimming.
texts.Route19_Text_DouglasPostBattle: I see a couple of islands over yonder!
texts.Route19_Text_DavidIntro: I tried diving for POKéMON, but it was a no-go.
texts.Route19_Text_DavidPostBattle: I guess you have to fish for sea POKéMON.
texts.Route19_Text_TonyIntro: I look at the sea to forget all the bad things that happened.
texts.Route19_Text_TonyPostBattle: I'm looking at the sea to forget the bad thing that happened!
texts.Route19_Text_AnyaIntro: Oh, I just love your ride! Can I have it if I win?
texts.Route19_Text_AnyaPostBattle:
It's still a long way to go to SEAFOAM ISLANDS…

I want to go back to FUCHSIA…
texts.Route19_Text_AlicePostBattle: My boyfriend wanted to swim to SEAFOAM ISLANDS.
texts.Route19_Text_AxleIntro: Ahoy, there! These waters are treacherous!
texts.Route19_Text_AxlePostBattle: M-my legs! They cramped up! Glub, glub…
texts.Route19_Text_ConnieIntro: I swam here with my friends… I'm tired…
texts.Route19_Text_ConniePostBattle:
If I were to ride a POKéMON on the sea, I'd like a LAPRAS.

LAPRAS is so big, I bet it would keep me dry on water.
texts.Route19_Text_RouteSign: SEA ROUTE 19 FUCHSIA CITY - SEAFOAM ISLANDS
texts.Route19_Text_LiaIntro: LIA: I'm looking after my brother. He just became a TRAINER.
texts.Route19_Text_LiaDefeat: LIA: That's no way to treat my little brother!
texts.Route19_Text_LiaPostBattle:
LIA: Do you have a younger brother?

I hope you're teaching him all sorts of things.
texts.Route19_Text_LiaNotEnoughMons:
LIA: I want to battle together with my little brother.

Don't you have two POKéMON?
texts.Route19_Text_LucIntro: LUC: My big sis taught me how to swim and train POKéMON.
texts.Route19_Text_LucDefeat: LUC: Oh, wow! Someone tougher than my big sis!
texts.Route19_Text_LucPostBattle: LUC: My big sis is strong and nice. I think she's awesome!
texts.Route19_Text_LucNotEnoughMons:
LUC: I don't want to if I can't battle you with my big sis.

Don't you have two POKéMON?
texts.Route20_Text_BarryIntro: The water is shallow here. There are many people swimming.
texts.Route20_Text_BarryPostBattle: I wish I could ride my POKéMON. I bet you're not tired.
texts.Route20_Text_ShirleyIntro: SEAFOAM is a quiet getaway. I'm vacationing here.
texts.Route20_Text_ShirleyPostBattle: There's a huge cavern underneath this island.
texts.Route20_Text_TiffanyIntro: I love floating with the fishes here among the waves.
texts.Route20_Text_IrenePostBattle: SEAFOAM used to be a single island in the distant past.
texts.Route20_Text_DeanPostBattle: I should've been buffing up my POKéMON, not me!
texts.Route20_Text_DarrinIntro: Why are you riding a POKéMON? Can't you swim?
texts.Route20_Text_DarrinPostBattle: Riding a POKéMON sure looks fun!
texts.Route20_Text_RogerIntro: I rode my bird POKéMON here.
texts.Route20_Text_RogerDefeat: Oh, no! Now what am I to do?
texts.Route20_Text_RogerPostBattle: My birds are exhausted. They can't FLY me back!
texts.Route20_Text_NoraIntro: My boyfriend gave me big pearls.
texts.Route20_Text_NoraDefeat: Oh, no! My pearls were in them!
texts.Route20_Text_NoraPostBattle: Will my pearls grow bigger inside CLOYSTER?
texts.Route20_Text_MissyIntro: I swam here from CINNABAR ISLAND. It wasn't easy, I tell you.
texts.Route20_Text_MissyPostBattle:
POKéMON have taken over an abandoned mansion on CINNABAR.

They call it the POKéMON MANSION now.
texts.Route20_Text_MelissaIntro:
CINNABAR, in the west, has a LAB for POKéMON.

My daddy works there.
texts.Route20_Text_MelissaPostBattle:
CINNABAR is a volcanic island.

I heard it rose out of the sea when a volcano erupted.
texts.Route20_Text_MistyTrainsHere:
Strong TRAINERS and WATER POKéMON are common sights in these parts.

They say that MISTY of the CERULEAN GYM trains here.
texts.Route21_North_Text_RonaldIntro: You want to know if the fish are biting?
texts.Route21_North_Text_RonaldPostBattle: I can't catch anything good. Not one good POKéMON to be had!
texts.Route21_North_Text_WadeIntro: I got a big haul! Wanna go for it?
texts.Route21_North_Text_WadeDefeat: Heheh, MAGIKARP just don't make the grade, do they?
texts.Route21_North_Text_WadePostBattle: I seem to only catch MAGIKARP!
texts.Route21_North_Text_SpencerIntro: The sea cleanses my body and soul!
texts.Route21_North_Text_SpencerPostBattle: The sea is great and all, but I like the mountains, too.
texts.Route21_North_Text_CueBallIntro: おれだって　たまには およぎに　くるぜ！
texts.Route21_North_Text_CueBallPostBattle: うきやすそう　だと？ うるせー　おおきな　おせわだッ！
texts.Route21_South_Text_JackIntro: I caught my POKéMON at sea.
texts.Route21_South_Text_JeromeIntro: Right now, I'm in a triathlon meet.
texts.Route21_South_Text_JeromePostBattle: I'm beat! But, I still have the bike race and marathon left!
texts.Route21_South_Text_RolandIntro: Ahh! Feel the sun and the wind!
texts.Route21_South_Text_ClaudeIntro: Hey, don't scare away the fish!
texts.Route21_South_Text_ClaudeDefeat: Sorry! I'm just so frustrated from not catching anything.
texts.Route21_South_Text_ClaudePostBattle: Sheesh, I haven't caught a thing. Could this place actually be a giant pool or something?
texts.Route21_South_Text_NolanIntro: Keep me company till I get a hit.
texts.Route21_South_Text_NolanPostBattle: Oh wait! I got a bite! Yeah!
texts.Route21_North_Text_LilIntro: LIL: Huh? A battle? IAN, can't you do it alone?
texts.Route21_North_Text_LilDefeat: LIL: Oh, see? We lost. Happy now?
texts.Route21_North_Text_LilPostBattle: LIL: I'm tired. Can't we go home already?
texts.Route21_North_Text_LilNotEnoughMons: LIL: Huh? A battle? I can't be bothered to do it alone. Bring two POKéMON, won't you?
texts.Route21_North_Text_IanIntro: IAN: My sis doesn't get enough exercise, so I made her come.
texts.Route21_North_Text_IanDefeat: IAN: Awww, Sis! Get it together!
texts.Route21_North_Text_IanPostBattle:
IAN: Come on, Sis!

You're not going to lose weight like this!
texts.Route21_North_Text_IanNotEnoughMons: IAN: We want a two-on-two battle. So can you bring two POKéMON?
texts.Route22_Text_EarlyRivalIntro:
{RIVAL}: Hey! {PLAYER}!

You're off to the POKéMON LEAGUE? Forget about it!

You probably don't have any BADGES, do you?

The guard won't let you through without them.

By the way, did your POKéMON get any stronger?
texts.Route22_Text_EarlyRivalPostBattle:
I heard the POKéMON LEAGUE is crawling with tough TRAINERS.

I have to figure out how to get past them.

You should quit dawdling and get a move on!
texts.Route22_Text_RivalShouldCatchSomeMons:
{RIVAL}“なんだ？ ポケモン　2ひきも もってるの　なぜか　だって？

おまえも つかまえれば　いい　じゃん！
texts.Route22_Text_LateRivalIntro:
{RIVAL}: What? {PLAYER}! What a surprise to see you here!

So you're going to the POKéMON LEAGUE?

You collected all the BADGES, too? That's cool!

Then I'll whip you, {PLAYER}, as a warm-up for the POKéMON LEAGUE!

Come on!
texts.Route22_Text_LateRivalDefeat:
What!?

I was just careless, you!
texts.Route22_Text_LateRivalPostBattle:
That loosened me up. I'm ready for the POKéMON LEAGUE!

{PLAYER}, you need more practice.

But hey, you know that! I'm out of here. Smell ya!
texts.Route22_Text_LateRivalVictory:
{RIVAL}“ひゃははッ　{PLAYER}ー！ それで　がんばってるのかよ！ おれの　さいのうに　くらべりゃ {PLAYER}は　まだまだ　だな！

もっと　れんしゅう　こいよ！ あははーッ！
texts.Route24_Text_JustEarnedFabulousPrize:
Congratulations! You beat our five contest TRAINERS!

You just earned a fabulous prize!
texts.Route24_Text_ReceivedNuggetFromMysteryTr: {PLAYER} received a NUGGET from the mystery TRAINER!
texts.Route24_Text_JoinTeamRocket:
By the way, how would you like to join TEAM ROCKET?

We're a group of professional criminals specializing in POKéMON!

Want to join?

Are you sure?

Come on, join us!

I'm telling you to join!

…Okay, you need convincing!

I'll make you an offer you can't refuse!
texts.Route24_Text_YoudBecomeTopRocketLeader:
With your ability, you'd become a top leader in TEAM ROCKET.

Come on, think of the opportunity! Don't let this chance go to waste.
texts.Route24_Text_ShaneIntro: I saw your feat from the grass!
texts.Route24_Text_ShanePostBattle: I hid because the people on the bridge frightened me.
texts.Route24_Text_EthanIntro: Okay! I'm No. 5! I'll stomp you!
texts.Route24_Text_EthanPostBattle: I did my best. I have no regrets!
texts.Route24_Text_ReliPostBattle: I did my best, so I've no regrets!
texts.Route24_Text_TimmyIntro: Here's No. 3! I won't be easy!
texts.Route24_Text_TimmyPostBattle: I did my best. I have no regrets!
texts.Route24_Text_AliPostBattle: I did my best. I have no regrets!
texts.Route24_Text_CaleIntro:
People call this the NUGGET BRIDGE!

Beat us five TRAINERS and win a fabulous prize!

Think you got what it takes?
texts.Route24_Text_CalePostBattle: I did my best. I have no regrets!
texts.Route25_Text_JoeyIntro: Local TRAINERS come here to practice.
texts.Route25_Text_JoeyPostBattle:
All POKéMON have weaknesses. Even the strongest ones.

That's why it's best to raise POKéMON of different types.
texts.Route25_Text_DanIntro: Dad took me to a great party on the S.S. ANNE at VERMILION CITY.
texts.Route25_Text_DanPostBattle: On the S.S. ANNE, I saw TRAINERS from around the world.
texts.Route25_Text_FlintIntro: I'm a cool guy. I've got a girlfriend!
texts.Route25_Text_FlintPostBattle: Oh, well. My girlfriend will cheer me up.
texts.Route25_Text_KelseyPostBattle: I wish my boyfriend was as good as you.
texts.Route25_Text_ChadIntro: I had this feeling… I knew I had to battle you!
texts.Route25_Text_ChadPostBattle:
If your POKéMON gets confused, switch it out.

That's a good tactic.
texts.Route25_Text_HaleyIntro: My friend has many cute POKéMON. I'm so jealous!
texts.Route25_Text_HaleyPostBattle: You came from MT. MOON? May I have a CLEFAIRY?
texts.Route25_Text_FranklinIntro: I just got down from MT. MOON, but I've still got gas in the tank!
texts.Route25_Text_FranklinPostBattle: Drat! A ZUBAT bit me back in that cave.
texts.Route25_Text_NobIntro: I'm off to see a POKéMANIAC's collection at the cape.
texts.Route25_Text_NobDefeat: You done got me, and real good, too!
texts.Route25_Text_NobPostBattle:
The POKéMANIAC sure lives up to his name.

His collection includes many rare species of POKéMON.
texts.Route25_Text_WayneIntro: You're going to see BILL? First, we battle!
texts.Route25_Text_WaynePostBattle: The trail below is a shortcut to CERULEAN CITY.
texts.Route25_Text_MistyHighHopesAboutThisPlac:
This cape is a famous date spot.

MISTY, the GYM LEADER, has high hopes about this place.
texts.Route25_Text_AreYouHereAlone:
Hello, are you here alone?

If you're out at CERULEAN's cape… Well, it should be as a couple.
texts.Route25_SeaCottage_Text_ImBillHelpMeOutP:
Hiya! I'm a POKéMON… …No I'm not!

Call me BILL! I'm a true-blue POKéMANIAC!

Hey! What's with that skeptical look?

I'm not joshing you, pal.

I screwed up an experiment and got combined with a POKéMON!

So, how about it? Help me out here!
texts.Route25_SeaCottage_Text_ImBillHelpMeOutL:
Hiya! I'm a POKéMON… …No I'm not!

Call me BILL! I'm a true-blue POKéMANIAC!

Hey! What's with that skeptical look?

I'm not joshing you, lady.

I screwed up an experiment and got combined with a POKéMON!

So, how about it? Help me out here!
texts.Route25_SeaCottage_Text_RunCellSeparatio:
Wait till I get inside the TELEPORTER.

When I do, go to my PC and run the Cell Separation System.
texts.Route25_SeaCottage_Text_NoPleaseChief:
No!? Now don't be so cold!

Come on, you gotta help a guy in deep, deep trouble!

What do you say, chief? Please? Okay? All right!
texts.Route25_SeaCottage_Text_NoPleaseBeautifu:
No!? Now don't be so cold!

Come on, you gotta help a guy in deep, deep trouble!

What do you say, beautiful? Please? Okay? All right!
texts.Route25_SeaCottage_Text_ThanksBudTakeThi:
BILL: Yeehah! Thanks, bud! I owe you one!

So, did you come to see my POKéMON collection?

You didn't? That's a bummer.

I've got to thank you… Oh, here, maybe this'll do.
texts.Route25_SeaCottage_Text_ThanksLadyTakeTh:
BILL: Yeehah! Thanks, lady! I owe you one!

So, did you come to see my POKéMON collection?

You didn't? That's a bummer.

I've got to thank you… Oh, here, maybe this'll do.
texts.Route25_SeaCottage_Text_ReceivedSSTicket: {PLAYER} received an S.S. TICKET from BILL.
texts.Route25_SeaCottage_Text_SSAnnePartyYouGo:
That cruise ship S.S. ANNE is in VERMILION CITY.

I hear there are lots of TRAINERS on board, too.

They invited me to their party, but I can't stand fancy do's.

Why don't you go instead of me? Go on and have a good time.
texts.Route25_SeaCottage_Text_CheckOutRareMons:
BILL: Feel like checking out some of my rare POKéMON on my PC?

Go on, check out my PC.
texts.Route25_SeaCottage_Text_TeleporterIsDisp: TELEPORTER is displayed on the PC monitor.
texts.Route25_SeaCottage_Text_SeeWhichMon: Which POKéMON do you want to see?
texts.Route2_EastBuilding_Text_GiveHM05IfSeen1:
Hi! Remember me? I'm one of PROF. OAK's AIDES.

If your POKéDEX has complete data on ten species, I'm supposed to give you a reward.

PROF. OAK entrusted me with HM05 for you.

So, {PLAYER}, let me ask you.

Have you gathered data on at least ten kinds of POKéMON?
texts.Route2_EastBuilding_Text_GreatHereYouGo:
Great! You have caught or owned {STR_VAR_3} kinds of POKéMON!

Congratulations! Here you go!
texts.Route2_EastBuilding_Text_ExplainHM05:
HM05 contains the hidden move FLASH.

FLASH lights up even the darkest of caves and dungeons.
texts.Route2_EastBuilding_Text_CanGetThroughRo: Once a POKéMON learns FLASH, you can get through ROCK TUNNEL.
texts.Route2_House_Text_FaintedMonsCanUseField:
A fainted POKéMON just has no energy left to battle.

It can still use moves like CUT outside of battle.
texts.Route2_ViridianForest_NorthEntrance_Text:
Many POKéMON live only in forests  and caves.

You need to be persistent and look everywhere to get different kinds.

Have you noticed the skinny trees on the roadside?

They can be cut down by a special POKéMON move, I hear.

Do you know the evolution-cancel technique?

When a POKéMON is evolving, you can stop the process.

It's a technique for raising POKéMON the way they are.
texts.Route2_ViridianForest_SouthEntrance_Text: Are you going to VIRIDIAN FOREST? It's a natural maze in there. Be careful you don't get lost.

RATTATA may be small, but don't underestimate its wicked bite.

Have you caught one already?
texts.Route3_Text_TunnelFromCeruleanTiring:
Whew… I better take a rest… Groan…

That tunnel from CERULEAN takes a lot out of you!
texts.Route3_Text_ColtonIntro: Hey! I saw you in VIRIDIAN FOREST!
texts.Route3_Text_ColtonPostBattle: There are other kinds of POKéMON than the ones you find in forests.
texts.Route3_Text_BenIntro:
Hi! I like shorts!

They're delightfully comfy and easy to wear!
texts.Route3_Text_BenPostBattle:
Are you using a POKéMON CENTER's PC for storing your POKéMON?

Each BOX can hold up to 30 POKéMON.
texts.Route3_Text_JaniceIntro: Excuse me! You looked at me, didn't you?
texts.Route3_Text_JanicePostBattle: You shouldn't be staring if you don't want to battle!
texts.Route3_Text_GregIntro: Are you a TRAINER? Let's get with it right away!
texts.Route3_Text_GregDefeat: If I had new POKéMON, I would've won!
texts.Route3_Text_GregPostBattle: If a POKéMON BOX on the PC gets full, just switch to another BOX.
texts.Route3_Text_SallyIntro: That look you gave me… It's so intriguing!
texts.Route3_Text_SallyPostBattle: You can avoid battles by not letting TRAINERS see you.
texts.Route3_Text_CalvinIntro: Hey! You're not wearing shorts! What's wrong with you?
texts.Route3_Text_CalvinPostBattle: I always wear shorts, even in winter. That's my policy.
texts.Route3_Text_JamesIntro: I'll battle you with the POKéMON I just caught.
texts.Route3_Text_JamesPostBattle: Trained POKéMON are stronger than the wild ones.
texts.Route3_Text_RobinPostBattle: ROUTE 4 is at the foot of MT. MOON.
texts.Route4_Text_TrippedOverGeodude: Ouch! I tripped over a rocky POKéMON, GEODUDE!
texts.Route4_Text_CrissyIntro: I came to MT. MOON in search of mushroom POKéMON.
texts.Route4_Text_CrissyDefeat: After all I did to catch them!
texts.Route4_Text_CrissyPostBattle:
There might not be any more mushrooms here.

I think I got them all.
texts.Text_MegaPunchTeach:
A punch of roaring ferocity!

Packed with destructive power!

When the chips are down, MEGA PUNCH is the ultimate attack! You agree, yes?

Now! Let me teach it to your POKéMON!
texts.Text_MegaPunchDeclined: You'll be back when you understand the worth of MEGA PUNCH.
texts.Text_MegaPunchWhichMon: Fine! Which POKéMON will learn it?
texts.Text_MegaPunchTaught:
Now, we are comrades in the way of punching!

You should go before you're seen by the misguided fool who trains only his silly kicking over there.
texts.Text_MegaKickTeach:
A kick of brutal ferocity!

Packed with destructive power!

When you get right down to it, MEGA KICK is the ultimate attack! Don't you agree?

Okay! I'll teach it to your POKéMON!
texts.Text_MegaKickDeclined: You'll come crawling back when you realize the value of MEGA KICK.
texts.Text_MegaKickWhichMon: All right! Which POKéMON wants to learn it?
texts.Text_MegaKickTaught:
Now, we are soul mates in the way of kicking!

You should run before you're seen by the deluded nitwit who trains only simple punching over there.
texts.Route4_Text_PeopleLikeAndRespectBrock:
Oh, wow, that's the BOULDERBADGE! You got it from BROCK, didn't you?

BROCK is cool. He's not just tough. People like and respect him.

I want to become a GYM LEADER like him.
texts.Route4_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_CanHaveSixM:
Okay, set six POKé BALLS in my belt…

Yeah, that'll do it. At most, you can have six POKéMON with you.
texts.Route4_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_TeamRocketA:
TEAM ROCKET attacks CERULEAN citizens…

Not a day goes by without TEAM ROCKET being in the news.
texts.Route4_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_LaddieBuyMa:
MAN: Hello there, laddie! Have I got a deal just for you!

I'll let you have a secret POKéMON - a MAGIKARP - for just ¥500!

So, you'll buy it, am I right?
texts.Route4_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_SweetieBuyM:
MAN: Hello there, sweetie pie! Have I got a deal just for you!

I'll let you have a secret POKéMON - a MAGIKARP - for just ¥500!

So, you'll buy it, am I right?
texts.Route4_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_PaidOutrage: {PLAYER} paid an outrageous ¥500 and bought the MAGIKARP…
texts.Route4_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_OnlyDoingTh: No? You say no? I'm only doing this as a favor to you!
texts.Route4_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_NoRoomForMo: There's no more room for any more POKéMON, it looks like.
texts.Route4_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_YoullNeedMo: You'll need more money than that!
texts.Route4_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_IDontGiveRe: MAN: Well, I don't give refunds. You knew what you were getting!
texts.Route4_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_ShouldStore:
Sometimes, you'll have too many POKéMON with you to add any more.

In that case, you should just store some using any PC.
texts.Route5_Text_UndergroundPathSign: UNDERGROUND PATH CERULEAN CITY - VERMILION CITY
texts.Route5_PokemonDayCare_Text_WantMeToRaise:
I run the DAY-CARE service.

Would you like me to raise one of your POKéMON?
texts.Route5_PokemonDayCare_Text_LookAfterMonF: Fine, I'll look after your {STR_VAR_1} for a while.
texts.Route5_PokemonDayCare_Text_ComeSeeMeInAW: Come see me in a while.
texts.Route5_PokemonDayCare_Text_MonNeedsToSpe:
You're back already?

Your {STR_VAR_1} needs to spend some more time with me.
texts.Route5_PokemonDayCare_Text_OweMeXForMons: You owe me ¥{STR_VAR_2} for the return of this POKéMON.
texts.Route5_PokemonDayCare_Text_PlayerGotMonB: {PLAYER} got {STR_VAR_1} back from the DAY-CARE MAN.
texts.Route5_PokemonDayCare_Text_OnlyHaveOneMo: Oh? You only have one POKéMON with you.
texts.Route5_PokemonDayCare_Text_WhatWillYouBa: If you leave me that POKéMON, what will you battle with?
texts.Route5_PokemonDayCare_Text_MonHasGrownBy:
Your {STR_VAR_1} has grown a lot. Yes, quite a lot, I'd say.

Let me see… By level, it's grown by {STR_VAR_2}.

Aren't I great?
texts.Route5_PokemonDayCare_Text_YouveGotNoRoo: You can't take this POKéMON back if you've got no room for it.
texts.Route5_PokemonDayCare_Text_WantMeToTakeA: きみの みてみるかね？
texts.Route5_PokemonDayCare_Text_CantAcceptMon: わるいけど　ひでんのわざを　もった ポケモンは　あずかれないなぁ
texts.Route5_SouthEntrance_Text_ThirstyOnGuard:
I'm on guard duty. Gee, I'm thirsty, though!

Oh, wait there, the road's closed.
texts.Route5_SouthEntrance_Text_ThatTeaLooksTa: Oh, that TEA… It looks awfully tasty…
texts.Route5_SouthEntrance_Text_ThanksIllShare:
Huh? I can have this drink? Gee, thanks! … … Glug, glug… … … Gulp… If you want to go to SAFFRON CITY… … … You can go on through.

I'll share this TEA with the other guards!
texts.Route6_Text_RickyIntro: Who's there? Quit listening in on us!
texts.Route6_Text_NancyIntro: Excuse me! This is a private conversation!
texts.Route6_Text_KeigoIntro: There aren't many bugs out here.
texts.Route6_Text_KeigoPostBattle: I like bugs, so I'm going back to VIRIDIAN FOREST.
texts.Route6_Text_JeffIntro: Huh? You want to talk to me?
texts.Route6_Text_JeffDefeat: This stinks… I couldn't beat your challenge…
texts.Route6_Text_JeffPostBattle: I should bring more POKéMON with me. I'll feel safer that way.
texts.Route6_Text_IsabellePostBattle: I want to get stronger. What's your secret?
texts.Route6_Text_ElijahIntro: I've never seen you around. Are you good?
texts.Route6_Text_ElijahPostBattle: Are my POKéMON weak? Or, am I just bad? Which do you think?
texts.Route6_Text_UndergroundPathSign: UNDERGROUND PATH CERULEAN CITY - VERMILION CITY
texts.Route6_NorthEntrance_Text_ThirstyOnGuard:
I'm on guard duty. Gee, I'm thirsty, though!

texts.Route7_EastEntrance_Text_ThirstyOnGuardD:
I'm on guard duty. Gee, I'm thirsty, though!

Oh, wait there, the road's closed.

texts.Route8_Text_AidanIntro: You look good at POKéMON, but how is your chemistry grade?
texts.Route8_Text_AidanPostBattle: I am better at school than this!
texts.Route8_Text_StanIntro: All right! Let's play a game!
texts.Route8_Text_GlennIntro: You should be informed. You need strategy to win at this!
texts.Route8_Text_PaigeIntro: I like NIDORAN, so I collect them!
texts.Route8_Text_PaigePostBattle: When POKéMON grow up, they get ugly! They shouldn't evolve.
texts.Route8_Text_LeslieIntro: School is fun, but so are POKéMON.
texts.Route8_Text_LeslieDefeat: You made it clear to me that I should stick with school.
texts.Route8_Text_LesliePostBattle:
I was planning on getting some fresh air for a change, but…

We're stuck here because of the gates at SAFFRON.
texts.Route8_Text_AndreaIntro: MEOWTH is so cute, meow, meow, meow!
texts.Route8_Text_AndreaPostBattle: I think PIDGEY and RATTATA are cute, too!
texts.Route8_Text_MeganIntro: We must look silly standing here like this.
texts.Route8_Text_MeganDefeat: Look what you did to my poor, cute POKéMON!
texts.Route8_Text_MeganPostBattle:
SAFFRON's gatekeeper won't let us go through.

I know he's doing his job, but I think he's mean.
texts.Route8_Text_RichPostBattle: Playing games and POKéMON are like eating peanuts! I just can't stop!
texts.Route8_Text_JuliaIntro: What's a cute, round, and fluffy POKéMON?
texts.Route8_Text_JuliaDefeat:
Stop!

Don't be so mean to my CLEFAIRY!
texts.Route8_Text_JuliaPostBattle:
I read that CLEFAIRY evolves when it's exposed to a MOON STONE.

I read that in a POKéMON JOURNAL. I wonder if it's true?
texts.Route8_Text_UndergroundPathSign: UNDERGROUND PATH CELADON CITY - LAVENDER TOWN
texts.Route8_Text_EliIntro: ELI: Twin power is fantastic. Did you know?
texts.Route8_Text_EliDefeat: ELI: But… We used our twin power…
texts.Route8_Text_EliPostBattle: ELI: I caught my POKéMON with ANNE!
texts.Route8_Text_EliNotEnoughMons: ELI: We can't battle if you don't have two POKéMON.
texts.Route8_Text_AnneIntro: ANNE: We'll shock you with our twin power!
texts.Route8_Text_AnnePostBattle: ANNE: I'm raising POKéMON with ELI.
texts.Route8_Text_AnneNotEnoughMons: ANNE: Hi, hi! Let's battle! But bring two POKéMON.
texts.Route8_Text_RicardoDefeat: Aww, man. I'm not into this.
texts.Route8_Text_RicardoPostBattle: I got grass caught up in my spokes, man.
texts.Route8_Text_JarenIntro: Clear the way, or I'll run you down!
texts.Route8_Text_JarenPostBattle: Don't think you're all special and all just because of this.
texts.Route8_WestEntrance_Text_ThirstyOnGuardD:
I'm on guard duty. Gee, I'm thirsty, though!

Oh, wait there, the road's closed.
texts.Route8_WestEntrance_Text_ThatTeaLooksTas: Oh, that TEA… It looks awfully tasty…

Huh? I can have this drink? Gee, thanks! … … Glug, glug… … … Gulp… If you want to go to SAFFRON CITY… … … You can go on through.

I'll share this TEA with the other guards!
texts.Route9_Text_AliciaIntro: You have POKéMON with you! You're mine!
texts.Route9_Text_AliciaPostBattle:
The tunnel coming up is pitch-black inside.

You'll need FLASH to get through there.
texts.Route9_Text_ChrisIntro: Who's that walking there with those good-looking POKéMON?
texts.Route9_Text_DrewIntro: I'm taking the ROCK TUNNEL to go to LAVENDER…
texts.Route9_Text_DrewPostBattle: Are you off to ROCK TUNNEL, too?
texts.Route9_Text_CaitlinPostBattle: You're obviously talented. Good luck to you!
texts.Route9_Text_JeremyIntro: Bwahaha! Great! I was bored, eh!
texts.Route9_Text_JeremyDefeat:
Keep it coming, eh!

Oh wait. I'm out of POKéMON!
texts.Route9_Text_JeremyPostBattle: You sure had guts standing up to me there, eh?
texts.Route9_Text_BriceIntro: Hahaha! Aren't you a little toughie!
texts.Route9_Text_BrentIntro: I got up early every day to raise my POKéMON from cocoons!
texts.Route9_Text_BrentDefeat:
WHAT?

What a total waste of time!
texts.Route9_Text_BrentPostBattle: I have to collect more than bugs to get stronger…
texts.Route9_Text_AlanPostBattle: Hahahaha! Us hearty guys always laugh!
texts.Route9_Text_ConnerPostBattle: If you don't like BUG POKéMON, you bug me!
texts.SafariZone_Center_Text_PressStartToCheck:
TRAINER TIPS

Press START to check remaining time.
texts.SafariZone_Center_Text_WhereDidErikGo: SARA: Where did my boyfriend, ERIK, go?
texts.SafariZone_Center_Text_CatchingMonsAsGif: I'm catching POKéMON to take home as gifts.
texts.SafariZone_East_Text_TimeDeclinesOnlyWhi:
TRAINER TIPS

The remaining time declines only while you walk.
texts.SafariZone_East_Text_HowManyDidYouCatch: How many did you catch? I'm bushed from the effort!
texts.SafariZone_East_Text_CaughtChanseyAllWor:
I caught a CHANSEY!

That makes this all worthwhile.
texts.SafariZone_East_Text_TiredFromAllTheFun: Whew! I'm tired from all the fun!
texts.SafariZone_North_Text_SecretHouseStillAh:
TRAINER TIPS

The SECRET HOUSE is still ahead.
texts.SafariZone_North_Text_ZigzagThroughTallG:
TRAINER TIPS

POKéMON hide in tall grass.

Zigzag through grassy areas to flush them out.
texts.SafariZone_North_Text_WinFreeHMFindSecre:
TRAINER TIPS

Win a free HM for finding the SECRET HOUSE.
texts.SafariZone_East_Text_KeepAnyItemFoundOnS:
You can keep any item you find in the SAFARI ZONE.

But, you'll run out of time if you try for all of them at once.
texts.SafariZone_East_Text_PrizeInDeepestPartO: Go to the deepest part of the SAFARI ZONE. You will win a prize!
texts.SafariZone_East_Text_MyEeveeEvolvedIntoF:
My EEVEE evolved into FLAREON.

But, a friend's EEVEE turned into a VAPOREON. I wonder why?
texts.SafariZone_SecretHouse_Text_CongratsYouv:
Ah! Finally!

You're the first person to reach the SECRET HOUSE!

Although I made a campaign for our grand opening,

I was getting worried that no one would win our campaign prize.

Congratulations! You have won!
texts.SafariZone_SecretHouse_Text_ExplainSurf:
HM03 is SURF.

POKéMON will be able to ferry you across water using it.

And, this HM isn't disposable, so you can use it over and over.

You're super lucky for winning this fabulous prize!
texts.SafariZone_SecretHouse_Text_DontHaveRoom: You don't have room for this fabulous prize!
texts.SafariZone_West_Text_PleaseFindWardensLo:
REQUEST NOTICE

Please find the SAFARI WARDEN's lost GOLD TEETH. They're around here somewhere.

Reward offered! Contact: WARDEN
texts.SafariZone_West_Text_SearchForSecretHous:
TRAINER TIPS

Zone Exploration Campaign! The Search for the SECRET HOUSE!
texts.SafariZone_West_Text_KogaPatrolsSafariEv:
The SAFARI ZONE's huge, wouldn't you say?

FUCHSIA's GYM LEADER, KOGA,  patrols the grounds every so often.

Thanks to him, we can play here knowing that we're safe.
texts.SafariZone_West_Text_RocksMakeMonRunButE: Tossing ROCKS at POKéMON might make them run, but they'll be easier to catch.
texts.SafariZone_West_Text_BaitMakesMonStickAr: Using BAIT will make POKéMON more likely to stick around if they get busy eating.
texts.SafariZone_West_Text_HikedLotsDidntSeeMo: I hiked a lot, but I didn't see any POKéMON I wanted.
texts.SaffronCity_Text_WhatDoYouWantGetLost: What do you want? Get lost!
texts.SaffronCity_Text_BossTakeTownForTeamRock: BOSS said he'll take this town in the name of TEAM ROCKET!
texts.SaffronCity_Text_DontGetDefiantOrIllHurt: Don't get defiant! Or I'll have to hurt you!
texts.SaffronCity_Text_CriminalLifeMakesMeFeel: My life as a criminal makes me feel so alive!
texts.SaffronCity_Text_WeCanExploitMonsAroundW:
With SILPH under control, we can exploit POKéMON around the world!

We'll get stinking rich, yeahah!
texts.SaffronCity_Text_YouBeatTeamRocket: You beat TEAM ROCKET all alone? That's amazing!
texts.SaffronCity_Text_SafeToGoOutAgain: Yeah! TEAM ROCKET is gone! It's safe to go out again!
texts.SaffronCity_Text_PeopleComingBackToSaffr:
People fled from here in droves when those ROCKETS came.

They should be flocking back to SAFFRON now.
texts.SaffronCity_Text_FlewHereOnPidgeot:
I flew here on my PIDGEOT when I read about SILPH.

It's already over? I missed the media action…
texts.SaffronCity_Text_SawRocketBossEscaping: I saw the ROCKET BOSS escaping SILPH's building.
texts.SaffronCity_Text_ImASecurityGuard:
I'm a security guard.

Suspicious kids I don't allow in!
texts.SaffronCity_Text_HesTakingASnooze:
… Snore…

Hah! He's taking a snooze!
texts.SaffronCity_Text_CitySign: SAFFRON CITY Shining, Golden Land of Commerce
texts.SaffronCity_Text_GymSign: SAFFRON CITY POKéMON GYM LEADER: SABRINA The Master of PSYCHIC POKéMON!
texts.SaffronCity_Text_FullHealCuresStatus:
TRAINER TIPS

FULL HEAL cures all ailments like burns, paralysis, poisoning, freezing, and sleep.

It costs a bit more, but it's more convenient than buying other items.
texts.SaffronCity_Text_GreatBallImprovedCatchR:
TRAINER TIPS

The new GREAT BALL offers improved catching rates.

Try it on those hard-to-catch POKéMON.
texts.SaffronCity_Text_SilphsLatestProduct: SILPH's latest product! Release to be determined…
texts.SaffronCity_Text_TrainerFanClubSign:
POKéMON TRAINER FAN CLUB

Many TRAINERS have scribbled their names on this sign.
texts.SaffronCity_Text_HowCanClubNotRecognizeL:
This FAN CLUB… No one here has a clue!

How could they not recognize the brilliance that is LANCE?

He stands for justice! He's cool, and yet passionate! He's the greatest, LANCE!
texts.SaffronCity_CopycatsHouse_1F_Text_Daught: My daughter is so self-centered. She has but a few friends.

My daughter likes to mimic people. It's rather vexing.

Her mimicry has earned her the nickname COPYCAT around here.

{PLAYER}: Pardon? You're weird!   COPYCAT: Hmm? Quit mimicking? But that's my favorite hobby!
texts.Text_MimicTeach:
Oh wow! A POKé DOLL!

For me? Thank you!

You know what? I can teach the move MIMIC.
texts.Text_MimicWhichMon: I really love MIMIC! Who's going to learn it?
texts.Text_MimicTaughtMale:
{PLAYER}: Hi! Thanks for earlier!

{PLAYER}: Pardon?

{PLAYER}: Is it that fun to mimic my every move?

COPYCAT: You bet! It's a scream!
texts.Text_MimicTaughtFemale:
{PLAYER}: Hi! Thanks for what you did for us.

{PLAYER}: Pardon?

{PLAYER}: Is it really that fun to copy what I say and do?

COPYCAT: You bet! It's a scream!

texts.SaffronCity_CopycatsHouse_2F_Text_Doduo:
DODUO: Giiih!

PRETTY MIRROR LOOK AT ME, SEE HOW PRETTY I CAN BE?
texts.SaffronCity_CopycatsHouse_2F_Text_RareMo: This is a rare POKéMON! Huh? It's only a doll!
texts.SaffronCity_CopycatsHouse_2F_Text_MarioW: A game with MARIO wearing a bucket on his head!
texts.SaffronCity_CopycatsHouse_2F_Text_MySecr:
…

My Secrets!

Skill: Mimicry! Hobby: Collecting dolls! Favorite POKéMON: CLEFAIRY!
texts.SaffronCity_Dojo_Text_MasterKoichiIntro:
Grunt!

I am the KARATE MASTER! I am the LEADER here!

You wish to challenge us? Expect no mercy!

Fwaaa!
texts.SaffronCity_Dojo_Text_ChoosePrizedFighti:
Indeed, I have lost!

But, I beseech you, do not take our emblem as your trophy!

In return, I will give you a prized FIGHTING POKéMON!

Choose whichever one you like!
texts.SaffronCity_Dojo_Text_StayAndTrainWithUs: Grunt! Stay and train at karate with us!
texts.SaffronCity_Dojo_Text_MikePostBattle: You wait 'til you see our MASTER! I'm a small fry compared to him!
texts.SaffronCity_Dojo_Text_HidekiIntro: I hear you're good! Show me!
texts.SaffronCity_Dojo_Text_HidekiPostBattle: Our MASTER is a pro fighter. Be prepared to lose!
texts.SaffronCity_Dojo_Text_AaronIntro:
Hiyah! I have no fear for anything tough!

I shatter boulders for training every day!
texts.SaffronCity_Dojo_Text_AaronPostBattle: The only thing that frightens us is psychic power!
texts.SaffronCity_Dojo_Text_HitoshiIntro:
Hwaah!

You're trespassing in our FIGHTING DOJO!
texts.SaffronCity_Dojo_Text_HitoshiPostBattle: The prime fighters across the land train here.
texts.SaffronCity_Dojo_Text_ReceivedMonFromKar: {PLAYER} received the {STR_VAR_1} from the KARATE MASTER.
{PLAYER}は　カラテ　だいおう　から {STR_VAR_1}を　もらった！
texts.SaffronCity_Gym_Text_SabrinaIntro:
I had a vision of your arrival.

I have had psychic powers since I was a child.

It started when a spoon I carelessly tossed, bent.

I dislike battling, but if you wish, I will show you my powers!{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}
texts.SaffronCity_Gym_Text_SabrinaDefeat:
This loss shocks me! But, a loss is a loss.

I admit, I didn't work hard enough to win.

Your victory has earned you the MARSHBADGE.
texts.SaffronCity_Gym_Text_SabrinaPostBattle:
Psychic power isn't something that only a few people have.

Everyone has psychic power. People just don't realize it.
texts.SaffronCity_Gym_Text_ExplainMarshBadgeTa:
The MARSHBADGE makes POKéMON up to Lv. 70 obey you.

Stronger POKéMON will become wild, ignoring your orders in battle.

Just don't raise your POKéMON too much to avoid that problem.

Wait, please take this TM with you.
texts.SaffronCity_Gym_Text_ExplainTM04:
TM04 is CALM MIND.

It makes the POKéMON concentrate to raise both SP. ATK and SP. DEF.
texts.SaffronCity_Gym_Text_BagFullOfOtherItems: Your BAG is full of other items.
texts.SaffronCity_Gym_Text_AmandaIntro: SABRINA is far younger than I, but she has earned my respect.
texts.SaffronCity_Gym_Text_AmandaPostBattle:
In a battle of equals, the one with the stronger will wins.

If you wish to beat SABRINA, focus and will yourself to victory.
texts.SaffronCity_Gym_Text_JohanIntro: Does our unseen power scare you?
texts.SaffronCity_Gym_Text_JohanPostBattle: PSYCHIC POKéMON fear only ghosts and bugs!
texts.SaffronCity_Gym_Text_StacyIntro:
POKéMON take on the appearance of their TRAINERS.

Your POKéMON must be tough, then!
texts.SaffronCity_Gym_Text_StacyPostBattle:
I have much to learn still…

I must master PSYCHIC and teach it to my POKéMON…
texts.SaffronCity_Gym_Text_TyronIntro:
You understand, don't you?

That power alone isn't enough to win in the world of POKéMON?
texts.SaffronCity_Gym_Text_TyronPostBattle: SABRINA just wiped out the KARATE MASTER next door.
texts.SaffronCity_Gym_Text_TashaIntro: You and I, our POKéMON shall battle!
texts.SaffronCity_Gym_Text_TashaPostBattle: I knew that this was going to take place.
texts.SaffronCity_Gym_Text_CameronIntro:
SABRINA is young, but she's also our highly skilled LEADER.

You won't reach her easily!
texts.SaffronCity_Gym_Text_CameronPostBattle:
There used to be two POKéMON GYMS in SAFFRON.

The FIGHTING DOJO next door lost its GYM status, though.

We simply creamed them when we decided to have just one GYM.
texts.SaffronCity_Gym_Text_PrestonIntro:
SAFFRON POKéMON GYM is famous for training psychics.

You want to see SABRINA, don't you? I can tell!
texts.SaffronCity_Gym_Text_PrestonPostBattle: That's right! I used telepathy to read your mind!
texts.SaffronCity_Gym_Text_GymGuyAdvice:
Yo! Champ in the making!

SABRINA's POKéMON use psychic power instead of force.

FIGHTING POKéMON are especially weak against PSYCHIC POKéMON.

They'll get destroyed before they can even aim a punch!
texts.SaffronCity_Gym_Text_GymGuyPostVictory:
Psychic power, huh?

If I had that, I'd make a bundle at the slots!
texts.SaffronCity_Gym_Text_GymStatue:
SAFFRON POKéMON GYM LEADER: SABRINA

WINNING TRAINERS: {RIVAL}
texts.SaffronCity_Gym_Text_GymStatuePlayerWon:
SAFFRON POKéMON GYM LEADER: SABRINA

WINNING TRAINERS: {RIVAL}, {PLAYER}
texts.SaffronCity_House_Text_DontLookAtMyLette:
…Thank you for writing. I hope to see you soon!

…Hey! Don't look at my letter!
texts.SaffronCity_House_Text_GettingCopycatPok: The COPYCAT is cute! I'm getting her a POKé DOLL.
texts.SaffronCity_House_Text_ExplainPPUp:
I was given a PP UP as a gift.

It's used to increase the PP of a POKéMON's move.

I should use it on a powerful move with only a few PP.
texts.SaffronCity_Mart_Text_MaxRepelMoreEffect:
MAX REPEL keeps weaker POKéMON from appearing.

MAX REPEL stays effective longer than SUPER REPEL.
texts.SaffronCity_Mart_Text_ReviveIsCostly: REVIVE is costly, but it revives fainted POKéMON!
texts.SaffronCity_MrPsychicsHouse_Text_YouWant:
…Wait! Don't say a word!

You wanted this!
texts.SaffronCity_MrPsychicsHouse_Text_Explain:
You already know, don't you? TM29 is PSYCHIC.

It's an attack that may also lower the target's special stats.
texts.SaffronCity_MrPsychicsHouse_Text_YouveNo: Where do you plan to put this? You've no room.
texts.SaffronCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Growth: POKéMON growth rates differ from species to species.
texts.SaffronCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_SilphC:
SILPH CO. is widely known to all.

It's a victim of its own fame - it attracted TEAM ROCKET.
texts.SaffronCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_GreatI:
Sigh… Wouldn't this be great?

If the ELITE FOUR came and stomped TEAM ROCKET?
texts.SaffronCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_TeamRo: TEAM ROCKET took off! We can go out safely again! That's great!
texts.SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_Y:
Are you maybe… … …

You are! You are {PLAYER}!

We were just talking about you!

We were talking about how an incredibly good TRAINER appeared.

And that someone is you! You're so cool!

So, we decided that we'll become your FAN CLUB!

We all hope you'll keep battling and show us how cool you are.

That way, maybe other people will become fans just like me.
texts.SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_A:
I'll always be cheering for you!

Go, {PLAYER}, go!
texts.SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_I:
I'll always believe in you, {PLAYER}.

Please show the others what you're like when you battle seriously.
texts.SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_W:
I'm sorry. I was your fan before.

But now, you seem to have lost the drive you had before.

Lately, I think {STR_VAR_1} has been a lot cooler.
texts.SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_E:
Oh! {PLAYER}!

Everyone's been all excited about you recently.

I can understand why. I know that you're strong.

But, do you know what?

Once I became {STR_VAR_1}'s fan, I can't just stop being a fan.
texts.SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_T:
I think TRAINERS are so cool when they're battling.

Don't you think so, too?
texts.SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_C:
Oh! It's {PLAYER}! Too cool!

Oh! Oh, yeah!

Can you autograph something? How about my shorts?

However hot it's been…

And however cold it may get…

I've always believed in, and worn, shorts!

I'm counting on you to keep winning!

I believe in you just as much as I believe in shorts!
texts.SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_B:
BROCK's my hero! He's a man among men!

Heheh, I got my mom to do something for me.

I got her to embroider “BROCK” on my shorts!

…  …

…  … I'm BROCK's fan!

Even if I were his only fan, I swear it on my rock-hard will, and on my shorts!

I'll be his fan to the bitter end!

BROCK's the last word on cool, end of story!

Now there's a guy who I want to be like!
texts.SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_H:
{PLAYER}, I've had the pleasure of watching you battle.

It brings back sweet memories of my own long-lost youth.

May you continue to find success. You have a fan in me!
texts.SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_N:
I have journeyed far and wide across the lands.

But never have I seen a TRAINER of your magnificence.

Take courage in your abilities and keep battling on!

Make that a promise to me, my young idol!
texts.SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_H:
Hmm… And you are?

Were you hoping to sign up for a membership in our FAN CLUB?
texts.SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_Y:
Ah, so you are the much- talked-about {PLAYER}.

You certainly do have the look of a winner.

But for me to accept you as a true POKéMON great…

… …

You've still a ways to go!

All of us gathered here are fans of POKéMON TRAINERS.

The way they look in battle… They are the picture of coolness.

Perhaps you will be talked about here, too, if you keep winning.
texts.SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_W:
It's {PLAYER}! It's {PLAYER}!

I want to be like {PLAYER} one day!
texts.SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_E:
Everyone stopped being {PLAYER}'s fan…

But that means I can have {PLAYER} all to myself!

Yay! Go for it! My one and only {PLAYER}!
texts.SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_W:
Do you know what? I want to be like SABRINA!

I want to be a psychic girl just like her!

Even if I'm the only one, I won't stop being SABRINA's fan.

My dream is to be like SABRINA, cute, but cool.

I want to be a psychic girl just like her!
texts.SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_C: I wonder if I can become a cool TRAINER one day?
texts.SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_T:
Oh, man, oh, man! Cool! Too cool!

…Huh? No, not you.

Just the way you battle. That's cool.
texts.SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_I:
Yo, {PLAYER}!

Looks like I'm the only one left out of your fans.

But, you know, I like being an only fan… It's less stressful.

Keep up and at it!
texts.SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_L:
{STR_VAR_1}'s cool, huh? I love the way he talks.

I'd really relish a chance to meet him in person once.
texts.SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_I:
Huh, can you believe it? Everyone turned into your fans.

So after all we've been through, I'm the lone {STR_VAR_1} fan?

Eh, being the one and only {STR_VAR_1} fan's my style, anyway.
texts.SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_A:
Oh, my goodness! Is it really you, {PLAYER}?

I have to tell you, I adore the way you battle.

I hope you'll keep at it. I'll be your number one fan!
texts.SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_I:
Oh, my goodness! If it isn't {PLAYER}!

It's so disappointing… I realized I'm your number-one-and-only fan!

Well, it can't be helped! Let me cheer you on, at least!

Hurray, hurray, {PLAYER}!
texts.SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_T:
Recently, {STR_VAR_1} has been on fire.

The way he battles… It's just  the way that I like it!
texts.SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_E:
Oh, hello! If it isn't {PLAYER}!

Lately, all everyone talks about is you.

I'm feeling lonesome because I prefer {STR_VAR_1}.
texts.SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_Y:
Amazing! {PLAYER}, you really are amazing!

Instead of just watching, maybe I should become a TRAINER, too.
texts.SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_I:
I'm your only fan… Sigh… This is lonely…

Can't you try harder and make the others take notice of you?
texts.SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_W:
Master {STR_VAR_1} is so dignified… He is so my type.

Why can't the others see the dignity he simply oozes?
texts.SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_B:
I believe in Master {STR_VAR_1} with all my heart.

Even if I am the only one to believe in him.

I won't ever feel lonesome, though.

Not if I keep thinking about Master {STR_VAR_1}.
texts.SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_Y:
Hiyah!

Your battling style is most educational.

I hope that you will keep plugging away at success, hiyah!
texts.SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_W:
Instead of just watching others battle, battle yourself!

…My DOJO's MASTER chewed me out like that…

But I won't let that stop me from being your fan!

I can't stop being your fan!
texts.SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_O:
Hiyah! There is but one TRAINER who has my respect.

And that is none other than my MASTER at the FIGHTING DOJO.

You should become a fan of my MASTER like me! Hiyah!
texts.SaffronCity_PokemonTrainerFanClub_Text_N:
Hiyah! I respect my MASTER at the FIGHTING DOJO.

I will never become a fan of anyone other than my MASTER!

I will even sneak out of the DOJO to spread word of his greatness.

Hiyah!
texts.Text_RockSlideTeach:
When you're up on a rocky mountain like this, rockslides are a threat.

Can you imagine? Boulders tumbling down on you?

That'd be, like, waaaaaaaaaaah! Total terror!

You don't seem to be scared. Want to try using ROCK SLIDE?
texts.Text_RockSlideDeclined: Oh, so you are scared after all.
texts.Text_RockSlideWhichMon: Which POKéMON should I teach ROCK SLIDE?
texts.Text_RockSlideTaught: It might be scary to use it in this tunnel…
texts.SeafoamIslands_B4F_Text_BouldersMightCha: Hint: Boulders might change the flow of water.
texts.Text_SwordsDanceTeach:
Not many people come out here.

If I train here, I'm convinced that I'll get stronger and stronger.

Yep, stronger and stronger…

How would you like to learn a move like that? It's SWORDS DANCE.
texts.Text_SwordsDanceWhichMon: All right, pick which POKéMON I should teach it to.
texts.Text_SwordsDanceTaught: If only we could keep getting stronger and stronger, eh?
texts.SevenIsland_Text_IslandSign: SEVEN ISLAND Quest Island of Infinity
texts.SevenIsland_Text_IslandsMadeInSevenDays:
These islands are called the SEVII ISLANDS because there are seven.

…Or at least that's what the young people believe.

The truth is, these islands are so named because they are said to have been made in seven days.
texts.SevenIsland_Text_IslandVirtuallyUntouche:
This island has been left virtually untouched in its natural state.

It could be a little difficult to hike around because of that.
texts.SevenIsland_House_Room1_Text_OnlyEnjoyme:
I may not look like much now, but when I was younger…

I flew everywhere, challenging TRAINERS wherever I found them.

Now, my only source of enjoyment is reminiscing about the past while watching battles.
texts.SevenIsland_House_Room1_Text_SlightBreez: There is a slight breeze blowing around the box.
texts.SevenIsland_House_Room1_Text_ChallengeVi:
Ah! Welcome, my friend!

Let me tell you something. There's a hidden room in the basement.

A TRAINER named {STR_VAR_1} is waiting there now.

Tell me, you did come to challenge {STR_VAR_1}, am I right?
texts.SevenIsland_House_Room1_Text_OhYouWontBa:
Oh… You won't battle…

I see, I see. … …

Well, perhaps if you change your mind, do come back.
texts.SevenIsland_House_Room1_Text_LimitThreeM:
Ah! You will battle for me?

It was worth my time moving the box aside, then.

… … But there is one slight problem.

This hidden room is not built very sturdy.

Can I get you to limit it to battles of three POKéMON per side?
texts.SevenIsland_House_Room1_Text_SaveProgres: Fine! Before your battle, would you like to save your game?
