texts.SevenIsland_House_Room1_Text_DontHoldAny: All right. Don't hold anything back!
texts.SevenIsland_House_Room2_Text_MatchEndedU: The match ended up a draw.
texts.SevenIsland_House_Room1_Text_DrawWasIt:
A draw, was it?

However, let me say that it was a worthy spectacle.

I'd say it was a wonderful battle with a real sense of depth!
texts.SevenIsland_House_Room1_Text_AstoundingB:
Bravo!

Bravo, indeed! What an astounding battle!

It was so astounding, why, it keeps filling my eyes with tears!

The thrust and parry of expertly used techniques!

The clash of power upon power!

Yes! It was sheer magnificence!
texts.SevenIsland_House_Room1_Text_FeelYourDis:
Too bad! I feel your disappointment.

However, that disappointment is what will make you better.

Use it, learn from it, and make it motivate you to seek greatness.

Forget not this disappointment and redouble your training!
texts.SevenIsland_Mart_Text_MonHavePersonaliti:
POKéMON have personalities of their own, just like people.

My PIKACHU has a HASTY nature, so it grew to be a speedy POKéMON.
texts.SevenIsland_Mart_Text_PreparationsComple: Okay, preparations are complete for me to explore the RUINS.
texts.SevenIsland_Mart_Text_NeedToFishOnSevenI:
I need to fish on SEVEN ISLAND.

That will complete my fishing tour of the SEVII ISLANDS.

I'd better stock up on some POKé BALLS first, though.
texts.SevenIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Events:
On this island, different events occur depending on connections.

What are those connections?

They are for you to discover on your own.
texts.SevenIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_DidYou:
Did you ride a SEAGALLOP ferry to get here?

There are at least ten of those high-speed ships.

I don't know where they all go, though.
texts.SevenIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_CheckO: If you're confident, you should check out TRAINER TOWER.
texts.SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_CyndyPost: The way I am now, I may have to hold off on TRAINER TOWER…
texts.SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_EvanIntro:
It doesn't matter if you happen to have the strongest POKéMON…

It doesn't mean a thing if you don't know how to use them properly!
texts.SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_EvanPostB:
You see them every so often, TRAINERS with awesome POKéMON who have no idea what to do.

Before training POKéMON, TRAINERS themselves need to grow up.
texts.SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_JacksonIn: I work to protect the environment. In turn, nature protects me!
texts.SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_JacksonDe: Whoa! You're tough! How about protecting me?
texts.SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_JacksonPo:
From far out among the stars, our planet is just a drop of water.

But we want to protect that drop of water for everyone.
texts.SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_KatelynIn: Those shoes you have are pretty snazzy.
texts.SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_KatelynDe: You're hot stuff in spite of your cute looks.
texts.SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_KatelynPo:
Your mom bought those snazzy RUNNING SHOES for you?

She must adore you.
texts.SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_LeroyIntr: You look strong. Let me battle you, please!
texts.SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_LeroyDefe: I knew it! You're as tough as I thought!
texts.SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_LeroyPost:
The way you battle has given me a lot of useful data.

Thanks so much!
texts.SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_MichelleI:
I was given the best possible education to become this strong.

I don't want to lose to anyone!
texts.SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_MichelleD: Thank you. I feel like I've been set free by losing to you.
texts.SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_MichelleP:
For some reason, I get furious over the slightest thing.

I'll calm myself by breathing deeply.
texts.SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_LexIntro: LEX: My darling NYA, together we could win!
texts.SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_LexDefeat: LEX: I seem to have been too careless…
texts.SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_LexPostBa:
LEX: I think it was a good experience for NYA.

You have my gratitude.
texts.SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_LexNotEno: LEX: May I ask you to battle the both of us at the same time?
texts.SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_NyaIntro: NYA: I'll do my best so I won't drag down my mentor, LEX!
texts.SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_NyaDefeat: NYA: Oh, no… I'm so sorry, I…
texts.SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_NyaPostBa:
NYA: I think I'm going to need much more seasoning and tutoring under LEX…

…So, LEX, please, may I stay with you like this?
texts.SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_NyaNotEno: NYA: I'm sorry, but may we battle in two-on-two style?
texts.SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_BrunoTrai:
Training by oneself is certainly not a bad thing.

But it's also not bad to aim for the top with a partner.

Even BRUNO… He trained with a fellow by the name of BRAWLY before.
texts.SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Entrance_Text_: Kyahaha! I'll flick you away effortlessly!
Tch! Too strong for me!

What's that? I don't act the way I look?

Heh, that's a part of my strategy!
Howdy! Are you a member of my fan club?

Oh, so you're not a fan…

Well, I can change that. Let me sing for you!
Lalalah… My POKéMON, I send them out, all the girls scream and shout!
This island is too spread out… It's not easy patrolling the place.
Uh-huh…

TRAINERS like you from cities, they sure are tough.

You'll be headed for the TOWER, won't you?
I punish people who abuse POKéMON!
You don't seem to be a problem TRAINER.
If you treat your POKéMON with kindness, they'll understand.
EVE: I'll team up with JON and battle together.
EVE: Me and JON, we lost. Ehehe.
EVE: I'm going to work harder with JON.

EVE: I want to team up with JON when I battle you.

Come back with two POKéMON, okay?
JON: When I'm with EVE, it feels like we could never lose.
JON: When I'm with EVE, it doesn't feel like I've lost!

JON: When I'm with EVE, I feel giddy whether I win or lose.

It's magical!

JON: If it's with EVE, I'll be happy to battle with you.

So, I'd like to make it a two-on-two battle, if I may.

SEVAULT CANYON ENTRANCE

TRAINERS are asked to refrain from damaging plants in the CANYON.
texts.SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_House_Text_Cha:
Dance, dance! CHANSEY Dance!

You join in, too! Dance, dance!
texts.SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_House_Text_You:
Ahahahaha!

There, you're all chipper now! Lucky!
texts.SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_TanobyKey_Text: A mysterious rumble echoed somewhere far away.
texts.SevenIsland_TanobyRuins_Text_BrandonIntr: Do you know anything about this stone chamber?
texts.SevenIsland_TanobyRuins_Text_BrandonDefe: That was uncalled for. You didn't have to be so rough.
texts.SevenIsland_TanobyRuins_Text_BrandonPost:
The TANOBY RUINS date back at least 1,500 years.

But it's a baffling mystery as to why it was built in the first place.
texts.SevenIsland_TanobyRuins_Text_BenjaminInt: A mystic POKéMON is said to sleep inside here.
texts.SevenIsland_TanobyRuins_Text_BenjaminDef: I'm not much good in battle.
texts.SevenIsland_TanobyRuins_Text_BenjaminPos:
I hear there are other ruins like the one here.

Might they be the resting places of other mystic POKéMON?
texts.SevenIsland_TanobyRuins_Text_EdnaIntro: CLIFFORD is teaching me how to paint.
texts.SevenIsland_TanobyRuins_Text_EdnaDefeat: We might get in trouble for being noisy here.
texts.SevenIsland_TanobyRuins_Text_EdnaPostBat:
I said that I wanted to paint an old building.

So CLIFFORD brought me here.
texts.SevenIsland_TanobyRuins_Text_CliffordInt: Today, in addition to our lesson, we came to see the chamber.
texts.SevenIsland_TanobyRuins_Text_CliffordPos:
Ah, so you are studying POKéMON on your own…

Yes, you certainly are quite the extraordinary person, indeed.
texts.SevenIsland_TrainerTower_Text_DarioPostB:
In your future, I sense that you will meet many others.

I think you will be linked to each other by a strange power.
texts.SevenIsland_TrainerTower_Text_RodetteInt: Somewhere on this island, peculiar POKéMON are sleeping.
texts.SevenIsland_TrainerTower_Text_RodettePos:
Somewhere on this island, peculiar POKéMON are sleeping.

Could it be that they're waiting for you?
texts.SevenIsland_TrainerTower_Text_TrainerTow: TRAINER TOWER ENTRANCE Rise to the Challenge, TRAINERS!
texts.SevenIsland_TrainerTower_Text_LooksLikeT: トレーナータワーには いまは　はいれない　みたい‥
texts.SevenIsland_TrainerTower_Text_TrainerTow: トレーナータワーが　あいてる！ さっそく　はいってみよう！
texts.SilphCo_10F_Text_GruntIntro: Welcome to 10F! So good of you to join me!
texts.SilphCo_10F_Text_GruntPostBattle: Nice try, but the boardroom is up one more floor.
texts.SilphCo_10F_Text_TravisPostBattle: Are you satisfied with beating me? Then go on home!
texts.SilphCo_10F_Text_KeepMeCryingASecret: About me crying… Please keep it a secret.
texts.SilphCo_11F_Text_ThanksForSavingMeDearBo:
PRESIDENT: Oh, dear boy! Thank you for saving SILPH.

I will never forget you saved us in our moment of peril.

I have to thank you in some way.

Because I am rich, I can give you anything.

Here, maybe this will do.
texts.SilphCo_11F_Text_ThanksForSavingMeDearGi:
PRESIDENT: Oh, dear girl! Thank you for saving SILPH.

I will never forget you saved us in our moment of peril.

I have to thank you in some way.

Because I am rich, I can give you anything.

Here, maybe this will do.
texts.SilphCo_11F_Text_ObtainedMasterBallFromP: {PLAYER} obtained a MASTER BALL from the PRESIDENT!
texts.SilphCo_11F_Text_ThatsOurSecretPrototype:
PRESIDENT: You can't buy that anywhere.

It's our secret prototype MASTER BALL.

It will catch any POKéMON without fail!

You should be quiet about using it, though.
texts.SilphCo_11F_Text_YouHaveNoRoomForThis: You have no room for this.
texts.SilphCo_11F_Text_ThanksForRescuingUs:
SECRETARY: Thank you for rescuing all of us.

We, from the PRESIDENT down, are indebted to you.
texts.SilphCo_11F_Text_GiovanniIntro:
Ah, {PLAYER}! So we meet again!

The PRESIDENT and I are discussing a vital business proposition.

Keep your nose out of grown-up matters…

Or, experience a world of pain!
texts.SilphCo_11F_Text_GiovanniPostBattle:
Blast it all! You ruined our plans for SILPH!

But, TEAM ROCKET will never fall!

{PLAYER}! Never forget that all POKéMON exist for TEAM ROCKET!

I must go, but I shall return!
texts.SilphCo_11F_Text_Grunt2Intro: Stop right there! Don't you move!
texts.SilphCo_11F_Text_Grunt2PostBattle: So, you want to see my BOSS?
texts.SilphCo_11F_Text_Grunt1Intro: Halt! Do you have an appointment with my BOSS?
texts.SilphCo_11F_Text_Grunt1PostBattle: Watch your step… My BOSS likes his POKéMON tough!
texts.SilphCo_11F_Text_MonitorHasMonsOnIt: The monitor has POKéMON on it!
texts.SilphCo_1F_Text_WelcomePresidentInBoardr:
Welcome.

The PRESIDENT is in the boardroom on 11F.
texts.SilphCo_1F_Text_DestroyedWontBeFixedForW: めちゃめちゃに　こわされてる とうぶん　なおりそうに　ない‥
texts.SilphCo_2F_Text_ConnorDefeat: How did you know I was a ROCKET?
texts.SilphCo_2F_Text_ConnorPostBattle: I work for both SILPH and TEAM ROCKET.
texts.SilphCo_2F_Text_JerryPostBattle: Can you solve the maze in here? It's not easy, I tell you!
texts.SilphCo_2F_Text_Grunt1Intro: No kids are allowed in here!
texts.SilphCo_2F_Text_Grunt1PostBattle:
Diamond-shaped tiles are teleport blocks.

They're transporters for this high-tech building.
texts.SilphCo_2F_Text_Grunt2Intro: Hey, kid! What are you wandering here for?
texts.SilphCo_2F_Text_Grunt2PostBattle: SILPH CO. will be associated with TEAM ROCKET!
texts.Text_ThunderWaveTeach:
Eeek! No! Stop! Help!

Oh, you're not with TEAM ROCKET. I'm sorry, I thought…

Will you forgive me if I teach you the THUNDER WAVE technique?
texts.Text_ThunderWaveDeclined: Oh… But THUNDER WAVE is convenient…
texts.Text_ThunderWaveWhichMon: Which POKéMON should I teach THUNDER WAVE?
texts.Text_ThunderWaveTaught:
THUNDER WAVE causes paralysis in the target POKéMON.

A paralyzed POKéMON may be unable to move in battle.

It's an ELECTRIC-type move, so it won't work on some POKéMON.
texts.SilphCo_3F_Text_WhatAmIToDo: I work for SILPH CO. What am I to do?
texts.SilphCo_3F_Text_YouAndYourMonsSavedUs: {PLAYER}! You and your POKéMON saved us!
texts.SilphCo_3F_Text_GruntPostBattle: A hint? You can open doors with a CARD KEY!
texts.SilphCo_3F_Text_JoseIntro: I support TEAM ROCKET more than I support SILPH CO.!
texts.SilphCo_3F_Text_JosePostBattle:
Humph…

TEAM ROCKET said that if I helped them, they'd let me study POKéMON.
texts.SilphCo_4F_Text_CantYouSeeImHiding: Sssh! Can't you see I'm hiding?
texts.SilphCo_4F_Text_Grunt1Intro: TEAM ROCKET has taken control of SILPH CO.!
texts.SilphCo_4F_Text_Grunt1PostBattle: Fwahahaha! My BOSS has been after this place!
texts.SilphCo_4F_Text_RodneyIntro: My POKéMON is my loyal servant.
texts.SilphCo_4F_Text_RodneyPostBattle:
The doors are electronically locked.

It takes a CARD KEY to open the doors here.
texts.SilphCo_4F_Text_Grunt2PostBattle: I better tell the BOSS on 11F!
texts.SilphCo_5F_Text_RocketsInUproarAboutIntr:
TEAM ROCKET is in an uproar over some intruder.

That's you, right?
texts.SilphCo_5F_Text_YoureOurHeroThankYou: TEAM ROCKET took off! You're our hero! Thank you!
texts.SilphCo_5F_Text_Grunt1Intro: I heard a kid was wandering around.
texts.SilphCo_5F_Text_Grunt1PostBattle: It's not smart to pick a fight with TEAM ROCKET!
texts.SilphCo_5F_Text_BeauIntro: We study POKé BALL technology on this floor.
texts.SilphCo_5F_Text_BeauPostBattle: We worked on the ultimate POKé BALL which would catch anything.
texts.SilphCo_5F_Text_DaltonIntro:
Whaaat?

There shouldn't be any children here!
texts.SilphCo_5F_Text_DaltonPostBattle: You're only on 5F. It's a long way to my BOSS!
texts.SilphCo_5F_Text_Grunt2Intro: Show TEAM ROCKET a little respect!
texts.SilphCo_5F_Text_Grunt2PostBattle:
Which reminds me.

KOFFING evolves into WEEZING!
texts.SilphCo_5F_Text_PorygonFirstVRMon:
It's a POKéMON REPORT!

POKéMON LAB created PORYGON, the first virtual-reality POKéMON.
texts.SilphCo_5F_Text_Over350TechniquesConfirm:
It's a POKéMON REPORT!

Over 350 POKéMON techniques have been confirmed.
texts.SilphCo_5F_Text_SomeMonsEvolveWhenTraded:
It's a POKéMON REPORT!

Some POKéMON have been confirmed to evolve when they are traded.
texts.SilphCo_5F_Text_RocketBossLookingForStro:
Those thugs that took over our building…

Their BOSS said he was looking for strong POKéMON.

I hope our PRESIDENT managed to avoid trouble…
texts.SilphCo_6F_Text_RocketsTookOverBuilding: The ROCKETS came and took over the building!
texts.SilphCo_6F_Text_BetterGetBackToWork: Well, better get back to work.
texts.SilphCo_6F_Text_HelpMePlease: Oh dear, oh dear. Help me, please!
texts.SilphCo_6F_Text_ThatManIsSuchACoward: That man next to me… He's such a coward!
texts.SilphCo_6F_Text_NeedsMeToLookAfterHim: He's so helpless, he needed someone like me to look after him.
texts.SilphCo_6F_Text_RocketsTryingToConquerWo: TEAM ROCKET is trying to conquer the world with POKéMON.
texts.SilphCo_6F_Text_RocketsRanAwayBecauseOfY: TEAM ROCKET ran away, and it's all because of you!
texts.SilphCo_6F_Text_TargetedSilphForOurMonPr: They must have targeted SILPH for our POKéMON products.
texts.SilphCo_6F_Text_ComeWorkForSilphWhenYour: Come work for SILPH when you get older.
texts.SilphCo_6F_Text_Grunt1Intro: I am one of the four ROCKET BROTHERS!
texts.SilphCo_6F_Text_Grunt1PostBattle: No matter! My brothers will avenge me!
texts.SilphCo_6F_Text_TaylorIntro:
That rotten PRESIDENT!

Serves him right for shipping me off to the TIKSI BRANCH!

That's why TEAM ROCKET came after us, I'm sure of it!
texts.SilphCo_6F_Text_TaylorPostBattle: TIKSI BRANCH? It's in Russian no-man's-land!
texts.SilphCo_6F_Text_Grunt2PostBattle: If you stand for justice, you betray us bad guys!
texts.SilphCo_7F_Text_HaveMonForSavingUs:
Oh! Hi! You're not a ROCKET! You came to save us? Why, thank you!

I want you to have this POKéMON for saving us.
texts.SilphCo_7F_Text_ObtainedLaprasFromEmploy: {PLAYER} obtained a LAPRAS from the SILPH employee!
texts.SilphCo_7F_Text_ExplainLapras:
It's a LAPRAS. It's a very intelligent POKéMON.

We kept it in our lab, but it will be much better off with you.

I think you will be a good TRAINER for LAPRAS!

It's a good swimmer. It'll give you a lift across water!
texts.SilphCo_7F_Text_RocketBossWentToBoardroo:
TEAM ROCKET's BOSS went to the boardroom!

Is our PRESIDENT okay? I'm worried.
texts.SilphCo_7F_Text_OhNo: あ‥　もう　もてないぞ
texts.SilphCo_7F_Text_SavedAtLast: たすかったよ　ありがと！
texts.SilphCo_7F_Text_RocketsAfterMasterBall: TEAM ROCKET was after the MASTER BALL, which catches any POKéMON.
texts.SilphCo_7F_Text_CanceledMasterBallProjec: We canceled the MASTER BALL project because of TEAM ROCKET.
texts.SilphCo_7F_Text_BadIfTeamRocketTookOver: It would be bad if TEAM ROCKET took over SILPH or our POKéMON.
texts.SilphCo_7F_Text_WowYouChasedOffTeamRocke:
Wow!

You chased off TEAM ROCKET all by yourself?
texts.SilphCo_7F_Text_ReallyDangerousHere:
You! It's really dangerous here!

You came to save me? You can't!
texts.SilphCo_7F_Text_Grunt3Intro: Uh-oh! I smell a little mouse!
texts.SilphCo_7F_Text_Grunt3PostBattle: You won't find my BOSS by just scurrying around!
texts.SilphCo_7F_Text_JoshuaIntro:
Heheh!

You mistook me for a SILPH worker?
texts.SilphCo_7F_Text_JoshuaPostBattle: Despite your age, you are a skilled TRAINER!
texts.SilphCo_7F_Text_Grunt1Intro: I am one of the four ROCKET BROTHERS!
texts.SilphCo_7F_Text_Grunt1PostBattle: Doesn't matter. My brothers will repay the favor!
texts.SilphCo_7F_Text_Grunt2Intro: A child intruder? That must be you!
texts.SilphCo_7F_Text_Grunt2PostBattle: Go on home before my BOSS gets ticked off!
texts.SilphCo_7F_Text_RivalIntro:
{RIVAL}: Hahaha! I thought you'd turn up if I waited here!

I guess TEAM ROCKET slowed you down! Not that I care!

I saw you in SAFFRON, so I decided to see if you got better!
texts.SilphCo_7F_Text_RivalDefeat: Oh, man! So, you are ready for BOSS ROCKET!
texts.SilphCo_7F_Text_RivalVictory:
{RIVAL}“おまえなあ‥

こんな　うでまえじゃ まだまだ‥ いちにんまえ　とは　いえないぜ
texts.SilphCo_7F_Text_RivalPostBattle:
Well, {PLAYER}! I'm moving on up and ahead!

By checking my POKéDEX, I'm starting to see what's strong and how they evolve!

Am I a genius or what?

I'm going to the POKéMON LEAGUE to boot out the ELITE FOUR.

I'll become the world's most powerful TRAINER!

{PLAYER}, well, good luck to you! Don't sweat it! Smell ya!
texts.SilphCo_8F_Text_WonderIfSilphIsFinished: I wonder if SILPH is finished…
texts.SilphCo_8F_Text_Grunt1Intro: That's as far as you'll go!
texts.SilphCo_8F_Text_Grunt1PostBattle: If you don't turn back… I'll call for backup!
texts.SilphCo_8F_Text_ParkerPostBattle: So, what do you think of SILPH BUILDING's maze?
texts.SilphCo_8F_Text_Grunt2Intro: I am one of the four ROCKET BROTHERS!
texts.SilphCo_8F_Text_Grunt2PostBattle: I'll leave you up to my brothers.
texts.SilphCo_8F_Text_ToRocketBossMonsAreTools:
TEAM ROCKET's BOSS is terribly cruel!

To him, POKéMON are just tools to be used.

What will happen if that tyrant takes over our company…
texts.SilphCo_9F_Text_YouShouldTakeQuickNap: You look tired. You should take a quick nap.
texts.SilphCo_9F_Text_Grunt1Intro: Your POKéMON seem to adore you, kid!
texts.SilphCo_9F_Text_Grunt1PostBattle: If I had started as a TRAINER at your age…
texts.SilphCo_9F_Text_EdIntro: Your POKéMON have weak points! I can nail them!
texts.SilphCo_9F_Text_EdPostBattle: Exploiting weak spots does work. Think about type advantages.
texts.SilphCo_9F_Text_Grunt2Intro: I am one of the four ROCKET BROTHERS!
texts.SixIsland_Text_IslandSign: SIX ISLAND Fortune Island of Aged Wisdom
texts.SixIsland_Text_ThatWayToWaterPathRuinVal:
Keep going this way and you'll get to the WATER PATH.

Stay on that and you'll get to the RUIN VALLEY.
texts.SixIsland_Text_SkyAtNightIsFantastic: When you're this far away from the city, the sky at night is fantastic.
texts.SixIsland_DottedHole_SapphireRoom_Text_I:
Fufu… Fufufufu… I guessed right.

I was right in tailing you!
texts.SixIsland_DottedHole_SapphireRoom_Text_S:
I knew that there was a SAPPHIRE here, so it belongs to me!

I'll sell it to TEAM ROCKET for serious money.

…D-don't glare at me like that!

If you want it back, why don't you go get it after I sell it?

I'll even tell you one of the passwords to TEAM ROCKET's WAREHOUSE.

The WAREHOUSE password I know is “Yes, nah, CHANSEY.”

I'm done. Don't think badly of me!
texts.SixIsland_GreenPath_Text_JaclynIntro:
…Huh?

I was envisioning my house, but this is where I TELEPORT?
texts.SixIsland_GreenPath_Text_JaclynPostBattl:
I am so scatterbrained!

I need to focus so I can TELEPORT properly to my house!
texts.SixIsland_GreenPath_Text_RightRouteSign: GREEN PATH Think Green, Keep Nature Clean!
texts.SixIsland_House_Text_GoodPlaceForNatureA:
There's nothing that young people'd find exciting here on this island.

But, this is a good place in terms of nature and history.

Relax and enjoy your stay.
texts.SixIsland_Mart_Text_AgathaOldestEverElit:
Play with POKéMON lots and live a long life!

Take AGATHA, for example.

She set a record for being the oldest-ever ELITE FOUR member.

She spurs me to do bigger things.
texts.SixIsland_Mart_Text_ShouldBuyMailAndWrit: I should buy some MAIL and write him a letter…
texts.SixIsland_OutcastIsland_Text_RocketIntro:
There're no rare POKéMON around these parts! Not a one!

That burns me up, man. I'll take it out on you!
texts.SixIsland_OutcastIsland_Text_RocketPostB: So listen, you haven't seen any rare POKéMON, have you?
texts.SixIsland_OutcastIsland_Text_TylorIntro: I'm having no luck at all. A battle'd be a change of pace!
texts.SixIsland_OutcastIsland_Text_TylorPostBa: I can't very well go home without catching something, though.
texts.SixIsland_OutcastIsland_Text_MymoIntro:
Gasp… Gasp…

I swam here from SIX ISLE PORT in one go.
texts.SixIsland_OutcastIsland_Text_MymoPostBat: I'm only at the halfway point… I'm beat…
texts.SixIsland_OutcastIsland_Text_NicoleIntro: It's not so easy sending POKéMON out while swimming, you know?
texts.SixIsland_OutcastIsland_Text_NicoleDefea: I didn't lose to you at swimming. This doesn't bother me.
texts.SixIsland_OutcastIsland_Text_NicolePostB:
Are you headed for the island up past here?

I didn't see anything interesting there.
texts.SixIsland_OutcastIsland_Text_AvaIntro: AVA: Let's have a two-on-two marine battle!
texts.SixIsland_OutcastIsland_Text_AvaDefeat: AVA: Oh, you're amazing! Even better, you're on your own!
texts.SixIsland_OutcastIsland_Text_AvaPostBatt: AVA: You know, I do prefer the sea over any pool.
texts.SixIsland_OutcastIsland_Text_AvaNotEnoug:
AVA: You're challenging us to a battle?

You'll need at least two POKéMON if you want to do that.
texts.SixIsland_OutcastIsland_Text_GebIntro: GEB: Big Sister, help! Please battle with me!
texts.SixIsland_OutcastIsland_Text_GebDefeat: GEB: Wow, Big Sister, this person's really good!
texts.SixIsland_OutcastIsland_Text_GebPostBatt: GEB: I'm hanging onto my sister because I can't touch the bottom.
texts.SixIsland_OutcastIsland_Text_GebNotEnoug:
GEB: Please battle against me and my sister!

…Oh, you don't have two POKéMON?
texts.SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_BethanyIntro: I'm curious, how do you raise your POKéMON?
texts.SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_BethanyDefeat: You raise your POKéMON with a whole lot of love!
texts.SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_BethanyPostBa: In the same way your mother raised you full of love, you should raise your POKéMON.
texts.SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_AllisonIntro: I'm working to preserve the natural ecology of POKéMON here.
texts.SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_AllisonDefeat: Oh, for someone so young, you are tremendous!
texts.SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_AllisonPostBa:
I'm not saying that you shouldn't catch POKéMON.

I just want people to raise their POKéMON responsibly.
texts.SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_GarretIntro: I caught a BUG POKéMON that lives only around here!
texts.SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_GarretPostBat: There's a girl near the BUSH who measures HERACROSS for TRAINERS.
texts.SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_JonahIntro: You know, it just doesn't feel right if I don't use BUG POKéMON.
texts.SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_JonahDefeat: It's okay, losing is a fun part of POKéMON's appeal, too.
texts.SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_JonahPostBatt:
By the way, “appeal” is a weird word, if you think about it.

Like, is it like an orange peel? Or like a ringing bell?
texts.SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_VanceIntro: Yeah, yeah, yeah! Look at all the BUG POKéMON!
texts.SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_VanceDefeat: I got beat while I was still busy celebrating!
texts.SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_VancePostBatt: I'm going to bring my little brother here next time.
texts.SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_NashIntro: Look, look! There are funny patterns on the ground.
texts.SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_NashPostBattl:
The funny patterns on the ground…

They look like the patterns on my grandpa's clothes.
texts.SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_CordellIntro: I bet you think I'm just some guy, don't you, eh?
texts.SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_CordellDefeat: I bet you think I'm weak, don't you, eh?
texts.SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_CordellPostBa:
Ayup, you townies come around all so dandy with a hat that flashy…

How about giving me that?
texts.SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_DaliaIntro: Take a deep breath. Isn't the air delicious?
texts.SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_DaliaDefeat: If you'd like, I can teach you how to breathe properly.
texts.SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_DaliaPostBatt:
First, exhale. Blow everything out.

When you can't exhale anymore, inhale the clean air!

Isn't it refreshing?
texts.SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_JoanaIntro:
I love BUG POKéMON. That's why I'm here all the time.

Am I the only girl like that?
texts.SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_JoanaDefeat: I lost, but I'm still laughing. Am I the only girl like that?
texts.SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_JoanaPostBatt:
I'm going to keep on collecting BUG POKéMON.

Am I the only girl like that?
texts.SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_RileyIntro: This is a good spot. I'll pitch my tent here.
texts.SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_RileyPostBatt: I'm going to observe the night sky here.
texts.SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_MarcyIntro: Oh, yuck! I think a bug stung me!
texts.SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_MarcyDefeat: It wasn't a bug. I cut my shin on some grass.
texts.SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_MarcyPostBatt: A little cut like that… A little spit's enough to cure it!
texts.SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_LaytonIntro: Have you noticed something odd about these parts?
texts.SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_LaytonDefeat: Have you taken a good look around your feet?
texts.SixIsland_PatternBush_Text_LaytonPostBat:
There are places here in PATTERN BUSH where grass won't grow.

What could be the cause of such a phenomenon?
texts.SixIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Somethin:
For ten years, I've searched for RUINS.

No, make that twenty years.

I get this feeling that there's something hidden on this island.
texts.SixIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_SomeMons:
You know of POKéMON that evolve only upon trading, yes?

But did you know that there are still others?

Some POKéMON evolve only when traded while holding specific items.
texts.SixIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_RivalImp:
{RIVAL}: Hey, {PLAYER}! How's your POKéDEX filling up?

It looks like it's impossible to get all the POKéMON by hanging around just these parts.

Maybe there are POKéMON we don't know about somewhere far away…

… … …  … … …  … … …

Well, if I can't do it, there's no way for you to get it done.

I'm not going to get all desperate over this.

I'll keep collecting POKéMON at my own pace while I train them.

That's what I'll do. So there's no point staying here. I may as well leave for home.

That's that, then! Smell ya later!
texts.SixIsland_RuinValley_Text_CantFigureOutH: I can't figure out how I'm supposed to get inside.
texts.SixIsland_RuinValley_Text_IFoundThisPlac:
Let me tell you, I found this place.

Don't look so envious, will you?
texts.SixIsland_RuinValley_Text_CheckDoorMoreT: The door doesn't budge at all. Check it more thoroughly?
texts.SixIsland_RuinValley_Text_SeveralDotsOnT: On closer inspection, there are several dots on the door…
texts.SixIsland_RuinValley_Text_StanlyIntro: There appear to be many secrets still unsolved in this world.
texts.SixIsland_RuinValley_Text_StanlyPostBatt: I suggest to you that you, too, give a thought to the secrets and mysteries of our world once a day.
texts.SixIsland_RuinValley_Text_FosterIntro: I'm curious, what compelled you to come here?
texts.SixIsland_RuinValley_Text_FosterDefeat: It's been so long since I battled, my instincts are off.
texts.SixIsland_RuinValley_Text_FosterPostBatt:
There are several ruins on the SEVII ISLANDS.

The majority of them date back a long way.
texts.SixIsland_RuinValley_Text_LarryIntro:
It's been said that there are mysterious stones on this island.

I suspect it has something to do with the ruins here.
texts.SixIsland_RuinValley_Text_LarryPostBattl:
Those ruins over there…

I haven't had any luck in finding how I can get inside.
texts.SixIsland_RuinValley_Text_DarylIntro: A battle with you, so high up!
texts.SixIsland_RuinValley_Text_DarylDefeat: Oh, the heartbreak of losing so easily to you!
texts.SixIsland_RuinValley_Text_HectorIntro: I'm pretty familiar with the land around these parts.
texts.SixIsland_RuinValley_Text_HectorDefeat: You don't need to be so pushy. I'll be happy to tell you.
texts.SixIsland_RuinValley_Text_HectorPostBatt:
The door to the ruins… It has these strange patterns engraved on the outside.

I don't know what they mean, though.
texts.SixIsland_WaterPath_Text_RoseIntro: I let a pleasant breeze lead me all the way here.
texts.SixIsland_WaterPath_Text_RoseDefeat: Giggle… You're so cute when you're determined.
texts.SixIsland_WaterPath_Text_RosePostBattle:
I want to go to the woods over there, but…

There are lots of BUG POKéMON. They scare me a little.
texts.SixIsland_WaterPath_Text_EdwardIntro: I'm practicing in secret so no one can see me.
texts.SixIsland_WaterPath_Text_EdwardPostBattl: As a performer, I don't want people to know about the effort I put in.
texts.SixIsland_WaterPath_Text_SamirIntro:
What, you're suggesting that you're sick of seeing SWIMMERS like me?

Aww, don't be hatin'!
texts.SixIsland_WaterPath_Text_SamirPostBattle: I couldn't lift the stigma of being a SWIMMER…
texts.SixIsland_WaterPath_Text_DeniseIntro: My boyfriend's always busy, so I come swimming by myself.
texts.SixIsland_WaterPath_Text_DeniseDefeat: Awww, I knew this would happen!
texts.SixIsland_WaterPath_Text_DenisePostBattl: When I can't be with my boyfriend, I spend time with the POKéMON he gave me.
texts.SixIsland_WaterPath_Text_EarlIntro: Tell me, where are the mountains around these parts?
texts.SixIsland_WaterPath_Text_EarlDefeat: I lost my way while I was busy battling!
texts.SixIsland_WaterPath_Text_EarlPostBattle: Aren't there any mountains around these parts?
texts.SixIsland_WaterPath_Text_MiuIntro: MIU: Hello, POKéMON! It's time to play!
texts.SixIsland_WaterPath_Text_MiuPostBattle: MIU: It makes me all sad inside when we lose…
texts.SixIsland_WaterPath_Text_MiuNotEnoughMon: MIU: MIA and I are TWINS. We want to battle together.
texts.SixIsland_WaterPath_Text_MiaIntro: MIA: Hello, POKéMON! It's time to battle!
texts.SixIsland_WaterPath_Text_MiaDefeat: MIA: You're mean! You're bad for winning!
texts.SixIsland_WaterPath_Text_MiaPostBattle: MIA: Ohh… I'm sorry, my POKéMON…
texts.SixIsland_WaterPath_Text_MiaNotEnoughMon:
MIA: Oh, you only have one POKéMON?

Don't you feel lonesome?
texts.SixIsland_WaterPath_Text_RouteSign: WATER PATH Leads to RUIN VALLEY
texts.SixIsland_WaterPath_House1_Text_LoveItNe: Hera, hera, HERACROSS! Big and shiny, it's the bug boss! Love it, need it, HERACROSS!
texts.SixIsland_WaterPath_House1_Text_MayIMeas:
Eeeeek! That's a HERACROSS!

Please, please, may I measure how big it is?
texts.SixIsland_WaterPath_House1_Text_ItsXInch: Eeeek, it's {STR_VAR_2} inches! I've never seen anything like this! You deserve a reward!
texts.SixIsland_WaterPath_House1_Text_WantToSe:
I want to see a much, much bigger HERACROSS than that one.

Oh, how I adore them, big HERACROSS!
texts.SixIsland_WaterPath_House1_Text_ItsXInch: Huh? This {STR_VAR_2}-inch measurement… Oh, boo! It's the same as before.

Oh, it's just {STR_VAR_2} inches. The HERACROSS before was bigger.

It was {STR_VAR_3} inches, the biggest HERACROSS you've brought me.
texts.SixIsland_WaterPath_House1_Text_ThisWont:
Oh, no! This won't do!

HERACROSS looks much more macho and cool, and has a lovely horn!
texts.SixIsland_WaterPath_House1_Text_YourBagI: Your BAG is full. My reward won't fit.
texts.SixIsland_WaterPath_House1_Text_BiggestH:
The biggest HERACROSS that I have ever seen measured so far is:

{STR_VAR_3} inches!
texts.SixIsland_WaterPath_House1_Text_BlankCha:
It's a blank chart of some sort.

It has spaces for writing in records of some kind.
texts.SixIsland_WaterPath_House2_Text_MyNeighb:
My height is 67.0 inches on the button.

I know it is this precisely because my neighbor measured me.
texts.SSAnne_1F_Corridor_Text_LeStrongSilentTy:
Bonjour! I am le waiter on this ship!

I will be happy to serve you anything you please!

… … … Ah! Le strong silent type!
texts.SSAnne_1F_Corridor_Text_PassengersAreRes:
The passengers are restless from this long voyage.

You might be challenged by the more bored ones!
texts.SSAnne_1F_Room1_Text_ImAGlobalPoliceAgen:
Ssh…! I'm a GLOBAL POLICE agent.

I'm on the trail of TEAM ROCKET. They're up to nothing good!
texts.SSAnne_1F_Room2_Text_TylerPostBattle:
Listen, listen! Let me be your friend, okay?

Then we can trade POKéMON and do stuff.
texts.SSAnne_1F_Room2_Text_AnnIntro: I collected these POKéMON from all around the world!
texts.SSAnne_1F_Room2_Text_AnnDefeat: Oh, no! I went around the world for these!
texts.SSAnne_1F_Room2_Text_AnnPostBattle:
You hurt my poor POKéMON!

I demand that you heal them at a POKéMON CENTER!
texts.SSAnne_1F_Room2_Text_CruisingAroundWorld: We are cruising around the world, my children and I.
texts.SSAnne_1F_Room3_Text_CruiseIsElegantAndC: A world cruise is so elegant yet cozy!
texts.SSAnne_1F_Room3_Text_AlwaysTravelWithWig: I always travel with WIGGLYTUFF. I never leave home without it.
texts.SSAnne_1F_Room4_Text_WaiterCherryPiePlea: Waiter, I would like a cherry pie, please!
texts.SSAnne_1F_Room4_Text_WaitressCherryPiePl: Waitress, I would like a cherry pie, please!
texts.SSAnne_1F_Room5_Text_ArthurIntro: You insolent pup! How dare you barge in!
texts.SSAnne_1F_Room5_Text_ArthurDefeat: Humph! You rude child! You have no sense of courtesy!
texts.SSAnne_1F_Room5_Text_ArthurPostBattle: I wish to be left alone! Get out!
texts.SSAnne_1F_Room6_Text_TakeAShortRest: You look tired. Would you like to take a short rest?
texts.SSAnne_1F_Room6_Text_GladEveryoneIsRefre: I'm glad to see that everyone is looking refreshed and chipper.
texts.SSAnne_1F_Room6_Text_SorryYouLookLikeMyB: Oh, I'm sorry for fussing over you. You look like my little brother…
texts.SSAnne_1F_Room6_Text_SorryYouLookLikeMyS: Oh, I'm sorry for fussing over you. You look like my little sister…
texts.SSAnne_1F_Room7_Text_ThomasIntro:
I am but a solitary traveler…

My sole companions and friends are POKéMON I caught on my journeys…
texts.SSAnne_1F_Room7_Text_ThomasPostBattle: You should be nice to friends!
texts.SSAnne_2F_Corridor_Text_ThisShipIsLuxury:
This ship, she is a luxury liner for TRAINERS of the world!

At every port, we hold parties with invited TRAINERS.
texts.SSAnne_2F_Corridor_Text_RivalIntro:
{RIVAL}: Bonjour! {PLAYER}!

Imagine seeing you here! {PLAYER}, were you really invited?

So how's your POKéDEX coming?

I already caught 40 kinds, pal. Different kinds are everywhere.

Crawl around in grassy areas, and look hard for them.
texts.SSAnne_2F_Corridor_Text_RivalDefeat:
Humph!

At least you're raising your POKéMON!
texts.SSAnne_2F_Corridor_Text_RivalVictory:
{PLAYER}‥！ ふなよい　してるのか！

もっと　からだ きたえた　ほうが　いいぜ！
texts.SSAnne_2F_Corridor_Text_RivalPostBattle:
{RIVAL}: I heard there was a CUT master on board.

But he was just a seasick old man!

CUT itself is really useful. Yup, it'll be handy.

You should go see him, too. Smell ya!
texts.SSAnne_2F_Room1_Text_SleepingMonLookedLi:
I've journeyed far and wide, but in all my travels I've never seen any POKéMON sleep like this one!

It was something like this!
texts.SSAnne_2F_Room2_Text_BrooksIntro: Competing against the young keeps me youthful.
texts.SSAnne_2F_Room2_Text_BrooksDefeat: Good match! Ah, I feel young again!
texts.SSAnne_2F_Room2_Text_BrooksPostBattle: Fifteen years ago, I would have won!
texts.SSAnne_2F_Room2_Text_DaleIntro: Check out what I fished up!
texts.SSAnne_2F_Room2_Text_DalePostBattle:
Party?

The cruise ship's party should be over by now.
texts.SSAnne_2F_Room3_Text_SeenMonsFerryPeople: Ah, yes, I have seen some POKéMON ferry people across the water!
texts.SSAnne_2F_Room3_Text_SomeTreesCanBeCutDo:
Small trees can be chopped down using the move CUT.

But remember this! CUT is an HM technique.

Once learned, it is not so easily discarded.
texts.SSAnne_2F_Room4_Text_LamarIntro: Which do you find more worthy, a strong or a rare POKéMON?
texts.SSAnne_2F_Room4_Text_LamarPostBattle: Personally, I prefer strong and rare POKéMON.
texts.SSAnne_2F_Room4_Text_DawnIntro: I don't believe I saw you at the party?
texts.SSAnne_2F_Room4_Text_DawnPostBattle: Oh, I adore your strong POKéMON! Oh, how I envy you for them!
texts.SSAnne_2F_Room5_Text_HaveYouGoneToSafari:
Have you gone to the SAFARI ZONE in FUCHSIA CITY?

There are many kinds of rare POKéMON.
texts.SSAnne_2F_Room5_Text_WeThinkSafariZoneIs: Me and my daddy think the SAFARI ZONE is awesome! I wish we could go there again.
texts.SSAnne_2F_Room6_Text_CaptainIsAwfullySic: The CAPTAIN said he's awfully sick. He was all pale.
texts.SSAnne_2F_Room6_Text_ManyPeopleGetSeasic: I hear many people get seasick.
texts.SSAnne_3F_Corridor_Text_CaptainTeachesCu:
Our CAPTAIN is a sword master. He's awesome at using CUT.

They say he even teaches CUT to POKéMON!
texts.SSAnne_B1F_Room1_Text_PhillipIntro: Matey, you're walking the plank if you lose!
texts.SSAnne_B1F_Room1_Text_PhillipPostBattle: When we're out at sea, jellyfish POKéMON sometimes drift by.
texts.SSAnne_B1F_Room1_Text_BarnyIntro:
Hello, stranger!

I can't tell if you're from the seas or mountains, but stop and chat.

All my POKéMON are from the sea.
texts.SSAnne_B1F_Room1_Text_BarnyDefeat: Darn! I let that one get away!
texts.SSAnne_B1F_Room1_Text_BarnyPostBattle: I was going to make you my assistant, too!
texts.SSAnne_B1F_Room2_Text_HueyIntro: Even us sailors have POKéMON, too!
texts.SSAnne_B1F_Room2_Text_HueyPostBattle: We caught all our POKéMON while we were out at sea.
texts.SSAnne_B1F_Room3_Text_DylanIntro: I like feisty kids like you!
texts.SSAnne_B1F_Room3_Text_DylanPostBattle: Sea POKéMON live in deep water. You'll need a ROD to fish them up!
texts.SSAnne_B1F_Room4_Text_LeonardIntro: You know what they say about sailors and battling!
texts.SSAnne_B1F_Room4_Text_LeonardPostBattle: Hahaha! Want to be a sailor, mate?
texts.SSAnne_B1F_Room4_Text_DuncanIntro: Come on, then! My sailor's pride is at stake!
texts.SSAnne_B1F_Room4_Text_DuncanPostBattle: Did you see the FISHING GURU in VERMILION CITY?
texts.SSAnne_B1F_Room5_Text_MachokeHasStrength:
My buddy MACHOKE is super strong!

He has enough STRENGTH to move big rocks!
texts.SSAnne_CaptainsOffice_Text_CaptainIFeelS: CAPTAIN: Ooargh… I feel hideous… Urrp! Seasick…
texts.SSAnne_CaptainsOffice_Text_RubbedCaptain:
{PLAYER} rubbed the CAPTAIN's back!

Rub-rub… Rub-rub…
texts.SSAnne_CaptainsOffice_Text_ThankYouHaveH:
CAPTAIN: Whew! Thank you! I'm feeling much better now.

You want to see my hidden CUT technique?

I could show you my prized CUT technique if I weren't so ill…

I know! You can have this! This HIDDEN MACHINE!

Teach CUT to your POKéMON, and you can see it CUT anytime!
texts.SSAnne_CaptainsOffice_Text_ExplainCut:
Using CUT, you can chop down small trees.

Why not try it with the trees around VERMILION CITY?
texts.SSAnne_CaptainsOffice_Text_SSAnneWillSet:
CAPTAIN: …Whew!

Now that I'm not sick anymore, I guess it's time.

The S.S. ANNE will set sail soon!

Farewell, until our return to VERMILION CITY!
texts.SSAnne_CaptainsOffice_Text_YouHaveNoRoom: Oh, no! You have no room for this!
texts.SSAnne_CaptainsOffice_Text_HowToConquerS: How to Conquer Seasickness… The CAPTAIN's reading this!
texts.SSAnne_Deck_Text_ShipDepartingSoon: The party's over. The ship will be departing soon.
texts.SSAnne_Deck_Text_ScrubbingDecksHardWork: Whew! Scrubbing decks is hard work!
texts.SSAnne_Deck_Text_FeelSeasick:
Urf… I feel ill…

I got seasick, so I stepped out to get some air…
texts.SSAnne_Deck_Text_EdmondIntro:
Hey, matey!

Let's do a little jig!
texts.SSAnne_Deck_Text_EdmondPostBattle: How many kinds of POKéMON do you think there are in this big world?
texts.SSAnne_Deck_Text_TrevorPostBattle: My pa said there are 100 kinds of POKéMON. I think there are more.
texts.SSAnne_Kitchen_Text_BusyOutOfTheWay: You, mon petit! We're busy here! Out of the way!
texts.SSAnne_Kitchen_Text_SawOddBerryInTrash: I saw an odd BERRY in the trash. I wonder what that was?
texts.SSAnne_Kitchen_Text_SoBusyImDizzy: I'm so busy I'm getting dizzy! You have to give me room here!
texts.SSAnne_Kitchen_Text_PeelSpudsEveryDay:
Hum-de-hum-de-ho…

I peel spuds every day! Hum-hum…
texts.SSAnne_Kitchen_Text_HearAboutSnorlaxItsA:
Did you hear about SNORLAX? It's a glutton.

No other POKéMON eats and sleeps the way SNORLAX can and does!
texts.SSAnne_Kitchen_Text_OnlyGetToPeelOnions:
Snivel… Sniff…

I only get to peel onions… Snivel…
texts.SSAnne_Kitchen_Text_IAmLeChefMainCourseI:
Er-hem! Indeed I am le CHEF!

Le main course is
texts.SSAnne_Kitchen_Text_SalmonDuSalad:
Salmon du Salad!

Les guests may gripe it's fish again, however!
texts.SSAnne_Kitchen_Text_EelsAuBarbecue:
Eels au Barbecue!

Les guests will mutiny, I fear.
texts.SSAnne_Kitchen_Text_PrimeBeefsteak:
Prime Beefsteak!

But, have I enough fillets du beef?
texts.ThreeIsland_Text_IslandSign: THREE ISLAND Kin Island of Family Bonding
texts.ThreeIsland_Text_IslandBelongsToUs:
Hyahoo!

From this day on, this island belongs to us!
texts.ThreeIsland_Text_GoBackToKanto:
We don't need you people bringing your noise and trouble here!

We're asking you to go back to KANTO!
texts.ThreeIsland_Text_BossIsOnHisWay:
Hey, go cry somewhere else. Our boss is on his way.

When he gets here, we'll give you a k-rad motorbike show you won't soon forget!
texts.ThreeIsland_Text_GetOffIslandNow: W-what!? Not on your life! Get off the island now!
texts.ThreeIsland_Text_AreYouBossGoBackToKanto: Are you the boss? Go back to KANTO right now!
texts.ThreeIsland_Text_JustGotHerePal:
Hah?

I just got here, pal.

What's with the hostile attitude? It's mighty cold of you!
texts.ThreeIsland_Text_FollowersRaisingHavoc:
Your gang of followers have been raising havoc on their bikes.

Do you have any idea how much trouble they've caused us on the island?
texts.ThreeIsland_Text_OughtToBeThankingUs:
No, man, I don't get it at all.

Look at this place. What do you do for entertainment?

You ought to be thanking us for livening up this sleepy village.

But hey, if you insist, you can try making us leave.
texts.ThreeIsland_Text_YouCowardsToughInPack: Grr… You cowards… So tough in a pack…
texts.ThreeIsland_Text_WannaMakeSomethingOfYou:
You, what are you staring at? Don't you know it's not polite?

You wanna make something of it or what?
texts.ThreeIsland_Text_ThatsSmart: That's smart. Keep your nose out of this.
texts.ThreeIsland_Text_Biker1Intro: Heh, I like your guts. You'll be losing money to me, but…
texts.ThreeIsland_Text_Biker1PostBattle: Aww, man… Don't you dare laugh!
texts.ThreeIsland_Text_Biker2Intro: Aren't you from KANTO? You should be on our side!
texts.ThreeIsland_Text_Biker2PostBattle:
What's the matter with you, getting all hot like that?

Totally uncool, man!
texts.ThreeIsland_Text_Biker3Intro:
We invited the boss out here, but you had to mess it up!

You embarrassed us, man!
texts.ThreeIsland_Text_Biker3PostBattle: Boss, I'm telling you, you've gotta do something about this kid!
texts.ThreeIsland_Text_PaxtonIntro:
I've been watching you, and I'd say you've done enough.

What are you, their friend or something?

Then I guess you'll be battling me in their place.
texts.ThreeIsland_Text_PaxtonDefeat:
All right, enough! We'll leave like you wanted!

We'll be happy to see the last of this boring island!
texts.ThreeIsland_Text_PaxtonPostBattle: Humph! Yeah, go right on hanging around with these hayseeds!
texts.ThreeIsland_Text_ThankYouOhYourMonGotHur:
Thank you! Those goons were nothing but bad trouble.

Oh, look, your POKéMON got hurt on my account.
texts.ThreeIsland_Text_YouveGotImpressiveMons: You've got seriously impressive POKéMON with you.
texts.ThreeIsland_Text_LostelleWentOffTowardsB:
It'd be fantastic if someone as strong as you lived here.

I hope you'll at least stay here a while.

…I beg your pardon? You're looking for LOSTELLE?

LOSTELLE went off towards BOND BRIDGE a while ago.
texts.ThreeIsland_Text_WouldntWantToSeeBikersH:
THREE ISLAND is actually the most populous of the islands here.

Still, it could be less sleepy.

But I wouldn't want to see goons like those BIKERS here again.
texts.ThreeIsland_Text_WhenDodouEvolvesGoingTo:
I'm going to train my DODUO in the BERRY FOREST.

When it evolves, I'm going to play a game on TWO ISLAND.
texts.ThreeIsland_BerryForest_Text_HelpScaryPo:
LOSTELLE: Whimper… Sniff… Oh! Please, help!

A scary POKéMON appeared there a little while ago.

It kept scaring. It made LOSTELLE scared.

I'm too scared to move! But I want to go home…
texts.ThreeIsland_BerryForest_Text_HereItComes:
Oh! Here it comes again! No! Go away! It's scaring me!

Waaaaaaah! I want my daddy!
texts.ThreeIsland_BerryForest_Text_ThankYouHav:
Ohh! That was so scary! Thank you!

LOSTELLE came to pick some BERRIES.

You can have this!
texts.ThreeIsland_BerryForest_Text_LetsGoHome:
What's your name?

LOSTELLE's scared, so can I go with you to my daddy's house?

Okay! Let's go home!
texts.ThreeIsland_BerryForest_Text_BerryPouchI: Your BERRY POUCH is full. I guess you don't want this.
texts.ThreeIsland_BerryForest_Text_WelcomeToBe:
Welcome to the BERRY FOREST

Be friendly and share BERRIES with others and POKéMON.
texts.ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_NikkiIntro: The salty tang of the sea… It tickles my heart.
texts.ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_NikkiPostBat: Perhaps that reek is your sweaty POKéMON's body odor…
texts.ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_VioletIntro: Where are you off to in such a hurry?
texts.ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_VioletPostBa: If you keep going this way, you'll eventually reach BERRY FOREST.
texts.ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_AmiraIntro: My mommy said that I can't swim without my float ring.
texts.ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_AmiraPostBat: This year, I'm going to finally learn how to swim!
texts.ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_AlexisPostBa: Did I just win? Or did I lose?
texts.ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_TishaIntro: Oh, no, don't come here! Please, stay away from me!
texts.ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_TishaDefeat: Okay, you've won! Now will you please go away?
texts.ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_TishaPostBat:
A POKéMON bit through my  swimsuit.

I can't get out of the water!
texts.ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_JoyIntro: JOY: We'll teach you what our favorite POKéMON is!
texts.ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_JoyPostBattl: JOY: Wasn't that fun? I hope we can battle again!
texts.ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_JoyNotEnough:
JOY: I really want to battle with MEG.

One POKéMON isn't enough.
texts.ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_MegIntro: MEG: We'll show you our favorite POKéMON.
texts.ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_MegNotEnough:
MEG: I want to battle together with JOY.

One POKéMON isn't enough.
texts.ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_BondBridgeSi:
BOND BRIDGE Please be quiet when crossing.

BERRY FOREST AHEAD
texts.ThreeIsland_DunsparceTunnel_Text_Prospec:
Hey, there! How's it going?

What am I doing here, you ask? Why, I'm prospecting for gold!

When I strike it rich, I'm buying a house in KANTO.
texts.ThreeIsland_DunsparceTunnel_Text_StruckG:
Hey, there! How's it going? Did you hear? I've struck gold!

You remembered that I was prospecting, didn't you?

You can't begin to imagine just how happy I am.

So, I'll show you! This is for you!
texts.ThreeIsland_DunsparceTunnel_Text_ThatsAN:
That's a NUGGET!

I can't give you any nuggets of wisdom, so that'll have to do!
texts.ThreeIsland_DunsparceTunnel_Text_WhoopsB: Whoops, your BAG is crammed full! I'll give this to you later.
texts.ThreeIsland_House1_Text_YoureAlwaysSoCoo:
LOSTELLE: Hi, {PLAYER}! You're always so cool!

I'll make lunch for you, too, one day, {PLAYER}.
texts.ThreeIsland_House1_Text_RareRocksGemsDis: Rare rocks and gems are displayed.
texts.ThreeIsland_House2_Text_CantMakeThisSpoo:
Urrrrrrrrgggghhhh… Kwaaaaah!

…It's useless! I can't make this spoon bend with my mind.

Maybe I really don't have any psychic powers.
texts.ThreeIsland_House2_Text_IAdmireSabrina:
You know about a girl GYM LEADER in SAFFRON CITY?

She uses PSYCHIC-type POKéMON, right?

I admire her, I really do.

I've heard that she's one cool customer and beautiful, too.
texts.ThreeIsland_House3_Text_WantedToLiveSome:
I bought this house because I wanted to live somewhere quiet.

Today, I think I'll go out fishing.
texts.ThreeIsland_House4_Text_GhostsInBerryFor:
You must never, ever go out to the BERRY FOREST alone.

Why? There are ghosts there.
texts.ThreeIsland_House4_Text_PapaKeepsLyingTo: Papa keeps lying to me, and won't let me go out and play!
texts.ThreeIsland_House5_Text_ImNotLostelle:
Me? I'm not LOSTELLE.

She's probably gone to the BERRY FOREST, I think.

She picks BERRIES there for making lunch.
texts.ThreeIsland_House5_Text_IllGoPlayWithLos: I think I'll go play with LOSTELLE today.
texts.ThreeIsland_Mart_Text_TrueThatCeldadonDe:
Is it true?

CELADON DEPT. STORE is several times bigger than this shop?
texts.ThreeIsland_Mart_Text_PeopleHealWithBerr:
I sometimes buy medicine here.

But a lot of people heal POKéMON with BERRIES from BERRY FOREST.

After all, BERRIES are free and they never run out.
texts.ThreeIsland_Mart_Text_BikersWereAboutToT:
Those BIKERS were about to trash this POKéMON MART.

Am I glad they decided to leave!
texts.ThreeIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_PCNetw:
Hey, did you hear the news?

The PC network here can now link with PCs in KANTO.

I don't know how that came about, but it's fantastic!
texts.ThreeIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Imposs:
It's impossible to SURF between the islands around these parts.

The tides are too fast and treacherous.
texts.ThreeIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Always:
Let's crush BERRIES! …That'd be wasting BERRIES?

You can always find some BERRIES on the ground in BERRY FOREST.
texts.ThreeIsland_Port_Text_WereKantoRiderFede:
We're the KANTO RIDER FEDERATION! Vroom! Vavavavooom! Vroom!

My bike's wimpy, so I have to make exhaust noises myself!
texts.ThreeIsland_Port_Text_ForkOverMoney: Hey, hey, lady! Fork over some spending money!
texts.ThreeIsland_Port_Text_IllCallThePolice:
Aiyeeh!

Wh-who are you?! I… I'll call the police!
texts.ThreeIsland_Port_Text_ThankGoodnessBiker:
Those BIKERS… Are they gone?

Oh, thank goodness! They certainly had me terrified!
texts.ThreeIsland_Port_Text_EverythingTurnedOu:
Those BIKERS ran off, and LOSTELLE was found safe.

Everything turned out for the best!
texts.TrainerTower_Lobby_Text_WelcomeToTrainer:
Hello!

Welcome to TRAINER TOWER where TRAINERS gather from all over!
texts.TrainerTower_Lobby_Text_TrainersUpToFloo:
TRAINERS from all over the world gather here to battle.

Let me see…

Right now, there are TRAINERS only up to Floor {STR_VAR_1}.
texts.TrainerTower_Lobby_Text_TrainersUpEighth: TRAINERS are awaiting your challenge up to the eighth floor.
texts.TrainerTower_Lobby_Text_LikeToChallengeT: Would you like to challenge the waiting TRAINERS?
texts.TrainerTower_Lobby_Text_StartClockGetSet:
Okay, I'll get the clock started, so give it everything you have.

On your marks…

Get set…

Go!
texts.TrainerTower_Lobby_Text_TooBadComeBackTr:
That was too bad.

I think you put in a tremendous effort in your battling.

Please come back and try again!
texts.TrainerTower_Lobby_Text_GiveItYourBest: I hope you give it your best.
texts.TrainerTower_Lobby_Text_MoveCounterHereW:
When the TRAINERS switch places, the movement can be hectic.

To avoid the stampede, we moved the reception counter here.

I'm sorry for the inconvenience.
texts.TrainerTower_Roof_Text_ImOwnerBattledPer:
Hello…

I am the owner of this TOWER…

How the sky soars above this rooftop…

The caress of the winds up here…

It's all so perfect…

The way you battled… It, too, was perfection…
texts.TrainerTower_Roof_Text_DoneItInRecordTim:
Oh! Stupendous!

It's marvelous how you've come up here so quickly.

The fact is, you've done it in record time…

I'll have your record posted at the reception counter.
texts.TrainerTower_Roof_Text_TookSweetTimeGett: You seem to have taken your sweet time getting here…
texts.TrainerTower_Roof_Text_IdLikeToSeeBetter:
What I would like to see is a better time out of you…

I'm counting on you.

Until then, farewell…
texts.TrainerTower_Lobby_Text_NeedTwoMonsForDo:
This is a two-on-two battle.

You may not battle unless you have at least two POKéMON.
texts.TrainerTower_Lobby_Text_ExplainTrainerTo:
Here at TRAINER TOWER, there is an event called TIME ATTACK.

You will be timed on how quickly you can get from the reception counter to the OWNER on the roof.

The best times will be recorded on the Time Board.

Try competing with friends to see who can beat it the fastest.

You will not earn any EXP. Points or money by beating TRAINERS here.
texts.TrainerTower_Lobby_Text_WonderWhatKindsO:
I'm here to see how good I am.

I wonder what kinds of TRAINERS are waiting for me?

It's nerve-racking!
texts.TrainerTower_Lobby_Text_StairsTougherTha:
Gasp, gasp… Gasp…

Never mind battling! These stairs… They're tougher than any battle…
texts.TwoIsland_Text_IslandSign: TWO ISLAND Boon Island for Two
texts.TwoIsland_Text_DangerFastCurrent: DANGER! FAST CURRENT! Fishing and surfing prohibited!
texts.TwoIsland_Text_WelcomeToShopMerchandiseL:
Oh! Hello, welcome to my shop!

We've only opened up recently.

Our merchandise is limited, but I hope we can serve your needs.
texts.TwoIsland_Text_AddedMerchandiseForLostel:
I can't tell you how grateful I am for your rescue of LOSTELLE.

Thanks to your feat, the people of THREE ISLAND have changed their attitudes about KANTO people.

And, I'm from KANTO, you see.

The people of THREE ISLAND helped me add to my merchandise.
texts.TwoIsland_Text_HopeYouGiveItYourBest: Hi! I'm giving it my best here. I hope you do too, {PLAYER}.
texts.TwoIsland_Text_BringingItemsFromDistantL:
Oh, hello, {PLAYER}! Welcome!

I've started bringing in items from distant lands.

I've got some rare items in, too. Please have a look!
texts.TwoIsland_Text_FellowMovedFromCeladonCit:
That fellow there, he moved here from CELADON CITY.

He started up a shop with his younger brother.

You have to wonder if he knew what he was getting into.
texts.TwoIsland_Text_ShopkeepersBrotherWorksGa:
The shopkeeper's brother took a job at the GAME CORNER.

He's trying to pull together money so they can buy more merchandise.
texts.TwoIsland_Text_BrunoCameToIslandWhileBac:
Listen, listen. Did you know?

A famous TRAINER came to the ISLAND a little while back.

He's one of the ELITE FOUR. His name is BRUNO.

He went away disappointed when he found out that they were all sold out of Rage Candybars.
texts.TwoIsland_Text_BuyRareItemsHere: The discerning TRAINER knows to buy rare items here!
texts.TwoIsland_Text_OldWomanLivesOutOnCape:
There's an old woman who lives in a cottage out on the cape.

She gives the eye to POKéMON. It's a bit unnerving.
texts.TwoIsland_Text_HaveYouTriedJumpingGame:
Boing! Boing! Have you tried the jumping game?

The POKéMON you can enter… Boing!

Some go boing!

And some go boooooooing!

Did you know that? Boing!
texts.Text_UltimateMoveThatMon:
I perfected the ultimate move of its type…

But will no one take it for future use?

…Hm? Hmmm!

Y-you… Th-that {STR_VAR_1}…
texts.Text_AllowMeToTeachMonUltimateMove:
Oh! This is the one! This is the POKéMON!

This {STR_VAR_1} is worthy of learning my ultimate move!

Will you allow it?

Will you allow your {STR_VAR_1} to learn my {STR_VAR_2}?
texts.Text_YouRejectIt: Gaah! You reject it? No, I won't be dissuaded!
texts.Text_LetMeConferUltimateMove:
You will allow it?

Then, let me confer my ultimate {STR_VAR_2} on your {STR_VAR_1}.

Ggggrah-awooo!
texts.Text_TaughtMove:
Gasp, gasp, gasp…

I didn't think I could teach that move while I still lived…
texts.Text_MakeBestUseOfMove: I implore you to make the best use of that move and gain power!
texts.Text_PassedOnEverythingIKnow:
Gasp, gasp, gasp…

I have no regrets now. I've passed on everything I know.

Now I can live out my life knowing my work is done.
texts.Text_FeelRejuvenated:
After I passed on my knowledge to you, I felt so much relief.

In fact, I feel rejuvenated, as if I were younger again!
texts.TwoIsland_House_Text_TeachMonMoveForMush:
I'm the POKéMON MOVE MANIAC.

I know every single move that POKéMON learn growing up.

I'm also a mushroom maniac.

Bring me two TINYMUSHROOMS, or one BIG MUSHROOM.

If you do that for me, I'll teach a move to one POKéMON.
texts.TwoIsland_House_Text_WantMeToTeachMove:
Sniff, sniff… Hm! You smell of MUSHROOMS!

Do you want me to teach a move to a POKéMON of yours?
texts.TwoIsland_House_Text_NoMoveICanTeachThat:
Sorry…

It doesn't appear as if I have a move I can teach that POKéMON.
texts.TwoIsland_House_Text_IllNeedMushroomOrTw: Then, I'll need a MUSHROOM or two. What are you going to give me?
texts.TwoIsland_House_Text_HandedOverTwoTinyMu: {PLAYER} handed over two TINYMUSHROOMS in exchange.
texts.TwoIsland_House_Text_HandedOverOneBigMus: {PLAYER} handed over one BIG MUSHROOM in exchange.
texts.TwoIsland_House_Text_NeedMushroomOrTwoTo: If your POKéMON need to learn a move, I need a MUSHROOM or two.
texts.TwoIsland_House_Text_CantTeachAnEgg: Hunh? There isn't a single move that I can teach an EGG.
texts.TwoIsland_JoyfulGameCorner_Text_WhereHas:
Now, where's LOSTELLE gotten to today?

She always brings me lunch every day right about now…
texts.TwoIsland_JoyfulGameCorner_Text_PleaseHe:
Hm? You, there! Are you a friend of LOSTELLE's?

Have you seen LOSTELLE around? I don't know where she might be. She should've been here long ago.

LOSTELLE's a cutie - she got my looks - so what if someone…

What if something's happened to my LOSTELLE?!

Please, help me find her! Please go search THREE ISLAND!
texts.TwoIsland_JoyfulGameCorner_Text_IsThisOn:
Hah? What is this GAME CORNER? How much sadder can this get?

Those clowns…

They said they'd be waiting on the island, so where are they?

Hey, you! Is this the only THREE ISLAND around here?
texts.TwoIsland_JoyfulGameCorner_Text_ThisIsTw:
Try waking up before you crawl out of bed, you punk.

This is TWO ISLAND!

Move it! Get your filthy motorbike out of my place!
texts.TwoIsland_JoyfulGameCorner_Text_TheseIsl:
Huh… Oh, oh, gotcha.

Tch… These islands are confusing…
texts.TwoIsland_JoyfulGameCorner_Text_PunkScuf: Would you look at that? That punk scuffed up my floor.
texts.TwoIsland_JoyfulGameCorner_Text_PleaseGo:
Hey, but listen! I'm begging you, you have to go to THREE ISLAND.

If anything were to happen to my LOSTELLE…

My place is the house with the red roof on THREE ISLAND.

She may just show up late here, so I can't run off anywhere.

That's why I have to get you to do me this big favor.
texts.TwoIsland_JoyfulGameCorner_Text_NotRunni: I'm sorry. We're not running any games today.
texts.TwoIsland_JoyfulGameCorner_Text_GetGames: We'll get the games going soon for you!
texts.TwoIsland_JoyfulGameCorner_Text_YouRescu:
So you rescued LOSTELLE? How can I thank you?

LOSTELLE, darling, forgive me!

Daddy didn't know you were scared and in trouble!
texts.TwoIsland_JoyfulGameCorner_Text_Lostelle: LOSTELLE: It's okay, Daddy. I got to be friends with {PLAYER}!
texts.TwoIsland_JoyfulGameCorner_Text_ThisIsFo:
Oh, what's that? You're saying that this is for me?

How did you know that I love rare rocks and gems?

You sure know how to make a guy happy.
texts.TwoIsland_JoyfulGameCorner_Text_HandedMe: {PLAYER} handed the METEORITE to LOSTELLE's daddy.
texts.TwoIsland_JoyfulGameCorner_Text_OhThisIs:
Oh, I see, this is from BILL! You have to thank him for me!

You know, you've been fantastic. I want you to have this.
texts.TwoIsland_JoyfulGameCorner_Text_Received: {PLAYER} received a MOON STONE from LOSTELLE's daddy.
texts.TwoIsland_JoyfulGameCorner_Text_NotGoing: Your BAG's not going to fit another thing…
texts.TwoIsland_JoyfulGameCorner_Text_IllGetGa:
All right, I'll get the GAME CORNER running right away.

You have to come visit with a friend.
texts.TwoIsland_JoyfulGameCorner_Text_PleaseSh:
Listen, listen!

Please show me you being cool again!
texts.TwoIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_HaveYouV:
Have you visited the GAME CORNER already?

It's no good to go alone. You have to take a friend along.
texts.TwoIsland_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_OldLadyL:
Not many people live on TWO ISLAND.

There is this old lady who lives out on the cape.

She's been there since I don't know when.
texts.UndergroundPath_EastEntrance_Text_DoYouG:
The DEPARTMENT STORE in CELADON has a great selection.

Do you go there very often?
texts.UndergroundPath_SouthEntrance_Text_Peopl: People often lose things in the darkness of the UNDERGROUND PATH.
texts.UndergroundPath_WestEntrance_Text_Sleepy: I heard a sleepy POKéMON appeared out near CELADON CITY, too.
texts.VermilionCity_Text_GrimerMultipliesInSlu:
We're careful about pollution here.

We've heard GRIMER multiplies in toxic sludge.
texts.VermilionCity_Text_DidYouSeeSSAnneInHarb: Did you see the S.S. ANNE moored in the harbor?
texts.VermilionCity_Text_SSAnneHasDepartedForY:
So, the S.S. ANNE has departed?

She'll be back in VERMILION about this time next year.
texts.VermilionCity_Text_BuildingOnThisLand:
I'm putting up a building on this plot of land. I own it all.

My POKéMON is tamping the land to lay the foundation.
texts.VermilionCity_Text_MachopStompingLandFla: A MACHOP is stomping the land flat.
texts.VermilionCity_Text_SSAnneVisitsOnceAYear:
The S.S. ANNE is a famous luxury cruise ship.

It visits VERMILION once a year.
texts.VermilionCity_Text_CitySign: VERMILION CITY The Port of Exquisite Sunsets
texts.VermilionCity_Text_SnorlaxBlockingRoute1:
NOTICE!

ROUTE 12 may be blocked off by a sleeping POKéMON.

Detour through ROCK TUNNEL to LAVENDER TOWN.

VERMILION POLICE
texts.VermilionCity_Text_PokemonFanClubSign: POKéMON FAN CLUB All POKéMON fans welcome!
texts.VermilionCity_Text_GymSign: VERMILION CITY POKéMON GYM LEADER: LT. SURGE The Lightning American!
texts.VermilionCity_Text_DoYouHaveATicket:
Welcome to the S.S. ANNE!

Excuse me, do you have a ticket?
texts.VermilionCity_Text_FlashedSSTicket:
{FONT_NORMAL}{PLAYER} flashed the S.S. TICKET!

{FONT_MALE}Great! Welcome to the S.S. ANNE!
texts.VermilionCity_Text_DontHaveNeededSSTicke:
{FONT_NORMAL}{PLAYER} doesn't have the needed S.S. TICKET.

{FONT_MALE}Sorry!

You need a ticket to get aboard.
texts.VermilionCity_Text_BoardSeagallopTriPass:
Ah, you have a TRI-PASS.

Would you like to board a SEAGALLOP ferry?
texts.VermilionCity_Text_Seagallop7Departing:
Okay, everything's in order.

SEAGALLOP HI-SPEED 7 will be departing immediately.
texts.VermilionCity_Text_BoardSeagallopRainbow:
Ah, you have a RAINBOW PASS.

Would you like to board a SEAGALLOP ferry?
texts.VermilionCity_Text_OhMysticTicketTakeYou:
Oh! That's a MYSTICTICKET! Now that is rare.

We'll be happy to take you to NAVEL ROCK anytime.
texts.VermilionCity_Text_OhAuroraTicketTakeYou:
Oh! That's an AURORATICKET! Now that is rare.

We'll be happy to take you to BIRTH ISLAND anytime.
texts.VermilionCity_Text_BoardSeagallopFerry: Would you like to board a SEAGALLOP ferry?
texts.VermilionCity_Text_Seagallop10Departing:
Okay, everything's in order for you to board a special ferry.

SEAGALLOP HI-SPEED 10 will be departing immediately.
texts.VermilionCity_Text_Seagallop12Departing:
Okay, everything's in order for you to board a special ferry.

SEAGALLOP HI-SPEED 12 will be departing immediately.
texts.VermilionCity_Text_Route2AideHasPackageF:
Oh, hello, {PLAYER}! How are you doing?

It's me, one of PROF. OAK's AIDES.

Did you meet the other AIDE?

He had a package from PROF. OAK for you, {PLAYER}.

He said he'd look for you around ROUTE 2, {PLAYER}.

If you're in the ROUTE 2 area, please look for him.
texts.VermilionCity_Gym_Text_LtSurgeIntro:
Hey, kid! What do you think you're doing here?

You won't live long in combat! Not with your puny power!

I tell you, kid, electric POKéMON saved me during the war!

They zapped my enemies into paralysis!

The same as I'll do to you!{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_ENCOUNTER_GYM_LEADER}
texts.VermilionCity_Gym_Text_LtSurgePostBattle:
A little word of advice, kid!

Electricity is sure powerful!

But, it's useless against GROUND- type POKéMON!
texts.VermilionCity_Gym_Text_ExplainThunderBad:
The THUNDERBADGE cranks up your POKéMON's SPEED!

It also lets your POKéMON FLY lightning-quick anytime, kid!

You're special, kid! Take this!
texts.VermilionCity_Gym_Text_ExplainTM34:
TM34 contains SHOCK WAVE!

Teach it to an ELECTRIC POKéMON!
texts.VermilionCity_Gym_Text_MakeRoomInYourBag: Yo, kid, make room in your BAG!
texts.VermilionCity_Gym_Text_LtSurgeDefeat:
Now that's a shocker!

You're the real deal, kid!

Fine, then, take the THUNDERBADGE!
texts.VermilionCity_Gym_Text_TuckerIntro:
When I was in the Army, LT. SURGE was my strict CO.

He was a hard taskmaster.
texts.VermilionCity_Gym_Text_TuckerPostBattle:
It's not easy opening that door.

LT. SURGE was always famous for his cautious nature in the Army.
texts.VermilionCity_Gym_Text_BailyIntro:
I'm a lightweight, but I'm good with electricity!

That's why I joined this GYM.
texts.VermilionCity_Gym_Text_BailyPostBattle:
Okay, I'll talk!

LT. SURGE said he hid door switches inside something.
texts.VermilionCity_Gym_Text_DwayneIntro: This is no place for kids! Not even if you're good!
texts.VermilionCity_Gym_Text_DwaynePostBattle:
LT. SURGE installed the traps in the GYM himself.

He set up double locks everywhere. Let me give you a hint.

When you open the first lock, the second lock is right next to it.
texts.VermilionCity_Gym_Text_GymGuyAdvice:
Yo! Champ in the making!

LT. SURGE has a nickname.

People refer to him as the Lightning American!

He's an expert on electric POKéMON.

BIRD/WATER-type POKéMON match poorly against the ELECTRIC type.

Beware of paralysis, too.

LT. SURGE is very cautious.

He's locked himself in, so it won't be easy getting to him.
texts.VermilionCity_Gym_Text_GymStatue:
VERMILION POKéMON GYM LEADER: LT. SURGE

WINNING TRAINERS: {RIVAL}
texts.VermilionCity_Gym_Text_GymStatuePlayerWo:
VERMILION POKéMON GYM LEADER: LT. SURGE

WINNING TRAINERS: {RIVAL}, {PLAYER}
texts.VermilionCity_Gym_Text_SwitchUnderTrashF:
Hey! There's a switch under the trash! Turn it on!

The first electric lock opened!
texts.VermilionCity_Gym_Text_AnotherSwitchInTr: ガサゴソ‥！ おっと！　ゴミばこの　そこに また　スイッチが　あった！ おして　みよう！　‥　ポチッとな
texts.VermilionCity_Gym_Text_SecondLockOpened: The second electric lock opened! The motorized door opened!
texts.VermilionCity_Gym_Text_OnlyTrashLocksWer:
Nope! There's only trash here.

Hey! The electric locks were reset!
texts.VermilionCity_House1_Text_ImFishingGuruD:
I'm the FISHING GURU!

I simply looove fishing! I can't bear to go without.

Tell me, do you like to fish?
texts.VermilionCity_House1_Text_TakeThisAndFis:
Grand! I like your style. I think we can be friends.

Take this and fish, young friend!
texts.VermilionCity_House1_Text_ReceivedOldRod: {PLAYER} received an OLD ROD from the FISHING GURU.
texts.VermilionCity_House1_Text_FishingIsAWayO:
Fishing is a way of life! It is like the finest poetry.

From the seas to rivers, go out and land the big one, my friend.
texts.VermilionCity_House1_Text_HowAreTheFishB:
Hello there, {PLAYER}!

How are the fish biting?
texts.VermilionCity_House1_Text_NoRoomForNiceG:
Oh, no!

I had a nice gift for you, but you have no room for it!
texts.VermilionCity_House2_Text_DoYouHaveMonWa:
Hi! Do you have a {STR_VAR_1}?

Want to trade it for my {STR_VAR_2}?
texts.VermilionCity_House2_Text_ThisIsNoMon:
…This is no {STR_VAR_1}.

If you get one, please trade it to me!
texts.VermilionCity_House2_Text_HowIsMyOldMon:
How is my old {STR_VAR_2}?

My {STR_VAR_1} is doing great!
texts.VermilionCity_House3_Text_PidgeyFlyLette: I'm getting my PIDGEY to fly a letter to SAFFRON in the north.
texts.VermilionCity_House3_Text_DearPippiLette:
Dear PIPPI, I hope to see you soon.

I heard SAFFRON has problems with TEAM ROCKET.

VERMILION appears to be safe.
texts.VermilionCity_House3_Text_SendMyPidgeyTo:
I want to exchange MAIL with all sorts of people.

I send my PIDGEY to a UNION ROOM to exchange MAIL for me.
texts.VermilionCity_Mart_Text_TeamRocketAreWic:
There are wicked people who will use POKéMON for criminal acts.

TEAM ROCKET traffics in rare POKéMON, for example.

They also abandon POKéMON that they consider unpopular or useless.

That's the sort of horrid people they are, TEAM ROCKET.
texts.VermilionCity_Mart_Text_MonsGoodOrBadDep: I think POKéMON can be good or bad. It depends on the TRAINER.
texts.VermilionCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Trai:
Even if they are the same level, POKéMON can have very different stats and abilities.

A POKéMON raised by a TRAINER is stronger than one in the wild.
texts.VermilionCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Pois: My POKéMON was poisoned! It fainted while we were walking!
texts.VermilionCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_AllM:
It is true that a higher-level POKéMON will be more powerful…

But, all POKéMON will have weak points against specific types.

So, there appears to be no universally strong POKéMON.
texts.VermilionCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Urge:
The urge to battle with someone you've tangled with before…

Have you ever had that urge? I'm sure you have.

I wanted to battle certain people again over and over, too.

So, I've been giving these away. Please, take one!
texts.VermilionCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_UseD:
Use that device and you'll find TRAINERS looking for a rematch.

You have to charge its battery to use it, though.
texts.VermilionCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_Expl:
How do you use the VS SEEKER? There's nothing to it.

Use it like beep-beep-beep, and TRAINERS around you will notice.

If any TRAINER wants a rematch, it will let you know immediately.

Charge its battery and use it while you're on a road.
texts.VermilionCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_Admire: Won't you admire my PIKACHU's adorable tail?
texts.VermilionCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_Pikach:
Humph!

My PIKACHU is twice as cute as that one!
texts.VermilionCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_AdoreM:
I just adore my SEEL! It's so lovable!

It squeals, “Kyuuuh,” when I hug it!
texts.VermilionCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_SeelFa:
Oh, dear!

My SEEL is far more attractive. By double, I would say.
texts.VermilionCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_DidYou:
I chair the POKéMON Fan Club!

I raise more than a hundred POKéMON!

I'm very fussy when it comes to POKéMON! I surely am!

So…

Did you come visit to hear about my POKéMON?
texts.VermilionCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_Chairm:
Good! Then listen up!

My favorite RAPIDASH…

It's…cute…lovely…smart…  plus…amazing…you think so?… oh yes…it's…stunning… kindly…love it!

Hug it…when…sleeping…warm and cuddly…spectacular… ravishing… …Oops! Look at the time! I kept you too long!

Thanks for hearing me out! I want you to have this!
texts.VermilionCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_Receiv: {PLAYER} received a BIKE VOUCHER from the CHAIRMAN.
texts.VermilionCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_Explai:
Take that BIKE VOUCHER to the BIKE SHOP in CERULEAN CITY.

Exchange that for a BICYCLE free of charge!

Don't worry, my favorite FEAROW will FLY me anywhere I need to go.

So, I have no need for a BICYCLE.

I hope you like cycling!
texts.VermilionCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_ComeBa: Oh. Come back when you want to hear my story!
texts.VermilionCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_DidntC:
Hello, {PLAYER}!

Did you come see me about my POKéMON again?

No? Too bad!
texts.VermilionCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_Chairm: Our CHAIRMAN is very vocal about POKéMON.
texts.VermilionCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_Listen: Let's all listen politely to other TRAINERS!
texts.VermilionCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_Someon: If someone brags, brag right back!
texts.VermilionCity_PokemonFanClub_Text_Chairm:
Our CHAIRMAN really does adore his POKéMON.

But the person who is most liked by POKéMON is DAISY, I think.
texts.VictoryRoad_1F_Text_NaomiIntro: I wonder if you are good enough for me?
texts.VictoryRoad_1F_Text_NaomiPostBattle: I never wanted to lose to anybody, especially to a younger kid…
texts.VictoryRoad_1F_Text_RolandoIntro: I can see you're good. Let me see exactly how good!
texts.VictoryRoad_1F_Text_RolandoPostBattle: Tch! I concede, you are better than I!
texts.VictoryRoad_2F_Text_DawsonIntro: If you can get through here, you can go meet the ELITE FOUR.
texts.VictoryRoad_2F_Text_DawsonPostBattle: I can beat you when it comes to knowledge about POKéMON!
texts.VictoryRoad_2F_Text_DaisukeIntro: This here is VICTORY ROAD. It's the final test for TRAINERS!
texts.VictoryRoad_2F_Text_DaisukePostBattle: If you get stuck, try moving some boulders around.
texts.VictoryRoad_2F_Text_NelsonIntro: Ah, so you wish to challenge the ELITE FOUR?
texts.VictoryRoad_2F_Text_VincentPostBattle: You earned the right to be on VICTORY ROAD…
texts.VictoryRoad_2F_Text_GregoryPostBattle: Many TRAINERS give up their challenge here and go home.
texts.Text_DoubleEdgeTeach:
You should be proud of yourself, having battled your way through VICTORY ROAD so courageously.

In recognition of your feat, I'll teach you DOUBLE-EDGE.

Would you like me to teach that technique?
texts.Text_DoubleEdgeDeclined: I'll teach you the technique anytime.
texts.Text_DoubleEdgeWhichMon: Which POKéMON should I teach DOUBLE-EDGE?
texts.Text_DoubleEdgeTaught:
Keep that drive going for the POKéMON LEAGUE!

Take a run at them and knock 'em out!
texts.VictoryRoad_3F_Text_GeorgeIntro: I heard rumors of a child prodigy.
texts.VictoryRoad_3F_Text_GeorgePostBattle: So, it was you who beat GIOVANNI of TEAM ROCKET?
texts.VictoryRoad_3F_Text_AlexaIntro: TRAINERS live to seek stronger opponents.
texts.VictoryRoad_3F_Text_AlexaPostBattle: By fighting tough battles, you get stronger.
texts.VictoryRoad_3F_Text_CarolineIntro: I'll show you just how good you are. Not!
texts.VictoryRoad_3F_Text_CarolinePostBattle: You showed me just how good I was…
texts.VictoryRoad_3F_Text_ColbyIntro: Only the chosen can pass here!
texts.VictoryRoad_3F_Text_ColbyPostBattle:
All TRAINERS here are headed to the POKéMON LEAGUE.

Don't let down your guard.
texts.VictoryRoad_3F_Text_RayIntro: RAY: Together, the two of us are destined for greatness!
texts.VictoryRoad_3F_Text_RayPostBattle: RAY: You've beaten us. Greatness remains elusive…
texts.VictoryRoad_3F_Text_RayNotEnoughMons:
RAY: Together, the two of us are striving for the pinnacle.

We need you to bring two POKéMON into battle with us.
texts.VictoryRoad_3F_Text_TyraIntro: TYRA: We're trying to become champions together.
texts.VictoryRoad_3F_Text_TyraPostBattle: TYRA: You've taught me that power can be infinite in shape and form.
texts.VictoryRoad_3F_Text_TyraNotEnoughMons: TYRA: You can't battle with us if you have only one POKéMON.
texts.ViridianCity_Text_CanCarryMonsAnywhere:
Those POKé BALLS at your waist! You have POKéMON, don't you?

It's great that you can carry and use POKéMON anytime, anywhere.
texts.ViridianCity_Text_GymClosedWonderWhoLead:
This POKéMON GYM is always closed.

I wonder who the LEADER is?
texts.ViridianCity_Text_WantToKnowAboutCaterpi: You want to know about the two kinds of caterpillar POKéMON?
texts.ViridianCity_Text_ExplainCaterpieWeedle:
CATERPIE has no poison, but WEEDLE does.

Watch that your POKéMON aren't stabbed by WEEDLE's POISON STING.
texts.ViridianCity_Text_GrandpaHasntHadCoffeeY:
Oh, Grandpa! Don't be so mean!

I'm so sorry. He hasn't had his coffee yet.
texts.ViridianCity_Text_GoShoppingInPewterOcca:
I go shopping in PEWTER CITY occasionally.

I have to take the winding trail in VIRIDIAN FOREST when I go.
texts.ViridianCity_Text_ThisIsPrivateProperty:
I absolutely forbid you from going through here!

This is private property!
texts.ViridianCity_Text_ShowYouHowToCatchMons:
Well, now, I've had my coffee, and that's what I need to get going!

Hm? What is that red box you have?

Ah, so you're working on your POKéDEX.

Then let me give you a word of advice.

Whenever you catch a POKéMON, the POKéDEX automatically updates its data.

…You don't know how to catch a POKéMON?

I suppose I had better show you then!
texts.ViridianCity_Text_ThatWasEducationalTake:
There! Now tell me, that was educational, was it not?

And here, take this, too.
texts.ViridianCity_Text_WatchThatToLearnBasics:
If there's something you don't understand, watch that.

It will teach you about the basics of being a POKéMON TRAINER.
texts.ViridianCity_Text_WeakenMonsFirstToCatch:
Well, now, I've had my coffee, and that's what I need to get going!

But I made it too strong. It gave me a headache…

Incidentally, are you filling your POKéDEX?

At first, focus on weakening the POKéMON before trying to catch it.
texts.ViridianCity_Text_HowsTeachyTVHelping:
Well, now, I've had my coffee, and that's what I need to get going!

But I made it too strong. It gave me a headache…

Incidentally, is my old TEACHY TV helping you?
texts.ViridianCity_Text_MyGrandsonOnTheShow:
Wahaha! It's my grandson on the show!

Since he's the one doing the teaching, you're bound to learn.
texts.ViridianCity_Text_TooBusyForTeachyTV:
Hm… You're too busy to not even have the time for TEACHY TV…

Time is money, and neither should be ill spent…
texts.ViridianCity_Text_CitySign: VIRIDIAN CITY  The Eternally Green Paradise
texts.ViridianCity_Text_CatchMonsForEasierBatt:
TRAINER TIPS

Catch POKéMON and expand your collection.

The more you have, the easier it is to battle.
texts.ViridianCity_Text_MovesLimitedByPP:
TRAINER TIPS

The battle moves of POKéMON are limited by their POWER POINTS, PP.

To replenish PP, rest your tired POKéMON at a POKéMON CENTER.
texts.ViridianCity_Gym_Text_GiovanniIntro:
Fwahahaha! Welcome to my hideout!

It shall be so until I can restore TEAM ROCKET to its former glory.

But, you have found me again. So be it. This time, I'm not holding back!

Once more, you shall face GIOVANNI, the greatest TRAINER!{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_ENCOUNTER_ROCKET}
texts.ViridianCity_Gym_Text_GiovanniDefeat:
Ha! That was a truly intense fight. You have won!

As proof, here is the EARTHBADGE! {PAUSE_MUSIC}{PLAY_BGM}{MUS_OBTAIN_BADGE}{PAUSE 0xFE}{PAUSE 0x56}{RESUME_MUSIC}
texts.ViridianCity_Gym_Text_GiovanniPostBattle:
Having lost in this fashion,  I can't face my followers. I have betrayed their trust.

As of today, TEAM ROCKET is finished forever!

As for myself, I shall dedicate my life to training again.

Let us meet again someday! Farewell!
texts.ViridianCity_Gym_Text_ExplainEarthBadgeT:
The EARTHBADGE makes POKéMON of any level obey without question.

It is evidence of your mastery as a POKéMON TRAINER.

With it, you can challenge the POKéMON LEAGUE.

Also, take this TM.

Consider it a gift for your POKéMON LEAGUE challenge.
texts.ViridianCity_Gym_Text_ExplainTM26:
TM26 contains EARTHQUAKE.

It is a powerful attack that causes a massive tremor.

I made it when I ran the GYM here, far too long ago…
texts.ViridianCity_Gym_Text_YouDoNotHaveSpace: You do not have space for this!
texts.ViridianCity_Gym_Text_YujiIntro: Heh! You must be running out of steam by now!
texts.ViridianCity_Gym_Text_YujiPostBattle: You'll need power to keep up with our GYM LEADER.
texts.ViridianCity_Gym_Text_AtsushiIntro: Rrrroar! I'm working myself into a rage!
texts.ViridianCity_Gym_Text_JasonIntro: POKéMON and I, we make wonderful music together!
