texts.ViridianCity_Gym_Text_JasonPostBattle: Do you know the identity of our GYM LEADER?
texts.ViridianCity_Gym_Text_KiyoIntro: Karate is the ultimate form of martial arts!
texts.ViridianCity_Gym_Text_KiyoPostBattle: If my POKéMON were as good at karate as I…
texts.ViridianCity_Gym_Text_WarrenIntro: The truly talented win with style.
texts.ViridianCity_Gym_Text_WarrenPostBattle: The LEADER will scold me for losing this way…
texts.ViridianCity_Gym_Text_TakashiIntro: I'm the KARATE KING! Your fate rests with me!
texts.ViridianCity_Gym_Text_TakashiPostBattle: The POKéMON LEAGUE? You? Don't get cocky!
texts.ViridianCity_Gym_Text_ColeIntro: Your POKéMON will cower at the crack of my whip!
texts.ViridianCity_Gym_Text_SamuelIntro:
VIRIDIAN GYM was closed for a long time.

But now, our LEADER is back!
texts.ViridianCity_Gym_Text_SamuelPostBattle: You can go on to the POKéMON LEAGUE only by defeating our GYM LEADER!
texts.ViridianCity_Gym_Text_GymGuyAdvice:
Yo! Champ in the making!

Even I don't know the VIRIDIAN LEADER's identity.

But one thing's certain. This will be the toughest of all the GYM LEADERS.

Also, I heard that the TRAINERS here like GROUND-type POKéMON.
texts.ViridianCity_Gym_Text_GymGuyPostVictory: Blow me away! GIOVANNI was the GYM LEADER of VIRIDIAN?

WINNING TRAINERS: {RIVAL}

VIRIDIAN POKéMON GYM LEADER: GIOVANNI

WINNING TRAINERS: {RIVAL}, {PLAYER}
texts.ViridianCity_House_Text_NicknamingIsFun:
Coming up with nicknames is fun, but it's not so easy to do.

Clever names are nice, but simple names are easier to remember.
texts.ViridianCity_Mart_Text_YouCameFromPallet: Hey! You came from PALLET TOWN?
texts.ViridianCity_Mart_Text_TakeThisToProfOak:
You know PROF. OAK, right?

His order came in. Can I get you to take it to him?
texts.ViridianCity_Mart_Text_ReceivedOaksParce: {PLAYER} received OAK'S PARCEL from the POKéMON MART clerk.
texts.ViridianCity_Mart_Text_SayHiToOakForMe: Okay, thanks! Please say hi to PROF. OAK for me, too.
texts.ViridianCity_Mart_Text_ShopDoesGoodBusin: This shop does good business in ANTIDOTES, I've heard.
texts.ViridianCity_Mart_Text_GotToBuySomePotio:
I've got to buy some POTIONS.

You never know when your POKéMON will need quick healing.
texts.ViridianCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_FeelF:
Please feel free to use that PC in the corner.

The receptionist told me so. It's so kind of her!
texts.ViridianCity_PokemonCenter_1F_Text_PokeC:
There's a POKéMON CENTER in every town ahead.

They charge no money, so don't be shy about healing POKéMON.

POKéMON CENTERS heal your tired, hurt, or fainted POKéMON.

They make all POKéMON completely healthy.
texts.ViridianCity_School_Text_TryingToMemoriz: Whew! I'm trying to memorize all my notes.
texts.ViridianCity_School_Text_ReadBlackboardC:
Okay!

Be sure to read what's on the blackboard carefully!
texts.ViridianCity_School_Text_NotebookFirstPa:
Let's check out the notebook.

First page…

POKé BALLS are used to catch POKéMON.

Up to six POKéMON can be carried in your party.

People who raise and battle with POKéMON are called TRAINERS.
texts.ViridianCity_School_Text_NotebookSecondP:
Second page…

A healthy POKéMON may be hard to catch, so weaken it first.

Poison, burn, or cause another status problem to weaken it.
texts.ViridianCity_School_Text_NotebookThirdPa:
Third page…

POKéMON TRAINERS seek others to engage in POKéMON battles.

To TRAINERS, the taste of victory is sweet, indeed.

Battles are constantly waged at POKéMON GYMS everywhere.
texts.ViridianCity_School_Text_NotebookFourthP:
Fourth page…

The ultimate goal for all POKéMON TRAINERS is simple.

It is to defeat the top eight POKéMON GYM LEADERS.

Do so to earn the right to face…

The ELITE FOUR of the POKéMON LEAGUE!
texts.ViridianCity_School_Text_HeyDontLookAtMy: GIRL: Hey! Don't look at my notes!
texts.ViridianCity_School_Text_BlackboardLists: The blackboard lists POKéMON STATUS problems during battles.
texts.ViridianCity_School_Text_ReadWhichTopic: Which topic do you want to read?
texts.ViridianCity_School_Text_ExplainSleep:
A POKéMON can't attack if it's asleep.

POKéMON will stay asleep even after battles.

Use AWAKENING to awaken one from sleep.
texts.ViridianCity_School_Text_ExplainBurn:
A burn reduces ATTACK power. It also causes ongoing HP loss.

A burn remains after a battle. Use BURN HEAL to cure a burn.
texts.ViridianCity_School_Text_ExplainPoison:
When poisoned, a POKéMON's health steadily drops.

Poison lingers after battles. Use an ANTIDOTE to cure poison!
texts.ViridianCity_School_Text_ExplainFreeze:
A frozen POKéMON becomes helplessly immobile.

It stays frozen even after the battle ends.

Use ICE HEAL to thaw out the suffering POKéMON.
texts.ViridianCity_School_Text_ExplainParalysi:
Paralysis reduces SPEED and may prevent the POKéMON from moving.

Paralysis remains after battles. Use PARLYZ HEAL for treatment.
texts.ViridianForest_Text_FriendsItchingToBatt:
I came here with some friends to catch us some BUG POKéMON!

They're all itching to get into some POKéMON battles!
texts.ViridianForest_Text_RickIntro: Hey! You have POKéMON! Come on! Let's battle 'em!
texts.ViridianForest_Text_RickPostBattle: Ssh! You'll scare the bugs away. Another time, okay?

Sometimes, you can find stuff on the ground.

I'm looking for the stuff I dropped. Can you help me?

texts.ViridianForest_Text_AnthonyPostBattle: I lost some of my allowance…
texts.ViridianForest_Text_CharlieIntro: Did you know that POKéMON evolve?
texts.ViridianForest_Text_CharliePostBattle: BUG POKéMON evolve quickly. They're a lot of fun!
texts.ViridianForest_Text_RanOutOfPokeBalls:
I was throwing POKé BALLS to catch POKéMON, and I ran out.

That's why you can never have too many POKé BALLS.
texts.ViridianForest_Text_AvoidGrassyAreasWhen:
TRAINER TIPS

If your POKéMON are weak and you want to avoid battles, stay away from grassy areas!
texts.ViridianForest_Text_UseAntidoteForPoison: For poison, use ANTIDOTE! Get it at POKéMON MARTS!
texts.ViridianForest_Text_ContactOakViaPCToRat:

Contact PROF. OAK via a PC to get your POKéDEX evaluated!
texts.ViridianForest_Text_CantCatchOwnedMons:

You can't catch a POKéMON that belongs to someone else.

Throw POKé BALLS only at wild POKéMON to catch them!
texts.ViridianForest_Text_WeakenMonsBeforeCapt:
TRAINER TIPS

Weaken POKéMON before attempting capture!

When healthy, they may escape!

texts.CableClub_Text_ExplainBattleModes:
There are three Battle Modes.

SINGLE BATTLE is for two TRAINERS with one or more POKéMON each.

Each TRAINER can have one POKéMON in battle at a time.

DOUBLE BATTLE is for two TRAINERS with two or more POKéMON each.

Each TRAINER will send out two POKéMON in battle at a time.

MULTI BATTLE is for four TRAINERS with one or more POKéMON each.

Each TRAINER can have one POKéMON in battle at a time.

texts.CableClub_Text_UnionRoomInfo:
The TRAINERS in the UNION ROOM will be those players around you who have also entered the ROOM.

You may do all sorts of things here, such as exchanging greetings.

You may enter two POKéMON up to Lv. 30 for a one-on-one battle.

You may take part in a chat with two to five people.

Or, you may register a POKéMON for trade.

Would you like to enter the ROOM?

texts.CableClub_Text_FirstTimeRightThisWay:
Hello! My name is TEALA.

This must be your first time up here.

I'll show you how the Wireless Communication System works.

First, I need to show you this floor of our POKéMON CENTER.

Right this way, please.
texts.CableClub_Text_ExplainWirelessClubFirstT:
On the top floor, there are two rooms.

First, the room on the left. It's the UNION ROOM.

You may link up with TRAINERS around you who have also entered the UNION ROOM.

With them, you may do things like chat, battle, and trade.

Second, the room on the right is the DIRECT CORNER.

You may trade or battle POKéMON with your friends in this room.

If the Wireless Adapter isn't connected, you may still link up using a GBA Game Link cable.

If that is the case, you must go to the DIRECT CORNER.

I hope you enjoy the Wireless  Communication System.
texts.CableClub_Text_AskAboutLinking:
Hello, {PLAYER}!

It's me, TEALA, the POKéMON CENTER 2F attendant.

Is there something you needed to ask me about linking?
texts.CableClub_Text_ExplainWirelessClub:
Let me explain how the POKéMON WIRELESS CLUB works.

On this, the top floor, there are two rooms.

First, the room on the left. It's the UNION ROOM.

You may link up with TRAINERS around you who have also entered the UNION ROOM.

With them, you may do things like chat, battle, and trade.

Second, the room on the right is the DIRECT CORNER.

You may trade or battle POKéMON with your friends in this room.

Sometimes, you may not be able to find your friends in the UNION ROOM or the DIRECT CORNER.

In that case, please move closer to your friends.

If the Wireless Adapter isn't connected, you may still link up using a GBA Game Link cable.

If that is the case, you must go to the DIRECT CORNER.

I hope you enjoy the Wireless  Communication System.

texts.gFameCheckerPersonQuote_ProfOak:

texts.Text_BeautifulSkyWindow:

texts.Text_BlinkingLights: Lights in different colors are flashing on and off.
texts.Text_NeatlyLinedUpTools: All sorts of tools are lined up neatly.

texts.Text_VideoGame: It's the latest video game! It sure looks fun!
texts.Text_Burglary: There are obvious signs of burglary here…

texts.Help_Text_DescHowDoIDoThis: Detailed instructions are given for various operations.
texts.Help_Text_DescWhatDoesThisTermMean: Detailed descriptions are given for terms that appear in the game.
texts.Help_Text_DescAboutThisGame: Detailed descriptions are given about this game.
texts.Help_Text_DescTypeMatchupList: The matchups of  POKéMON types and moves are listed.
texts.Help_Text_DescExit: Select to exit the HELP System.
texts.Help_Text_Greetings: Greetings! This is the HELP System. Call me up whenever and wherever you need by pressing the L or R Button. The help messages change to suit the situation, so check them often, please.

texts.Help_Text_AnswerPlayingForFirstTime: You become the main character, exploring the world of POKéMON. By talking to people and solving mysteries, new paths will open to you. Strive for the goal together with your wonderful POKéMON.
texts.Help_Text_AnswerWhatShouldIBeDoing: When you come across another person, go up to them and press the A Button. That will get them to talk and interact with your character. You may also examine various items and objects in the same way. Talk to people and check things often to obtain information.
texts.Help_Text_AnswerCantGetOutOfRoom: On the stairs or the exits of a building is a red mat. Move your character to stand on top of the red mat. Press the {PLUS} Control Pad  toward the stairs or the exit to advance.
texts.Help_Text_AnswerCantFindPersonIWant: This isn't something you should worry about too much. Talk to other people, check signs, check things, and so on. Sometimes, you may need to just move to a new town or place.
texts.Help_Text_AnswerTalkedToEveryoneNowWhat: Try moving on to a new road, town, or place.
texts.Help_Text_AnswerSomeoneBlockingMyWay: There could be something in the town or inside a building that is the cause. Try talking to the people in the area again. If there is a problem that they need solved, you may have to help. Afterwards, try talking to the person blocking your way again.
texts.Help_Text_AnswerICantGoOn: Try talking to people by going up to them and pressing the A Button. Also, try checking things like odd trees and strange rocks with the A Button. Press the {PLUS} Control Pad and try going to places that look impassable, too.
texts.Help_Text_AnswerOutOfThingsToDo: Try going to places where you  haven't visited yet. Also, check everything that looks suspicious by pressing the A Button.
texts.Help_Text_AnswerWhatHappenedToItemIGot: Any item that you are given by another character goes in your BAG. The item is automatically sorted and placed in one of three pockets. For instructions on the BAG's use, please refer to the HELP System's “How do I do this?” heading.
texts.Help_Text_AnswerWhatAreMyAdventureBasics: If POKéMON are hurt in battle, take them to a POKéMON CENTER and have them healed by the staff. Get in the habit of saving your game and recording your progress. Stock up on healing items at POKéMON MARTS before traveling far.
texts.Help_Text_AnswerHowAreRoadsForestsDiffer: Forests are basically the same as roads but they can be like mazes. All forests have a way out, so don't give up if you get lost.
texts.Help_Text_AnswerHowAreCavesDifferent: Caves are dark and dangerous. Wild POKéMON can appear anywhere in them. If there is an emergency, rush to a POKéMON CENTER or use items. New towns await discovery beyond some caves, so don't give up.
texts.Help_Text_AnswerHowDoIProgress: The object of the game is to train your POKéMON and move forward. You must collect info and solve problems. For example, what do you need to get around an obstacle? What would get that impeding person out of the way?
texts.Help_Text_AnswerWhenCanIUseItem: There are several kinds of items. Some can be used only on the field. Some are only for use during battle. Some can be used anytime. Try using an item - if it can't be used, you will be alerted.
texts.Help_Text_AnswerWhatsABattle: In a battle, POKéMON try to reduce one another's vitality, expressed as HP. If a POKéMON's HP falls to zero, it faints, and the other POKéMON wins. By winning a battle, POKéMON earn EXP. Points, which help them level up (grow stronger).
texts.Help_Text_AnswerHowDoIPrepareForBattle: First, fully heal the POKéMON in your party (the POKéMON with you) at any POKéMON CENTER. You should also buy healing items for emergencies at a POKéMON MART.
texts.Help_Text_AnswerWhatIsAMonsVitality: A POKéMON's vitality is expressed in HP. If a POKéMON is hurt in battle, HP is subtracted. If its HP drops to zero, the POKéMON faints. Heal hurt or fainted POKéMON at a POKéMON CENTER or by using items.
texts.Help_Text_AnswerMyMonsAreHurt: A POKéMON CENTER is like an inn for POKéMON. It will fully heal POKéMON of any status problems and fully restore their HP using a special machine. This service is free, so get in the habit of healing your POKéMON often.
texts.Help_Text_AnswerWhatIsStatusProblem: A status problem refers to an ailment that is inflicted on a POKéMON by its foe's attack. These include burns, paralysis, poisoning, sleep, and freezing. These can be healed by visiting a POKéMON CENTER or using the appropriate item.
texts.Help_Text_AnswerWhatHappensIfAllMyMonsFa: If all the POKéMON in your party (all the POKéMON with you) faint, you lose some MONEY, and you are returned home or to a POKéMON CENTER. To reduce that chance, visit POKéMON CENTERS often. Also, get in the habit of saving often.
texts.Help_Text_AnswerCantCatchMons: If a wild POKéMON escapes from a POKé BALL, it's obviously still feisty. Try reducing its HP some more, and try to weaken it with paralysis or sleep before trying to catch it. If the POKé BALL rocks for a while, the quarry is close to being caught!
texts.Help_Text_AnswerRanOutOfPotions: There are shops, known as POKéMON MARTS, that sell items. You will not find POKéMON MARTS on roads, in forests, or in caves. Stock up on needed items while you are visiting a town with a POKéMON MART.
texts.Help_Text_AnswerCanIBuyPokeBalls: You may buy POKé BALLS at any POKéMON MART in any town. You will not find POKéMON MARTS on roads, in forests, or in caves. Stock up on POKé BALLS while you are visiting a town with a POKéMON MART.
texts.Help_Text_AnswerWhatsATrainer: A TRAINER is a person who raises POKéMON through battling. TRAINERS will challenge you  wherever they are - it could be on a road, in forests, caves, anywhere. If your eyes meet, you have to accept their challenge. So be careful!
texts.Help_Text_AnswerHowDoIWinAgainstTrainer: To beat a TRAINER in battle, use POKéMON that have type advantages over the foe's POKéMON. You may also use highly trained POKéMON with overwhelming power. Outnumbering the foe's POKéMON is another obvious tactic.
texts.Help_Text_AnswerWhereDoMonsAppear: Wild POKéMON will appear in tall grass, on roads, and in forests. They will appear anywhere in dark caves. There are no wild POKéMON or TRAINERS in towns, so they are safe places.
texts.Help_Text_AnswerWhatAreMoves: POKéMON may learn up to four different techniques, or moves. There is a great variety of moves including attacks and those with special effects. The kinds of moves that can be learned vary for each POKéMON. Some moves can be learned from machines.
texts.Help_Text_AnswerWhatAreHiddenMoves: HIDDEN moves are those that are especially important for your adventure. To use such a move outside of battle, open the “POKéMON” MENU and make the POKéMON that knows the move use it. A fainted POKéMON may use a HIDDEN move outside of battle.
texts.Help_Text_AnswerWhatMovesShouldIUse: Select “FIGHT,” and the MENU of moves will appear. Consider the type matchups, and use the most effective moves. You can check the effects of moves by opening “POKéMON,” picking a POKéMON, opening “SUMMARY,” then opening “POKéMON SKILLS.”
texts.Help_Text_AnswerWantToAddMoreMoves: The most a POKéMON can learn is four moves. They are learned as the POKéMON levels up. It can also be taught a move using a TM (Technical Machine) or HM (Hidden Machine). There are also people who teach moves.
texts.Help_Text_AnswerWantToMakeMonStronger: The key to making your POKéMON strong is to battle and win often. The EXP. (Experience) Points earned by winning battles accumulate to level up POKéMON that participated in them. Battle wild POKéMON often to level up your party.
texts.Help_Text_AnswerFoeMonsTooStrong: If your foes are too strong, try leveling up your POKéMON some more. Go back the way you came and battle wild POKéMON to level up your party. You may also battle TRAINERS whom you have not battled before.
texts.Help_Text_AnswerWhatDoIDoInCave: Unlike roads and forests, wild POKéMON can appear anywhere in caves. If your POKéMON are hurt in a cave, rush to a POKéMON CENTER or use items to heal them right away. It is very dangerous to force your luck in caves.
texts.Help_Text_AnswerNothingIWantToKnow: Trust your own knowledge and power. Believe in yourself and find your way!
texts.Help_Text_AnswerWhatsPokemonCenter: A POKéMON CENTER is identified by its red roof and a “P.C” sign. Every POKéMON CENTER offers such services as fully healing POKéMON and free PC use, making it essential for your travels. On the upper floor are facilities for linking with friends and others.
texts.Help_Text_AnswerWhatsPokemonMart: A POKéMON MART is identified by its blue roof and a “MART” sign. Items can be bought and sold at any POKéMON MART. Some MARTS carry items that are available only in their towns.
texts.Help_Text_AnswerWantToEndGame: You can safely end your game by selecting “SAVE” on the MENU. Once you have saved, the game can be safely turned off. When the game is turned back on, you can resume from where you last saved.
texts.Help_Text_AnswerWhatsAMon: POKéMON are living beings about which many mysteries still remain. You may see them in grass, the sea, and caves. They appear to obey the wishes of the TRAINERS that caught them.
texts.Help_Text_AnswerWhatIsThatPersonLike: Use the FAME CHECKER among the KEY ITEMS in your BAG. It may give you a hint, so try it out.
texts.Help_Text_AnswerWhatDoesHiddenMoveDo: A HIDDEN move is taught to a POKéMON using an HM (Hidden Machine). A HIDDEN move is important for helping your adventure. For example, one is used to light up dark caves. Another cuts down small trees. There is one for traveling on water, and so on.
texts.Help_Text_AnswerWhatDoIDoInSafari: Try to catch wild POKéMON by throwing the special SAFARI BALLS. You may keep any item you find, too.
texts.Help_Text_AnswerWhatAreSafariRules: Your SAFARI GAME ends once you have traveled a certain distance or thrown all your SAFARI BALLS. Open the MENU to check the remaining number of steps and SAFARI BALLS.
texts.Help_Text_AnswerWantToEndSafari: If you would like to cut your SAFARI GAME short, open the MENU and select “RETIRE” at the top of the list.
texts.Help_Text_AnswerWhatIsAGym: POKéMON GYMS are operated by the POKéMON LEAGUE and are training facilities for TRAINERS. They are all across the land in cities and towns. Each one is headed by a LEADER, who is a very skilled TRAINER. Beat the LEADER to collect a BADGE.
texts.Help_Text_UsingMoveOutsideOfBattle: Using a move outside of battle
texts.Help_Text_HowToUsePokedex: {CIRCLE_1} Select “POKéDEX” on the MENU. {CIRCLE_2} Choose POKéMON using commands such    as “POKéMON LIST,”    “HABITATS OF POKéMON,” and    “SEARCH.” {CIRCLE_3} Select a POKéMON to obtain detailed    information.
texts.Help_Text_HowToUsePokemon: {CIRCLE_1} Select “POKéMON” on the MENU. {CIRCLE_2} Choose a POKéMON in your party. {CIRCLE_3} Select “SUMMARY,” “SWITCH,”    or “ITEM.”
texts.Help_Text_HowToUseSummary: {CIRCLE_1} Select “SUMMARY.” {CIRCLE_2} Press left or right on the {PLUS} Control    Pad to check the information:    “POKéMON INFO”    “POKéMON SKILLS”    “KNOWN MOVES”
texts.Help_Text_HowToUseSwitch: {CIRCLE_1} Choose the POKéMON you want to    switch around. {CIRCLE_2} Select “SWITCH.” {CIRCLE_3} Select the POKéMON to switch with    the first one. The POKéMON at the left of the screen will be the first one out in a battle.
texts.Help_Text_HowToUseItem: {CIRCLE_1} Select “ITEM.” {CIRCLE_2} Select whether you want to “GIVE”    an item to the POKéMON to hold,    or “TAKE” an item it is holding. A POKéMON can hold no more than one item!
texts.Help_Text_HowToUseBag: {CIRCLE_1} Select “BAG” on the MENU. {CIRCLE_2} Press left or right on the {PLUS} Control    Pad to check the data headings:    “ITEMS”    “KEY ITEMS”    “POKé BALLS”    Press up or down to select an item.
texts.Help_Text_HowToUseAnItem: {CIRCLE_1} Select the “ITEMS” POCKET. {CIRCLE_2} Press up or down on the {PLUS} Control    Pad to select an item. {CIRCLE_3} Select “USE” to use the selected    item. Some items may not be used depending on the place and/or situation.
texts.Help_Text_HowToUseKeyItem: {CIRCLE_1} Select the “KEY ITEMS” POCKET. {CIRCLE_2} Press up or down on the {PLUS} Control    Pad to select a key item. {CIRCLE_3} Select “USE” to use the selected    key item.
texts.Help_Text_HowToUsePokeBall: {CIRCLE_1} While battling a wild POKéMON,    select the BAG's “POKé BALLS”    POCKET. {CIRCLE_2} Press up or down on the {PLUS} Control    Pad to select a POKé BALL. {CIRCLE_3} Select “USE” to throw the selected    POKé BALL.
texts.Help_Text_HowToUsePlayer: {CIRCLE_1} Select “{PLAYER}” on the MENU. {CIRCLE_2} Your TRAINER CARD is displayed face    up with basic information. Press the    A Button to turn the CARD over. {CIRCLE_3} A variety of data can be found on    the reverse side of the CARD.
texts.Help_Text_HowToUseSave: {CIRCLE_1} Select “SAVE” on the MENU. {CIRCLE_2} Select “YES” and your progress is    recorded in the save file. Once the game is saved, you may turn off the game. Your game can be resumed from where you saved.
texts.Help_Text_HowToUseOption: {CIRCLE_1} Select “OPTION” on the MENU. {CIRCLE_2} Press up or down on the {PLUS} Control    Pad to select an optional item, then    press left or right to alter the    settings. {CIRCLE_3} Select “CANCEL” or press the    B Button after making changes.
texts.Help_Text_HowToUsePotion: {CIRCLE_1} Open the MENU. {CIRCLE_2} Press up or down on the {PLUS} Control    Pad and select “BAG.” {CIRCLE_3} Select “POTION” in the “ITEMS”    POCKET. {CIRCLE_4} Select “USE.” {CIRCLE_5} Select the POKéMON to be healed.
texts.Help_Text_HowToUseTownMap: {CIRCLE_1} Open the MENU. {CIRCLE_2} Press up or down on the {PLUS} Control    Pad and select “BAG.” {CIRCLE_3} Press left or right to open the    “KEY ITEMS” POCKET, then press    up or down to select “TOWN MAP.”  {CIRCLE_4} Select “USE” to open the TOWN MAP.
texts.Help_Text_HowToUseTM: {CIRCLE_1} Open the MENU. {CIRCLE_2} Open the “KEY ITEMS” POCKET in the    “BAG.” {CIRCLE_3} “OPEN” the TM CASE. {CIRCLE_4} Select and “USE” a TM. {CIRCLE_5} Select a POKéMON that can learn the    move in the TM.
texts.Help_Text_HowToUseHM: {CIRCLE_1} Open the MENU. {CIRCLE_2} Open the “KEY ITEMS” POCKET in the    “BAG.” {CIRCLE_3} “OPEN” the TM CASE. {CIRCLE_4} Select and “USE” an HM. {CIRCLE_5} Select a POKéMON that can learn it. HMs are hard to remove, so be careful!
texts.Help_Text_HowToUseMoveOutsideOfBattle: {CIRCLE_1} Open the MENU. {CIRCLE_2} Select “POKéMON.” {CIRCLE_3} Select a POKéMON that knows an    HM move. The usable HM move(s)    will be shown in blue. Select and    use the desired move to destroy an    obstacle, fly, surf, etc.
texts.Help_Text_HowToRideBicycle: {CIRCLE_1} Open the MENU. Open the    “KEY ITEMS” POCKET in the “BAG”    and select the “BICYCLE.” {CIRCLE_2} The BICYCLE can be ridden by    selecting “USE.” You may also    “REGISTER” it for instant use by    pressing SELECT.
texts.Help_Text_HowToEnterName: {CIRCLE_1} Move the cursor to the letter you    want with the {PLUS} Control Pad, then    press the A Button to enter it. {CIRCLE_2} Press the B Button to back up. {CIRCLE_3} Press SELECT to switch between    uppercase and lowercase letters. {CIRCLE_4} Press the A Button on “OK.”
texts.Help_Text_HowToUsePC: {CIRCLE_1} Go to any POKéMON CENTER, go up    to the PC, then press the A Button.
texts.Help_Text_HowToUseBillsPC: {CIRCLE_1} Select “{STR_VAR_1}'S PC” on the PC. {CIRCLE_2} Select from one of the top three    MENU items to access the POKéMON    Storage System. If you catch a POKéMON when you have six in your party, the POKéMON is sent automatically to a BOX in the System!
texts.Help_Text_HowToUseWithdraw: {CIRCLE_1} Select a POKéMON in the open BOX    with the {PLUS} Control Pad. {CIRCLE_2} Select “WITHDRAW” to remove the    POKéMON from the BOX and add it to    your party. You may not withdraw a POKéMON if you already have six POKéMON with you!
texts.Help_Text_HowToUseDeposit: {CIRCLE_1} Select a POKéMON in your party with    the {PLUS} Control Pad. {CIRCLE_2} Select “DEPOSIT.” {CIRCLE_3} Select the BOX, then press the    A Button to store the POKéMON. If you have only one POKéMON with you, it may not be stored!
texts.Help_Text_HowToUseMove: {CIRCLE_1} Select a POKéMON in the open BOX. {CIRCLE_2} Pick up the POKéMON by selecting    “MOVE” and move it anywhere with    the {PLUS} Control Pad. {CIRCLE_3} Move the POKéMON to the BOX name    and press left or right to move it    to another BOX.
texts.Help_Text_HowToMoveItems: {CIRCLE_1} Faintly shown POKéMON can be made    to hold an item by selecting it and    pressing the A Button. {CIRCLE_2} Clearly shown POKéMON can be made    to give the item they are holding to    another POKéMON, or return the item    to the BAG with the A Button.
texts.Help_Text_HowToUsePlayersPC: {CIRCLE_1} Select “{PLAYER}'s PC” on the PC. {CIRCLE_2} Select either “ITEM STORAGE” or    “MAILBOX.” You may store things in your own PC if your BAG is full. You may also withdraw items stored in your PC.
texts.Help_Text_HowToUseWithdrawItem: {CIRCLE_1} Select “WITHDRAW ITEM.” {CIRCLE_2} Select the item to be withdrawn. {CIRCLE_3} The item can be withdrawn and    placed in the BAG's ITEMS POCKET.    It may also be directly given to a    POKéMON to hold.
texts.Help_Text_HowToUseDepositItem: {CIRCLE_1} Select “DEPOSIT ITEM.” {CIRCLE_2} Select the item in the BAG to be    deposited using the {PLUS} Control Pad. {CIRCLE_3} If there is more than one     item to be deposited, enter the    quantity with the {PLUS} Control Pad,    then press the A Button.
texts.Help_Text_HowToUseMailbox: When MAIL is taken from a POKéMON, it is moved to the MAILBOX. If it has no MAIL, the MAILBOX can't be used. {CIRCLE_1} Select “{PLAYER}'S PC” on the PC. {CIRCLE_2} Select “MAILBOX” to read MAIL or    make a POKéMON hold MAIL.
texts.Help_Text_HowToUseProfOaksPC: {CIRCLE_1} Select “PROF. OAK'S PC” on the PC. {CIRCLE_2} PROF. OAK will evaluate your    POKéDEX. His evaluations should give you hints for catching more POKéMON!
texts.Help_Text_HowToOpenMenu: {CIRCLE_1} Press START. {CIRCLE_2} The MENU will open on the right. {CIRCLE_3} Depending on the situation, the MENU    may feature different headings. The MENU will not open in certain situations such as when talking, doing something, battling, etc.
texts.Help_Text_HowToUseFight: {CIRCLE_1} Select “FIGHT.” {CIRCLE_2} Select one of the moves shown, and that move will be used!
texts.Help_Text_HowToUsePokemon2: {CIRCLE_1} Select “POKéMON.” {CIRCLE_2} Select the POKéMON in your party    that you want to use. {CIRCLE_3} If you have two or more POKéMON    with you, they may be switched by    selecting “SHIFT.” Check POKéMON    data by selecting “SUMMARY.”
texts.Help_Text_HowToUseShift: This command switches the POKéMON in battle with another one in your party. {CIRCLE_1} Select the POKéMON to be sent out. {CIRCLE_2} Select “SHIFT.” {CIRCLE_3} The selected POKéMON will switch    places with the POKéMON in battle!
texts.Help_Text_HowToUseSummary2: {CIRCLE_1} Select “SUMMARY.” {CIRCLE_2} Press left or right on the {PLUS} Control    Pad to check the information:    “POKéMON INFO”    “POKéMON SKILLS”    “KNOWN MOVES”
texts.Help_Text_HowToUseBag2: {CIRCLE_1} Select “BAG.” {CIRCLE_2} Press left or right on the {PLUS} Control    Pad to check the data headings:    “ITEMS”    “KEY ITEMS”    “POKé BALLS”    Press up or down to select an item.
texts.Help_Text_HowToReadPokedex: {CIRCLE_1} POKéMON that you have caught are    identified by a POKé BALL mark on    the POKéDEX list. {CIRCLE_2} A caught POKéMON will provide a    large amount of data. {CIRCLE_3} Select “AREA” to display the TOWN    MAP with the POKéMON's habitat(s).{CIRCLE_3} Select “NEXT DATA” to display the    TOWN MAP with its habitat(s).
texts.Help_Text_HowToUseHomePC: {CIRCLE_1} Go up to the PC at home, then press    the A Button. {CIRCLE_2} The PC will turn on. {CIRCLE_3} Select either “ITEM STORAGE” or    “MAILBOX.”
texts.Help_Text_HowToUseItemStorage: {CIRCLE_1} Select “WITHDRAW ITEM” to withdraw    an item stored on your PC. {CIRCLE_2} Select “DEPOSIT ITEM” to put     an item from your BAG into your PC.
texts.Help_Text_HowToUseWithdrawItem2: {CIRCLE_1} Select “WITHDRAW ITEM.” {CIRCLE_2} Select the item to be withdrawn. {CIRCLE_3} The item can be withdrawn and    placed in the BAG's ITEMS POCKET.    It may also be directly given to a    POKéMON to hold.
texts.Help_Text_HowToUseDepositItem2: {CIRCLE_1} Select “DEPOSIT ITEM.” {CIRCLE_2} Select the item in the BAG to be    deposited using the {PLUS} Control Pad. {CIRCLE_3} If there is nothing in the BAG, this    command can't be used!
texts.Help_Text_HowToUseMailbox2: When MAIL is taken from a POKéMON, it is moved to the MAILBOX. If it has no MAIL, the MAILBOX can't be used. {CIRCLE_1} Select MAIL by name to read it or    make a POKéMON hold it.
texts.Help_Text_HowToUseRun: You may not “RUN” from a TRAINER battle! {CIRCLE_1} You may “RUN” from a wild POKéMON. {CIRCLE_2} Your chance of escape is improved    if your POKéMON in battle is fast.
texts.Help_Text_HowToRegisterKeyItem: You may “REGISTER” a key item for instant use by pressing SELECT! {CIRCLE_1} Open the “KEY ITEMS” POCKET. {CIRCLE_2} Select the key item, then select    “REGISTER.”
texts.Help_Text_HowToUseBall: {CIRCLE_1} Select to throw the special POKé    BALL used only in the SAFARI ZONE. When wild POKéMON appear, throw lots of SAFARI BALLS to catch them!
texts.Help_Text_HowToUseBait: {CIRCLE_1} Select to throw the special food    used only in the SAFARI ZONE. It is POKéMON food rolled up into a ball for easy eating. When BAIT is thrown, the wild POKéMON may get attracted by it, and may not flee!
texts.Help_Text_HowToUseRock: {CIRCLE_1} Select to throw a rock lying on    the ground in the SAFARI ZONE. Throwing a rock at a POKéMON may  make it run away, but it becomes easier to catch!
texts.Help_Text_HowToUseHallOfFame: {CIRCLE_1} Select “HALL OF FAME” on the PC. {CIRCLE_2} The POKéMON that have entered the    HALL OF FAME can be examined.
texts.Help_Text_DefineHP: HP indicates a POKéMON's vitality. If a POKéMON's HP drops to zero, it faints and is unable to battle. So, the key in battle is to try to reduce the foe's HP to zero. If your POKéMON are hurt, restore their HP at a POKéMON CENTER or use items.
texts.Help_Text_DefineEXP: EXP. Points stands for “Experience Points.” POKéMON gain EXP. Points by participating in winning battles. When a POKéMON accumulates sufficient EXP. Points, it levels up. The EXP. Bar indicates accumulated EXP. Points. It returns to zero upon leveling up.
texts.Help_Text_DefineMoves: POKéMON may learn up to four different moves. There are many kinds of moves including attacks and those with special effects. The kinds of moves that can be learned vary for each POKéMON. Some moves can be learned from items.
texts.Help_Text_DefineAttack: ATTACK indicates the power of an offensive move. The higher this stat, the more powerful the move. It is applied for the following move types: NORMAL, POISON, GROUND, FLYING, BUG, FIGHTING, ROCK, GHOST, and STEEL.
texts.Help_Text_DefineDefense: DEFENSE indicates the resistance a POKéMON has against physical attacks. The higher this stat, the less damage sustained from a foe's physical hit.
texts.Help_Text_DefineSpAtk: SP. ATK (Special Attack) indicates the power of a special attack move. The higher this stat, the more powerful the special attack move. It is applied for the following move types: FIRE, WATER, ELECTRIC, GRASS, ICE, PSYCHIC, DRAGON, and DARK.
texts.Help_Text_DefineSpDef: SP. DEF (Special Defense) indicates the resistance a POKéMON has against special attacks. The higher this stat, the less damage sustained from a foe's special attack.
texts.Help_Text_DefineSpeed: SPEED indicates the agility of a POKéMON. If this stat exceeds the foe's in battle, the POKéMON can make a move before its slower opponent.
texts.Help_Text_DefineLevel: Lv. (Level) indicates the growth and strength of a POKéMON. In general, when a POKéMON levels up, its stats such as HP, ATTACK, and DEFENSE rise, making it stronger. POKéMON may learn a new move upon leveling up.
texts.Help_Text_DefineType: POKéMON and moves are classified by type. Every type has advantageous and disadvantageous matchups against other types. For example, like a rock- paper-scissors game, the WATER type is strong against the FIRE type and weak against the GRASS type.
texts.Help_Text_DefineOT: OT stands for “Original TRAINER,” the first TRAINER to have caught the selected POKéMON. Even if the POKéMON is traded, the OT name will remain unchanged.
texts.Help_Text_DefineItem: All POKéMON can be made to hold one item each. Some items will be used by the POKéMON automatically in certain situations. To make a POKéMON hold an item, select the item from the BAG and “GIVE” it to the POKéMON.
texts.Help_Text_DefineAbility: All POKéMON have a special ABILITY. There are many different kinds of these abilities, some used in battle, some elsewhere. The abilities differ from species to species. Some species may have more than one kind of ability.
texts.Help_Text_DefineMoney: Whenever you win a battle against a TRAINER, you are given prize money. Save up your prize money so you can enjoy shopping at POKéMON MARTS!
texts.Help_Text_DefineMoveType: Moves are also classified by types. If a POKéMON of a certain type uses a move of the same type, the move's power is boosted. If the move's type has a matchup advantage against the target, its effectiveness is also boosted.
texts.Help_Text_DefineNature: All POKéMON have a personality, or “NATURE.” The POKéMON's nature appears to affect how the POKéMON will grow upon leveling up.
texts.Help_Text_DefineIDNo: The ID No. is a special number assigned specifically to you as a TRAINER. Together with the OT name, the ID No. is used to precisely identify the Original TRAINER. The ID No. does not change even if the POKéMON is traded.
texts.Help_Text_DefinePP: PP stands for “Power Points.” It indicates the number of times a certain move can be used in battle. Like HP, PP can be restored by visiting a POKéMON CENTER or using certain items.
texts.Help_Text_DefinePower: POWER indicates the strength of an attack. The higher this number, the greater the damage that can be inflicted on the foe!
texts.Help_Text_DefineAccuracy: ACCURACY indicates the probability of the move hitting the foe. The higher this number, the more likely the move will strike the target.
texts.Help_Text_DefineFNT: FNT stands for “fainted.” A POKéMON faints if its HP is reduced to zero. It becomes incapable of taking part in battle. Restore a fainted POKéMON at a POKéMON CENTER, or use an item.
texts.Help_Text_DefineItems: Ordinary items bought at any POKéMON MART are placed in the ITEMS POCKET. Items may be used, given to a POKéMON to hold, or tossed out as garbage.
texts.Help_Text_DefineKeyItems: Important items that you find or  receive from people are placed in the KEY ITEMS POCKET. Key items may be used, or registered for use instantly with SELECT. Once registered, the item can be used without opening the MENU and BAG.
texts.Help_Text_DefinePokeBalls: POKé BALLS, which are used for catching wild POKéMON, are placed in the POKé BALLS POCKET. POKé BALLS may be bought at POKéMON MARTS. They may be used, given to a POKéMON to hold, or tossed out as garbage.
texts.Help_Text_DefinePokedex: This indicates the number of species of POKéMON you have caught and/or evolved to fill the POKéDEX. Try hard to catch all sorts of POKéMON!
texts.Help_Text_DefinePlayTime: This is the total amount of time that you have played this game.
texts.Help_Text_DefineBadges: The POKéMON LEAGUE BADGES that you have won are registered and shown. Earn BADGES by defeating GYM LEADERS in various cities and towns.
texts.Help_Text_DefineTextSpeed: You can adjust how quickly the text is displayed. Choose one: SLOW, MID, or FAST.
texts.Help_Text_DefineBattleScene: You can choose to turn the battle animation ON or OFF.
texts.Help_Text_DefineBattleStyle: You can choose whether or not a TRAINER can switch a POKéMON after it has made its foe faint. Set to “SHIFT” if you would like the chance to switch a POKéMON after it has made its foe faint.
texts.Help_Text_DefineSound: You can choose between MONO and STEREO sound output.
texts.Help_Text_DefineButtonMode: Set to “HELP” to display help messages by pressing the L or R Button. Set to “LR” to enable the switching of the POKéDEX pages and BAG POCKETS using the L and R Buttons. Set to “L=A” to make the L Button work the same as the A Button.
texts.Help_Text_DefineFrame: You may choose the design of the frame around certain menus. Try them out and see what you like.
texts.Help_Text_DefineCancel2: The settings will be changed to the selections shown in red, and you will return to the MENU.
texts.Help_Text_DefineTM: A TM (Technical Machine) is a device used to teach a move to a POKéMON. There are many different kinds. Moves can be taught only to those POKéMON capable of using them. A TM breaks after a single use.
texts.Help_Text_DefineHM: An HM (Hidden Machine) is a device used to teach a HIDDEN move to a POKéMON. A HIDDEN move can be taught only to those POKéMON capable of using it. Unlike a TM, an HM can be used over and over. A HIDDEN move can be tough for a POKéMON to forget.
texts.Help_Text_DefineHMMove: HIDDEN moves are those that are especially important for your adventure. To use such a move outside of battle, open the “POKéMON” MENU and make the POKéMON that knows the move use it. A fainted POKéMON may use a HIDDEN move outside of battle.
texts.Help_Text_DefineEvolution: Among POKéMON, there are some that undergo major changes (evolution) upon growing to certain levels. Evolution causes a POKéMON to alter form, change its name, and perhaps change the moves it may learn. Some POKéMON evolve due to reasons other than leveling up.
texts.Help_Text_DefineStatusProblem: Status problems include: Sleep: Can't use moves. Poison: Causes steady HP loss. Paralysis: May prevent moves. Burn: HP loss and lowers ATTACK. Freeze: Can't use moves. These can be healed with items, etc.
texts.Help_Text_DefinePokemon: POKéMON is a name given to describe wondrous creatures that inhabit all corners of this world. People raise POKéMON to be their pets, use them for battling, and so on.
texts.Help_Text_DefineIDNo2: The ID No. is a special number assigned specifically to you as a TRAINER. Together with the OT name, the ID No. is used to precisely identify the Original TRAINER. The ID No. does not change even if the POKéMON is traded.
texts.Help_Text_DefineMoney2: Whenever you win a battle against a TRAINER, you are given prize money. Save up your prize money so you can enjoy shopping at POKéMON MARTS!
texts.Help_Text_DefineBadges2: This indicates the number of POKéMON LEAGUE BADGES that you have won. Earn BADGES by defeating GYM LEADERS in various cities and towns.
texts.Help_Text_DescTheHelpSystem: The help messages change depending on how much you have progressed in the game. They are designed to support you when you need them. If there is anything that you don't understand, please look up the HELP System!
texts.Help_Text_DescTheGame: You become the main character to explore the world of POKéMON! By talking to people and solving mysteries, new paths will open to you. Strive for the goal together with your wonderful POKéMON!
texts.Help_Text_DescWirelessAdapter:
This game communicates over a wireless link using the Wireless Adapter.

Go wireless anywhere, anytime, and with anybody!

Try playing with the Wireless Adapter always attached!
texts.Help_Text_DescGameFundamentals1: Visit every city and town, travel every road, explore every cave, and face every challenge as you strive to become the greatest TRAINER of POKéMON!
texts.Help_Text_DescGameFundamentals2: On your adventure, you will be faced with many obstacles. Every obstacle can be overcome by doing something or by solving mysteries. Some obstacles are affected by something that happens far away.
texts.Help_Text_DescGameFundamentals3: Some of the obstacles in your way can be removed once your POKéMON learn specific moves.
texts.Help_Text_DescWhatArePokemon: POKéMON are wondrous creatures that are shrouded in mystery. You may meet them all over the world…in tall grass, caves, the sea, and more. They appear to grow obedient to the TRAINERS that caught them.

texts.gPikachuIntro_Text_Page1: In the world which you are about to enter, you will embark on a grand adventure with you as the hero.  Speak to people and check things wherever you go, be it towns, roads, or caves. Gather information and hints from every source.
texts.gPikachuIntro_Text_Page2: New paths will open to you by helping people in need, overcoming challenges, and solving mysteries.  At times, you will be challenged by others and attacked by wild creatures. Be brave and keep pushing on.
texts.gPikachuIntro_Text_Page3: Through your adventure, we hope that you will interact with all sorts of people and achieve personal growth. That is our biggest objective.  Press the A Button, and let your adventure begin!
texts.gOakSpeech_Text_WelcomeToTheWorld:
Hello, there! Glad to meet you!

Welcome to the world of POKéMON!

My name is OAK.

People affectionately refer to me as the POKéMON PROFESSOR.
texts.gOakSpeech_Text_IsInhabitedFarAndWide: …is inhabited far and wide by creatures called POKéMON.
texts.gOakSpeech_Text_IStudyPokemon:
For some people, POKéMON are pets. Others use them for battling.

As for myself…

I study POKéMON as a profession.
texts.gOakSpeech_Text_TellMeALittleAboutYourse: But first, tell me a little about yourself.
texts.gOakSpeech_Text_YourNameWhatIsIt: Let's begin with your name. What is it?
texts.gOakSpeech_Text_WhatWasHisName:
This is my grandson.

He's been your rival since you both were babies.

…Erm, what was his name now?
texts.gOakSpeech_Text_YourRivalsNameWhatWasIt: Your rival's name, what was it now?
texts.gOakSpeech_Text_RememberRivalsName: That's right! I remember now! His name is {RIVAL}!
texts.gOakSpeech_Text_LetsGo:
{PLAYER}!

Your very own POKéMON legend is about to unfold!

A world of dreams and adventures with POKéMON awaits! Let's go!

You still have lots to do.

Go into every patch of grass you see and look for POKéMON!

It looks as if you're getting on the right track!

I've given one of my AIDES a FLASH HM. Make sure you go get it!
texts.PokedexRating_Text_LessThan30:
Your POKéDEX could use a bit more volume still!

Try to catch other species of POKéMON!
texts.PokedexRating_Text_LessThan40:
Good, it's apparent that you're trying hard!

I've given one of my AIDES an ITEMFINDER. Be sure to collect it!

Your POKéDEX is coming along quite well!

I've given one of my AIDES an AMULET COIN. Be sure to get it!

Ah, you've finally topped 50 species!

I've given one of my AIDES an EXP. SHARE. Be sure to go get it!

texts.PokedexRating_Text_LessThan120: You even have the evolved forms of POKéMON! Super!

texts.PokedexRating_Text_LessThan140: Outstanding! You've become a real pro at this!

texts.Pokedude_Text_SpeedierBattlerGoesFirst: POKé DUDE: The speedier of the battlers gets to attack first.
texts.Pokedude_Text_MyRattataFasterThanPidgey: It looks like my RATTATA was faster than the PIDGEY.
texts.Pokedude_Text_BattlersTakeTurnsAttacking: The battlers take turns attacking and reducing each other's HP.
texts.Pokedude_Text_MyRattataWonGetsEXP:
My RATTATA reduced the foe's HP to zero, so it wins!

The POKéMON that took part in the battle get EXP. Points.

When a POKéMON collects enough EXP. Points, it levels up.

Leveling up makes your POKéMON stronger than before.
texts.Pokedude_Text_UhOhRattataPoisoned:
POKé DUDE: Uh-oh… My RATTATA has been poisoned…

If a POKéMON is poisoned, it loses HP steadily.
texts.Pokedude_Text_HealStatusRightAway: If a POKéMON develops a status problem, heal it right away.
texts.Pokedude_Text_UsingItemTakesTurn:
Using an item on a POKéMON uses up one turn, though.

Now, it's the opponent's turn!
texts.Pokedude_Text_WaterNotVeryEffectiveAgain:
POKé DUDE: The move BUBBLE is a WATER-type attack.

The targeted ODDISH is a GRASS/POISON-type POKéMON.

The WATER-type attack is absorbed by the GRASS-type POKéMON…

As a result, the move becomes not very effective, and inflicts only half the usual damage.
texts.Pokedude_Text_GrassEffectiveAgainstWater:
Uh-oh, this is not good!

The ABSORB attack you just saw is a GRASS-type move.

POLIWAG is a WATER-type POKéMON.

So, ABSORB becomes super effective, doubling the damage.
texts.Pokedude_Text_LetsTryShiftingMons:
It's not going to be easy to win with this matchup…

Let's try shifting POKéMON!
texts.Pokedude_Text_ShiftingUsesTurn:
Shifting POKéMON in and out uses up one turn.

Now, it's the opponent's turn.
texts.Pokedude_Text_ButterfreeDoubleResistsGra:
BUTTERFREE is a BUG/FLYING-type POKéMON.

Against this POKéMON, a GRASS- type attack…

…inflicts only half the usual damage on a BUG-type POKéMON…

…And, it also causes only half the damage on a FLYING-type POKéMON.

Therefore, BUTTERFREE, being a BUG/FLYING POKéMON, only takes one quarter of the usual damage.
texts.Pokedude_Text_ButterfreeGoodAgainstOddis:
ODDISH is a GRASS/POISON-type POKéMON.

A FLYING- or PSYCHIC-type attack is super effective against it.

One of those types of attacks will inflict double the usual damage.

Okay, here we go!
texts.Pokedude_Text_WeakenMonBeforeCatching:
POKé DUDE: When you're trying to catch a POKéMON, don't throw any POKé BALLS right away.

First, you need to weaken it by reducing its HP.
texts.Pokedude_Text_BestIfTargetStatused:
Okay, that should be good enough.

But, if it's possible, it would be best if the target has a status problem.

For instance, it would be easier to catch if it were asleep or paralyzed.
texts.Pokedude_Text_CantDoubleUpOnStatus:
This will make the POKéMON a lot easier to catch!

Oh, yes. If you paralyze a POKéMON, you can't make it fall asleep on top of paralysis.

In other words, you can't double up status problems, okay?
texts.Pokedude_Text_LetMeThrowBall: Okay! Let me throw my POKé BALL!
texts.Pokedude_Text_PickBestKindOfBall: Before you throw a POKé BALL, consider the condition and the type of POKéMON, and pick the kind of BALL that would work best.

texts.Route14_Text_IsaacRematchIntro: You're here again, huh? Shut up and battle.
texts.Route14_Text_GeraldRematchIntro: We've been riding here because of the wide-open spaces.
texts.Route14_Text_KiriRematchIntro: KIRI: JAN, I hope we win today.
texts.Route14_Text_JanRematchIntro: JAN: KIRI, here we go! Let's win for sure this time!
texts.Route15_Text_KindraRematchIntro: I'm going to keep battling with the POKéMON I got in trades.
texts.Route15_Text_BeckyRematchIntro:
You look gentle, so I think I can beat you.

I'll give it one more go!
texts.Route15_Text_EdwinRematchIntro:
When I whistle, bird POKéMON gather around.

They're amazingly cute!
texts.Route15_Text_ChesterRematchIntro: Hmm? My birds are shivering! Wait, aren't you that TRAINER…
texts.Route15_Text_GraceRematchIntro: Oh, you're a little cutie! So like a darling POKéMON! I remember you now!
texts.Route15_Text_OliviaRematchIntro:
I raise POKéMON for protection because I live alone.

That hasn't changed.
texts.Route15_Text_ErnestRematchIntro: Hey, kid! C'mon! I got these off some loser!
texts.Route15_Text_AlexRematchIntro: Fork over all your cash when you lose to me, kid!
texts.Route15_Text_CeliaRematchIntro: What's cool and happening? Trading POKéMON, of course.
texts.Route15_Text_YazminRematchIntro: Want to play with my POKéMON again?
texts.Route15_Text_MyaRematchIntro:
MYA: Hi, we keep meeting, don't we?

Help me train my little brother again?
texts.Route15_Text_RonRematchIntro: RON: My sister's gotten more powerful…
texts.Route16_Text_KojiRematchIntro: Nice BIKE! Hand it over quick!
texts.Route16_Text_LukeRematchIntro: Come out and play, little mouse. I'll treat you right!
texts.Route16_Text_HideoRematchIntro: Hey, wait a second! Don't call me and then run away!
texts.Route16_Text_CamronRematchIntro: I'm feeling hungry and mean! I really need a punching bag!
texts.Route16_Text_RubenRematchIntro: Hey, there! We'll have ourselves a good time!
texts.Route16_Text_JedRematchIntro: JED: Are you here to see our love, which knows no bounds?
texts.Route16_Text_LeaRematchIntro: LEA: Sometimes, the intensity of our love scares me.
texts.Route17_Text_RaulRematchIntro: I told you, there's no getting rich quick in battling kids.
texts.Route17_Text_IsaiahRematchIntro: I'm mighty proud of my bod, kiddo. Come on!
texts.Route17_Text_BillyRematchIntro: We're BIKERS! We rule the roads, man!
texts.Route17_Text_NikolasRematchIntro: VOLTORB's going to seriously electrify you today!
texts.Route17_Text_ZeekRematchIntro: I leveled up my POKéMON, but it absolutely won't evolve. Why?
texts.Route17_Text_JamalRematchIntro: Gaah! I really need to exercise and seriously trim some flab!
texts.Route17_Text_JaxonRematchIntro: Yep, that's a nice BIKE! How's it handle?
texts.Route18_Text_WiltonRematchIntro:
I've been checking every grassy area for new POKéMON.

But it's not always easy…
texts.Route18_Text_RamiroRematchIntro: Koorukukukoo! Is my birdcall getting better?
texts.Route18_Text_JacobRematchIntro:
I warned you before, this is my turf!

I don't want you coming around.
texts.Route19_Text_RichardRematchIntro: I'm almost warmed up to go out for a swim.
texts.Route19_Text_ReeceRematchIntro: Wait! Slow down! What if you have a heart attack?
texts.Route19_Text_MatthewRematchIntro: I love swimming! I guess you're the surfing type.
texts.Route19_Text_DouglasRematchIntro: What's beyond the horizon? Have you seen?
texts.Route19_Text_DavidRematchIntro: I tried diving for POKéMON again, but it was a no-go like before.
texts.Route19_Text_TonyRematchIntro:
I look at the sea to forget all the bad things that happened.

…Like losing to you the last time!
texts.Route19_Text_AnyaRematchIntro:
You always get to ride your POKéMON…

It looks so relaxing. Can I have it if I win?
texts.Route19_Text_AxleRematchIntro: These waters are treacherous! You shouldn't come back here!
texts.Route19_Text_ConnieRematchIntro: I swam here with my friends… I'm tired… Must we really battle again?
texts.Route19_Text_LiaRematchIntro:
LIA: You know my brother just became a TRAINER, right?

I want to make him better, so I need your help again.
texts.Route19_Text_LucRematchIntro:
LUC: My big sis taught me all about POKéMON.

I wonder if I'm better?
texts.Route20_Text_BarryRematchIntro: The water is shallow here. There are many people swimming.
texts.Route20_Text_ShirleyRematchIntro: Are you jealous that I'm vacationing on SEAFOAM?
texts.Route20_Text_TiffanyRematchIntro: I love floating with the fishes here among the waves.
texts.Route20_Text_DeanRematchIntro:
Check out my physique!

It's even more buff than ever before!
texts.Route20_Text_DarrinRematchIntro: Why are you riding a POKéMON? Haven't you learned to swim yet?
texts.Route20_Text_RogerRematchIntro: I rode my bird POKéMON here.
texts.Route20_Text_NoraRematchIntro: My boyfriend gave me big pearls. And, they've grown bigger!
texts.Route20_Text_MissyRematchIntro: I swam here from CINNABAR ISLAND. It wasn't easy, like I said.
texts.Route20_Text_MelissaRematchIntro:
CINNABAR, in the west, has a LAB for POKéMON.

My daddy works there.
texts.Route21_North_Text_RonaldRematchIntro: You want to know if the fish are biting?
texts.Route21_North_Text_WadeRematchIntro: I got a big haul again! Wanna go for it once more?
texts.Route21_North_Text_SpencerRematchIntro: The sea cleanses my body and soul!
texts.Route21_North_Text_CueBallRematchIntro: きょうも　およぎに きちまったぜ
texts.Route21_South_Text_JackRematchIntro: I caught my POKéMON at sea. And that's where I train them.
texts.Route21_South_Text_JeromeRematchIntro: Right now, I'm in another triathlon meet!
texts.Route21_South_Text_RolandRematchIntro: Ahh! Feel the sun and the wind!
texts.Route21_South_Text_ClaudeRematchIntro: Hey, cut it out already. You always scare away the fish!
texts.Route21_South_Text_NolanRematchIntro: Keep me company till I get a hit.
texts.Route21_North_Text_LilRematchIntro: LIL: Huh? A battle again? IAN, can't you do it alone?
texts.Route21_North_Text_IanRematchIntro: IAN: My sis is still a slob. Help me get her into shape!
texts.Route25_Text_JoeyRematchIntro: I won't lose while I'm here!
texts.Route25_Text_DanRematchIntro: Dad took me to a great party on the S.S. ANNE at VERMILION CITY.
texts.Route25_Text_FlintRematchIntro:
I'm a cool guy. I've got a girlfriend!

I'll show her how cool I am for sure this time!
texts.Route25_Text_KelseyRematchIntro: Hi! My boyfriend is cool! My conditioning's good today!
texts.Route25_Text_ChadRematchIntro: I had this feeling… I knew I had to battle you again!
texts.Route25_Text_HaleyRematchIntro: My friend has many cute POKéMON. I'm so jealous!
texts.Route25_Text_FranklinRematchIntro: I just trained up on MT. MOON, but I've still got gas in the tank!
texts.Route25_Text_NobRematchIntro: A POKéMANIAC lives on the cape. Have you seen his collection?
texts.Route25_Text_WayneRematchIntro: You're going to see BILL again? First, we battle!
texts.Route24_Text_ShaneRematchIntro: I saw your feat from the grass!
texts.Route24_Text_ReliRematchIntro: You always look so busy… Aren't you getting tired?
texts.Route24_Text_TimmyRematchIntro: You really must love coming to NUGGET BRIDGE.
texts.Route24_Text_AliRematchIntro:
The time we battled…

Even though I was the second in line, I was the best, wasn't I?
texts.Route24_Text_CaleRematchIntro:
People call this the NUGGET BRIDGE!

You've already beaten us, so you're not allowed to take the challenge…

…But, you're welcome to battle with us again.
texts.OneIsland_TreasureBeach_Text_AmaraRematc: Lying back, rocked by the waves… I don't notice time slipping by…
texts.OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_MariaRematchIn: The weather's gorgeous! I'll try not to spoil it.
texts.OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_AbigailRematch: My sunburn is starting to hurt…
texts.OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_FinnRematchInt: The fire bird's mountain casts a huge shadow…
texts.OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_GarrettRematch: I have this strong feeling that I can win this time!
texts.OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_TommyRematchIn: Wait! Wait a second! I'm sure I've hooked a big one!
texts.OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_SharonRematchI: You'll help me out with my training again?
texts.OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_TanyaRematchIn: We haven't missed a single day of training yet!
texts.OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_SheaRematchInt: Every morning, before breakfast, I swim around this island… Three times!
texts.OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_HughRematchInt: Dress appropriately for battle! Lose that frivolous outfit, I said!
texts.OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_BryceRematchIn: You know, everything tastes great when you're out in the wild.
texts.OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_ClaireRematchI: I ate too much again, so will you battle us for some exercise?
texts.OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_KiaRematchIntr:
KIA: My big brother and I make an awesome combination!

We won't lose this time!
texts.OneIsland_KindleRoad_Text_MikRematchIntr:
MIK: Together with KIA, we're afraid of nothing!

We'll prove it to you this time!
texts.ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_VioletRematc: From where have you come, and where are you bound?
texts.ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_AmiraRematch: I want to swim without my float ring soon.
texts.ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_TishaRematch: Oh, no, didn't I tell you already? Please, stay away from me!
texts.ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_JoyRematchIn: JOY: We've gotten stronger! Lots and lots!
texts.ThreeIsland_BondBridge_Text_MegRematchIn: MEG: You can't beat us today!
texts.FiveIsland_WaterLabyrinth_Text_AlizeRema:
Oh, hello!

Are you raising your POKéMON in a good environment?
texts.FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_DaisyRema: With these hands, I will create my victory today.
texts.FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_CelinaRem: Must I repeat myself? I'm trying to paint. Please keep out of my sight!
texts.FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_RaynaRema: I haven't made any progress… I still can't get the right angle…
texts.FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_JackiRema: Oh, you will give me another opportunity to match wits with you?
texts.FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_GillianRe:
They're almost finished making the pool for my POKéMON.

You must drop in for a visit.
texts.FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_DestinRem: I'm a good runner. I've gotten even faster!
texts.FiveIsland_ResortGorgeous_Text_TobyRemat: I say, friend! Let us enjoy our time together!
texts.FiveIsland_MemorialPillar_Text_MiloRemat:
I'm the eldest of the BIRD BROTHERS. Remember me?

That's right, I'm the one who loves birds for their beaks!
texts.FiveIsland_MemorialPillar_Text_ChazRemat:
I'm the middle kid of the BIRD BROTHERS.

I'm the one that loves wings. Let's battle again!
texts.FiveIsland_MemorialPillar_Text_HaroldRem:
I'm the youngest of the BIRD BROTHERS.

I love birds for their down. I didn't think I'd see you again!
texts.SixIsland_OutcastIsland_Text_TylorRematc: I'm still having no luck at all. A battle'd be a change of pace!
texts.SixIsland_OutcastIsland_Text_MymoRematch:
Gasp… Gasp…

I swam here from SIX ISLAND's port in one go again.
texts.SixIsland_OutcastIsland_Text_NicoleRemat: You always come along while I'm swimming.
texts.SixIsland_OutcastIsland_Text_AvaRematchI: AVA: Let's have another two-on-two marine battle today!
texts.SixIsland_OutcastIsland_Text_GebRematchI: GEB: My big sister and I are way tougher than before!
texts.SixIsland_GreenPath_Text_JaclynRematchIn:
…Huh?

I envision my house, but TELEPORT always brings me here!
texts.SixIsland_WaterPath_Text_RoseRematchIntr: Oh, hello. A pleasant breeze is blowing again.
texts.SixIsland_WaterPath_Text_EdwardRematchIn: Hehehe, I'm practicing in secret again.
texts.SixIsland_WaterPath_Text_SamirRematchInt:
What, you're sick of seeing SWIMMERS like me?

Aww, don't be hatin'! Battle with me again.
texts.SixIsland_WaterPath_Text_EarlRematchIntr: Come on, tell me, where are the mountains around these parts?
texts.SixIsland_WaterPath_Text_MiuRematchIntro: MIU: Hello, POKéMON! It's time to play again!
texts.SixIsland_WaterPath_Text_MiaRematchIntro: MIA: Hello, POKéMON! It's time to battle again!
texts.SixIsland_RuinValley_Text_StanlyRematchI: There appear to be many secrets still unsolved in this world.
texts.SixIsland_RuinValley_Text_FosterRematchI: Hi, didn't we meet before? What compelled you to come back?
texts.SixIsland_RuinValley_Text_LarryRematchIn:
It's been said that there are mysterious stones on this island.

Have you discovered anything since we last met?
texts.SixIsland_RuinValley_Text_DarylRematchIn: A rematch with you, so high up!
texts.SixIsland_RuinValley_Text_HectorRematchI: I'm pretty familiar with the land around these parts.
texts.SevenIsland_TrainerTower_Text_RodetteRem: Somewhere on this island, peculiar POKéMON are sleeping.
texts.SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Entrance_Text_:
Kyahaha!

Coming back won't change a thing. I'll flick you away effortlessly!
Howdy! You're a member of my fan club, isn't that right?
This island is too spread out… Patrolling the place is a drag…
I don't forgive people who abuse POKéMON!
EVE: I'll team up with JON and battle together again.
JON: When I'm with EVE, it feels like we could never lose, not ever.
texts.SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_CyndyRema: Let's have another battle. My conditioning's in top form!
texts.SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_EvanRemat:
It doesn't matter if you happen to have the strongest POKéMON…

It doesn't mean a thing if you don't know how to use them properly!
texts.SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_JacksonRe: I work to protect the environment. In turn, nature protects me!
texts.SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_KatelynRe: Every time we meet, you have those snazzy shoes on.
texts.SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_LeroyRema: You must have gotten tougher. Let me battle you, please!
texts.SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_MichelleR:
I was given the best possible education to become this strong.

I won't lose this time. Absolutely not!
texts.SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_LexRematc: LEX: My darling NYA, together we will win for certain!
texts.SevenIsland_SevaultCanyon_Text_NyaRematc: NYA: I won't drag down my mentor LEX! We're going to win!
texts.SevenIsland_TanobyRuins_Text_BrandonRema: Have you discovered anything about this stone chamber?
texts.SevenIsland_TanobyRuins_Text_BenjaminRem: A mystic POKéMON is said to sleep inside here.
texts.SevenIsland_TanobyRuins_Text_EdnaRematch: My teacher is showing me how to paint some more.
texts.SevenIsland_TanobyRuins_Text_CliffordRem: Today, in addition to our lesson, we came to see the chamber again.
texts.Text_FirstShouldRestoreMonsHealth: First, you should restore your POKéMON to full health.
texts.Text_MonsHealedShouldBuyPotions:
Your POKéMON have been healed to perfect health.

If your POKéMON's energy, HP, is down, please come see us.

If you're planning to go far in the field, you should buy some POTIONS at the POKéMON MART.

We hope you excel!
texts.Text_MonsHealed:
Your POKéMON have been healed to perfect health.

We hope you excel!
texts.Text_HadQuiteAnExperienceTakeRest:
MOM: {PLAYER}! Welcome home.

It sounds like you had quite an experience.

Maybe you should take a quick rest.
texts.Text_MomExplainHPGetPotions:
MOM: Oh, good! You and your POKéMON are looking great.

I just heard from PROF. OAK.

He said that POKéMON's energy is measured in HP.

If your POKéMON lose their HP, you can restore them at any POKéMON CENTER.

If you're going to travel far away, the smart TRAINER stocks up on POTIONS at the POKéMON MART.

Make me proud, honey!

Take care!
texts.Text_WhitedOutLostMoney:
{PLAYER} is out of usable POKéMON!

{PLAYER} panicked and lost ¥{STR_VAR_1}…

… … … …

{PLAYER} whited out!
texts.Text_WhitedOut:
{PLAYER} is out of usable POKéMON!

{PLAYER} whited out!
